https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.summary_zh: 专注于尼日利亚市场的数字金融服务公司OPay已在纽约证券交易所（NYSE）上市，在首次公开募股（IPO）中筹集了$3.04亿，并取得超过$40亿的市场市值。OPay首席财务官James Perry表示，公司在2026年第二季度达到了$10亿的年化营收水平。“OPay凭借强劲的财务实力进入公开市场，在2026年第二季度达到$10亿的年化营收水平。”
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.body: OPay, a Nigeria-focused digital financial services company, has listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE), raising $304 million in its initial public offering (IPO) and securing a market capitalisation of more than $4 billion. The company began trading on Friday, pricing its offering at $19 per American Depositary Share (ADS). It sold 16 million ADSs, with each representing 10 ordinary shares. According to the company, the United States Securities and Exchange Commission declared its registration statement effective on 29 October, and the offering was expected to close on 2 November. Lars Boilesen, OPay’s co-chief executive officer, said the listing marked a significant milestone for the company and Nigeria’s financial technology sector. “Today, OPay serves over 50 million monthly active users across Nigeria, Egypt, Pakistan, and Indonesia. Since launching in Nigeria eight years ago, we have pioneered seamless digital payments to become the country’s leading digital financial platform,” he said. Mr Boilesen said the company had recorded a 9.9 per cent market share across Africa and the Middle East based on monthly average users in the first half of 2026. He said OPay saw further growth opportunities in Nigeria, where an estimated 40 million adults remained outside the formal financial system. “Our journey is just beginning. In Nigeria, an estimated 40 million adults remain outside the formal financial system,” he said. He added that the company intended to apply its experience in Nigeria to other emerging markets, where young populations and increasing mobile internet access were expanding demand for digital financial services. Stephen Wen, another co-chief executive officer of OPay, said the company was positioned to expand across emerging markets, citing growing smartphone penetration and demand for accessible financial services. “In Nigeria, more than 60 per cent of the population are underserved by traditional banks and rely on cash. As we grow, we will stay focused on solving our customers’ pain points to make financial services accessible and convenient,” he said. James Perry, OPay’s chief financial officer, said the company had reached a $1 billion revenue run rate in the second quarter of 2026. He said OPay recorded 137 per cent year-on-year growth and a 19 per cent net margin in the first six months of the year. “OPay enters the public markets from a position of financial strength, reaching a $1 billion revenue run rate in Q2 2026. For the first six months of 2026, we grew 137% year-on-year and reached 19% net margin,” Mr Perry said. He said the company planned to use the IPO proceeds to invest in technology and support growth in Nigeria and other African markets. OPay has expanded beyond payments into savings, credit and merchant services, with plans to develop a broader financial and lifestyle platform. Launched in Nigeria in 2018, OPay operates an integrated digital financial platform serving users in Nigeria, Egypt, Pakistan and Indonesia
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.title_zh: OPay在纽约证券交易所上市，IPO募资3.04亿美元，估值达40亿美元
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.body_zh: 专注于尼日利亚市场的数字金融服务公司OPay已在纽约证券交易所（NYSE）上市，在首次公开募股（IPO）中募资3.04亿美元，市值超过40亿美元。该公司于周五开始交易，每份美国存托股份（ADS）发行价为19美元，共出售1600万份ADS，每份代表10股普通股。据公司介绍，美国证券交易委员会于10月29日宣布其注册声明生效，本次发行预计于11月2日结束。OPay联席首席执行官Lars Boilesen表示，此次上市标志着公司和尼日利亚金融科技行业迈出了重要一步。他说：“如今，OPay在尼日利亚、埃及、巴基斯坦和印度尼西亚拥有超过5000万月活跃用户。自8年前在尼日利亚启动业务以来，我们开创了便捷的数字支付服务，使OPay发展成为该国领先的数字金融平台。”Boilesen先生表示，根据2026年上半年的月均用户数，公司在非洲和中东的市场份额达到9.9%。他说，OPay在尼日利亚仍面临进一步增长机会，该国估计有4000万成年人尚未纳入正规金融体系。他说：“我们的征程才刚刚开始。在尼日利亚，估计仍有4000万成年人处于正规金融体系之外。”他还表示，公司计划将在尼日利亚积累的经验推广至其他新兴市场；这些市场人口年轻，移动网络接入率不断提高，正推动数字金融服务的需求增长。OPay另一位联席首席执行官Stephen Wen表示，智能手机普及率上升以及人们对便捷金融服务的需求，使公司具备在各新兴市场扩张的有利条件。他说：“在尼日利亚，超过60%的人口未能获得传统银行的充分服务，仍然依赖现金。随着业务发展，我们将继续专注于解决客户痛点，让金融服务变得触手可及、便捷易用。”OPay首席财务官James Perry表示，公司在2026年第二季度实现了10亿美元的年化收入。他说，2026年前六个月，OPay实现137%的同比增长，净利润率达到19%。Perry先生说：“OPay凭借稳健的财务状况进入公开市场，在2026年第二季度实现10亿美元的年化收入。2026年前六个月，我们的同比增长达到137%，净利润率达到19%。”他说，公司计划利用IPO所得款项投资技术，并支持在尼日利亚及其他非洲市场的增长。OPay已从支付业务拓展至储蓄、信贷和商户服务，并计划打造更综合的金融与生活服务平台。OPay于2018年在尼日利亚推出，目前运营一个综合性数字金融平台，服务尼日利亚、埃及、巴基斯坦和印度尼西亚的用户

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 华盛顿——韩国韩华航空航天株式会社旗下子公司Hanwha Defense USA（HDUSA）获得了为美国海军和海军陆战队建造一艘中型登陆舰（LSM）的2.69亿美元合同。据该公司称，这是其首次获得美国海军造船合同。此次选标通过Tote Services的船舶建造管理项目竞争性招标程序完成，该项目管理美国海军和海军陆战队的造船合同。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — Hanwha Defense USA (HDUSA), a subsidiary of South Korea's Hanwha Aerospace Co., has secured a $269 million contract to build a medium landing ship (LSM) for the U.S. Navy and Marine Corps, marking its first U.S. Navy shipbuilding contract, according to the company. The company said Thursday it was selected by U.S. maritime services firm Tote Services to build one LSM at Hanwha Philly Shipyard in Philadelphia, with options to construct three additional vessels. The selection was made through a competitive bidding process under Tote Services' vessel construction management program, which oversees shipbuilding contracts for the U.S. Navy and Marine Corps. "Since acquiring Philly Shipyard in 2024, Hanwha has made significant investments in its workforce and technology to pave the way to build ships for the U.S. Navy and other federal customers," HDUSA President and Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Michael Coulter said. Construction is scheduled to begin in the fourth quarter of 2027. Tote Services' $2.2 billion vessel construction manager contract supports the Navy and Marine Corps' planned 35-ship LSM fleet. The program's first vessel is expected to be delivered in 2030. The announcement comes as HDUSA is moving to acquire a controlling stake in Hanwha Philly Shipyard, which Hanwha purchased in 2024, as the South Korean defense group seeks to expand its presence in the U.S. shipbuilding industry
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: Hanwha Defense USA赢得美国海军2.69亿美元造船合同
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 华盛顿——据韩华防务美国公司（HDUSA）消息，该公司是韩国韩华航空航天公司的子公司，已获得一份价值2.69亿美元的合同，为美国海军和海军陆战队建造一艘中型登陆舰（LSM）。这是该公司首次获得美国海军舰船建造合同。该公司周四表示，美国海事服务企业Tote Services已选定其在费城韩华费城造船厂建造一艘LSM，并可选择增建3艘舰船。此次遴选通过Tote Services舰船建造管理计划下的竞争性招标程序进行，该计划负责美国海军和海军陆战队的舰船建造合同。HDUSA总裁兼首席执行官（CEO）迈克尔·库尔特表示：“韩华于2024年收购费城造船厂以来，在员工队伍和技术方面投入了大量资金，为美国海军及其他联邦客户建造舰船铺平了道路。”建造工作计划于2027年第四季度开始。Tote Services价值22亿美元的舰船建造管理合同支持海军和海军陆战队计划组建的35艘LSM舰队。该计划的首艘舰船预计将于2030年交付。宣布此项消息之际，HDUSA正推进收购韩华费城造船厂的控股权。韩华于2024年买下该造船厂，这家韩国防务集团旨在扩大其在美国造船业的布局

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title: Construction, demolition activities halted in Delhi-NCR from Nov 5 to 20 to curb air pollution
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary: The Centre on Friday announced a pause on construction and demolition activities across Delhi-NCR from November 5 to 20 in view of the pollution situation that begins in the national capital with the onset of winters. However, the government has exempted construction activities related to railways, metro services, airports, inter state bus terminals, hospitals, water supply and sanitation, national security and defence related activities and ‘projects of national importance’ from the pollution control measures.
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary_zh: 考虑到首都地区入冬后开始出现的污染状况，该中心周五宣布，11月5日至20日暂停德里—国家首都地区各地的施工和拆除活动。不过，政府豁免了与铁路、地铁服务、机场、城际客运总站、医院、供水与卫生、国家安全和国防相关的活动以及“具有 national importance 的项目”有关的施工活动，这些活动不受污染控制措施限制。
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: The Centre on Friday announced a pause on construction and demolition activities across Delhi-NCR from November 5 to 20 in view of the pollution situation that begins in the national capital with the onset of winters. The state government and private offices have also been directed to operate with upto 50% of the staff strength attending physically, while the remaining will work from home. Announcing the air pollution curbs, the government said that historical data indicates that pollution during mid-November peaks and Air Quality Index (AQI) levels reach 'Severe' and 'Severe+' categories on certain days. “This recurring pattern underscores the need for timely preventive interventions to minimize emissions before and during the onset of peak pollution episodes,” the order issued on Friday said. However, the government has exempted construction activities related to railways, metro services, airports, inter state bus terminals, hospitals, water supply and sanitation, national security and defence related activities and ‘projects of national importance’ from the pollution control measures. “This restriction shall also apply to linear public projects such as highways, roads, flyovers, overbridges, power transmission, pipelines, tele-communication etc,” the order said. While the Delhi air quality has started dipping, an overnight rainfall improved the Air Quality Index (AQI) to 133 in the ‘Moderate category’ on Friday. The AQI remained above 200 in the 'Poor' category on Wednesday and Thursday, according to the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB). The Air Quality Early Warning System for Delhi indicates that the city's air quality will likely remain in the moderate category until October 31, before deteriorating to the poor category from November 1 and further going down for the subsequent six days. In August, the Delhi government had called for a complete ban on construction and demolition activities from December 10 to January 20 under its winter action plan. The Delhi Traffic Police has also announced fresh restrictions under the revised Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) on vehicles entering the national capital from November 1, 2026. Stage-I of the GRAP is activated in Delhi-NCR when the AQI falls between 201 and 300, classified as ‘poor’. The Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) brings these measures into force to tackle pollution from sources such as road dust, vehicle emissions and open waste burning. The first stage focuses on reducing pollution at its source, with steps aimed at controlling dust from construction and roads, limiting vehicle emissions and checking industrial pollution. Under the fresh curbs to control air pollution in Delhi, the traffic police said that vehicles meeting BS-VI emission standards, along with CNG and electric vehicles will be allowed to enter and operate in Delhi. It also said that vehicles covered under specific exemptions in the notification will also be permitted, subject to the applicable rules. Every year, Delhi tackles air pollution with Air Quality Index (AQI) touching record levels – often pushed by emissions caused by vehicular movement, stubble burning in the neighbouring states and firecrackers during Diwali time
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title_zh: 德里—国家首都区11月5日至20日暂停施工和拆除活动，以遏制空气污染
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body_zh: 该中心周五宣布，鉴于首都地区进入冬季后开始出现的污染状况，11月5日至20日暂停德里—国家首都地区各地的施工和拆除活动。邦政府和私营机构也被指示最多安排50%的员工到岗，其余员工居家办公。政府宣布空气污染限制措施时表示，历史数据显示，污染在11月中旬达到高峰，空气质量指数（AQI）在某些日子会升至“严重”和“严重+”类别。周五发布的命令称：“这一反复出现的模式凸显了及时采取预防性干预措施，以便在污染高峰来临前及期间减少排放的必要性。”不过，政府豁免了与铁路、地铁服务、机场、州际巴士总站、医院、供水与卫生、国家安全和国防相关的活动，以及“具有全国重要性的项目”所涉及的施工活动。命令称：“这一限制还将适用于高速公路、道路、天桥、立交桥、输电、管道、电信等线性公共项目。”德里空气质量已开始下降，周五夜间降雨使空气质量指数（AQI）改善至133，处于“中等”类别。据中央污染控制委员会（CPCB）数据，周三和周四AQI仍高于200，处于“差”类别。德里空气质量预警系统显示，该市空气质量可能维持中等类别至10月31日，随后从11月1日起恶化至“差”类别，并在此后六天进一步下降。今年8月，德里政府曾依据冬季行动计划，呼吁从12月10日至1月20日全面禁止施工和拆除活动。德里交警还宣布，根据修订后的分级响应行动计划（GRAP），自2026年11月1日起对驶入首都的车辆实施新限制。当AQI介于201至300、归类为“差”时，德里—国家首都地区将启动GRAP第一阶段。空气质量管理委员会（CAQM）负责实施这些措施，以应对道路扬尘、车辆排放和露天焚烧垃圾等污染源。第一阶段重点从源头减少污染，采取措施控制施工和道路扬尘、限制车辆排放并检查工业污染。在德里控制空气污染的新措施下，交警表示，符合BS-VI排放标准的车辆以及压缩天然气车和电动汽车将获准进入并在德里通行。公告还称，通知中明确豁免的车辆也将获准通行，但须遵守适用规则。每年，德里都要应对空气污染，空气质量指数（AQI）屡次达到创纪录水平——污染通常由车辆行驶、邻近邦焚烧秸秆以及排灯节期间燃放烟花所造成的排放推动

https://leadership.ng/nigerian-businesse.title: ‘Nigerian Businesses Must Prioritise Online Discoverability’
https://leadership.ng/nigerian-businesse.summary: Speaking at a business forum in Lagos yesterday, Madiebo said businesses needed to consider how customers search for products, services, jobs, properties and other opportunities online, rather than focusing only on maintaining a digital presence. Businesses also need to think about discoverability. He said online visibility and discoverability were increasingly important considerations for businesses seeking to reach customers in Nigeria’s expanding digital marketplace.
https://leadership.ng/nigerian-businesse.summary_zh: 马迪博昨天在拉各斯举行的商业论坛上表示，企业需要考虑顾客如何在网上搜索产品、服务、职位、房产及其他机会，而不应只关注维持数字形象。企业还需要思考如何让自身容易被发现。他说，在尼日利亚不断扩大的数字市场中，网络可见度和可发现性正日益成为企业接触顾客时需要考虑的重要因素。
https://leadership.ng/nigerian-businesse.body: Speaking at a business forum in Lagos yesterday, Madiebo said businesses needed to consider how customers search for products, services, jobs, properties and other opportunities online, rather than focusing only on maintaining a digital presence. Nigeria had an estimated 109 million internet users at the end of 2025, representing 45.5 per cent of the population, while social media user identities stood at 47.8 million, according to DataReportal’s Digital 2026: Nigeria report. He said consumers increasingly used digital platforms to find specific products and services, compare available options and identify providers that met their needs. “Having a digital presence is important, but presence alone is not enough. Businesses also need to think about discoverability. When someone is actively looking for a product, service or opportunity, can that person easily find your business?” he said. Madiebo said businesses could not rely solely on advertising and social media posts to attract customers, noting that many consumers searched directly for specific goods and services. He added that businesses needed to make relevant information about their offerings accessible on platforms where potential customers could find them. The issue affects businesses across different sectors, including property, employment, hospitality and professional services, where customers often search for specific offerings before making decisions. Wetinuneed is a digital platform that brings together listings for businesses, products, properties, jobs and events. Madiebo said businesses needed to assess how easily prospective customers could find them online, particularly as internet usage continued to shape consumer behaviour. He said online visibility and discoverability were increasingly important considerations for businesses seeking to reach customers in Nigeria’s expanding digital marketplace. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/nigerian-businesse.title_zh: “尼日利亚企业必须优先提升在线曝光度”
https://leadership.ng/nigerian-businesse.body_zh: 昨天在拉各斯举行的一场商业论坛上，马迪博表示，企业需要考虑顾客如何在线搜索产品、服务、职位、房产和其他机会，而不应只专注于维持数字存在感。据 DataReportal 的《数字 2026：尼日利亚》报告，尼日利亚截至 2025 年底估计有 1.09 亿互联网用户，占总人口的 45.5%，社交媒体用户身份数量达到 4780 万。他说，消费者越来越依赖数字平台寻找特定产品和服务、比较现有选项，并identify符合自身需求的供应商。他说：“拥有数字存在感很重要，但仅有存在感还不够。企业还需要考虑能否被找到。当有人积极寻找某种产品、服务或机会时，这个人能否轻松找到你的企业？”马迪博表示，企业不能仅靠广告和社交媒体帖子吸引顾客，因为许多消费者会直接搜索特定商品和服务。他补充说，企业需要确保有关其产品和服务的信息，可以在潜在顾客能够找到它们的平台上便捷获取。这一问题影响着房地产、就业、酒店餐饮和专业服务等多个行业的企业，因为顾客在作出决定前通常会搜索特定的产品和服务。Wetinuneed 是一个数字平台，汇集企业、产品、房产、职位和活动的各类信息。马迪博表示，企业需要评估潜在顾客能够在多大程度上轻松地在线找到它们，尤其是在互联网使用持续塑造消费者行为的情况下。他说，对于希望触达尼日利亚不断扩大的数字市场顾客的企业而言，在线曝光度和可发现性正成为越来越重要的考量因素。我们掌握独家优势。获取实时报道、突发独家消息和独家视角，直接送达您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入 WhatsApp 上的 LEADERSHIP NEWS，随时随地获取 24/7 动态 →

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/30/o.title: Okpella Monarch Unveils Support for Small-Scale Business Owners, Free Electricity for the Elderly
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/30/o.summary: The Okuokpellagbe of Okpella, Edo State, King Michael Olorunfemi Sado, has unveiled an initiative aimed at providing monthly financial support for small-scale business owners in the community, in a move designed to stimulate local economic activities, strengthen livelihoods and promote grassroots development.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/30/o.summary_zh: 埃多州奥克佩拉的首领奥库奥克佩拉格贝、迈克尔·奥洛伦费米·萨多国王宣布了一项计划，拟每月向社区的小规模企业主提供经济支持，以促进地方经济活动、强化民众生计并推动基层发展。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/30/o.body: The Okuokpellagbe of Okpella, Edo State, King Michael Olorunfemi Sado, has unveiled an initiative aimed at providing monthly financial support for small-scale business owners in the community, in a move designed to stimulate local economic activities, strengthen livelihoods and promote grassroots development. The monarch, who made the disclosure in a video currently circulating on social media, said the initiative was conceived to help small businesses thrive while extending support to elderly residents who may be struggling to meet their daily needs. According to him, the intervention is part of a broader effort to improve the welfare of residents and create an enabling environment for economic activities to flourish in Okpella. In the viral video, the traditional ruler explained that the proposed initiative would provide regular financial assistance to small-scale business operators, with the objective of helping them sustain and grow their businesses. The monarch further disclosed that consideration had also been given to elderly men and women in the community, particularly those who may no longer have the strength to engage in strenuous activities or travel long distances in search of basic necessities. “I have also thought about how the old men and women can benefit from this initiative in Okpella. So therefore, through this initiative, we have come to the conclusion that Okpella will no longer pay light bills starting from now,” he declared. The announcement of free electricity, alongside the proposed monthly financial support for small businesses, has attracted considerable attention on social media, with the video generating reactions from residents and other viewers. The initiative, as outlined by the monarch, places economic empowerment and social welfare at the centre of his development agenda for the community. For small-scale business owners, regular financial support could provide an opportunity to improve their operations, replenish stock, meet essential business expenses and explore ways of expanding their enterprises. Similarly, the proposed electricity intervention could offer relief to households and businesses by reducing the burden of electricity bills, although details regarding its implementation, coverage and commencement are yet to be provided in the publicly circulated video. King Sado has been widely praised by the people for what they described as efforts to accelerate development in Okpella since ascending the throne. Within his first year, the monarch has been associated with efforts to improve basic amenities and infrastructure in the community, including road construction projects undertaken through the palace initiative. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/30/o.title_zh: 奥克佩拉君主公布对小企业主的支持计划，并为老年人提供免费用电
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/30/o.body_zh: 埃多州奥克佩拉的奥库奥克佩拉格贝王、迈克尔·奥洛伦费米·萨多国王宣布了一项计划，旨在每月为社区内的小企业主提供经济支持，以刺激地方经济活动、改善生计并促进基层发展。这位君主在社交媒体上流传的一段视频中透露了这项计划，并表示，该计划旨在帮助小企业发展壮大，同时向可能难以满足日常需求的年长居民提供支持。据他介绍，这项干预措施是改善居民福祉、为奥克佩拉营造有利于经济活动蓬勃发展的环境这一更大努力的一部分。在这段广泛传播的视频中，这位传统统治者解释说，拟议中的计划将定期为小规模经营者提供经济援助，帮助他们维持并发展业务。国王进一步透露，该计划也考虑了社区内的老年男女，尤其是那些可能已无力从事繁重活动或长途跋涉寻找基本生活必需品的人。他宣称：“我也考虑过奥克佩拉的老人和妇女如何从这项计划中受益。因此，通过这项计划，我们得出结论，从现在起，奥克佩拉居民将不再缴纳电费。”免费用电的宣布以及拟议中的小企业月度经济支持，在社交媒体上引起了广泛关注，视频收到了居民和其他观众的反应。按照国王的阐述，这项计划将经济赋权和社会福利置于其社区发展议程的核心。对于小规模企业主而言，定期的经济支持可以带来改善经营、补充库存、支付必要经营开支以及探索扩大企业规模途径的机会。同样，拟议中的电力干预措施可以通过减轻家庭和企业的电费负担来缓解压力，尽管公开发布的视频尚未提供有关其实施、覆盖范围和启动时间的细节。萨多国王即位以来为加快奥克佩拉发展所作的努力，赢得了民众的广泛赞誉。在任第一年内，这位君主与改善社区基本设施和基础设施的各项努力联系在一起，其中包括通过宫殿倡议开展的道路建设项目。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创刊，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕溪路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都 Territory以及世界各地设有办公室。作为尼日利亚最权威的新闻媒体，该报在全平台服务政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶级，同时充当抱负者和千禧一代探索新思想、文化与技术的交汇点。这家报纸秉持公共信托精神，致力于追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育和社区，以及人与社会的交汇点。您可以发送邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

The Governor made the declaration on Thursday when he received members of the Faleke Political Vanguard, a youth support organisation with representation across the 21 Local Government Areas of Kogi State, during a courtesy visit to the Government House, Lokoja.
https://leadership.ng/ododo-affirms-fale.summary_zh: 科吉州州长Alhaji Ahmed Usman Ododo重申了他与尼日利亚众议院伊凯贾联邦选区代表Hon.之间的政治关系。州长于周四接待来自Faleke Political Vanguard的成员时作出这一表态。该组织是一个青年支持组织，在科吉州下辖的21个地方政府区域均设有代表。州长府位于洛科贾。
https://leadership.ng/ododo-affirms-fale.body: Governor of Kogi State, Alhaji Ahmed Usman Ododo, has reaffirmed his political relationship with the Member representing Ikeja Federal Constituency in the House of Representatives, Hon. James Abiodun Faleke, declaring that there is no disagreement between them. The Governor made the declaration on Thursday when he received members of the Faleke Political Vanguard, a youth support organisation with representation across the 21 Local Government Areas of Kogi State, during a courtesy visit to the Government House, Lokoja. According to a statement by the Coordinator of the Faleke Political Vanguard, Alamoh Kehinde Samuel, Ododo explained that his inability to meet with the group regularly was not an indication of neglect or disagreement but rather a consequence of his demanding responsibilities as the Chief Executive of the state. According to the Governor, Faleke had specifically directed the group to support his administration, a responsibility he said he had willingly embraced. “I want people to know that we are together; we don’t have differences. He is my leader and he is my partner. I have been saying it, and I owe nobody any apology,” the Governor declared. He also recalled the support he received from Faleke during his legal challenges, describing their relationship as one built on mutual understanding, loyalty and shared political interests. Beyond political affiliations, Ododo used the occasion to reiterate his administration’s commitment to inclusive governance, particularly the empowerment of youths and women. The Governor described himself as a product of collective support, insisting that his position should not make him feel superior to other stakeholders. “I am not better than anybody. I have no voice, I have no power without your support. But with your support, we are willing to defend the interests of our youths and women,” he said. Reflecting on the state’s political history, Ododo cautioned against using young people as instruments of violence and division, recalling past experiences in which political interests allegedly fuelled hostility among communities and supporters. Earlier, the Coordinator of the Faleke Political Vanguard, Alamoh Kehinde Samuel, said the organisation comprised carefully selected youth leaders and supporters drawn from the 21 local government areas, many of whom were followers of the late former Governor Abubakar Audu and Hon. James Abiodun Faleke. He expressed appreciation to Governor Ododo for his support for the organisation and its members, describing the administration’s attention to security, youth development and inclusive governance as key reasons for their continued engagement. Kehinde also highlighted some of the administration’s interventions in healthcare, education, infrastructure, workers’ welfare and investment promotion. He specifically cited the construction and renovation of 88 primary healthcare centres, the establishment of a psychiatric centre at the Prince Abubakar Audu University Teaching Hospital, educational support for students, improved payment of salaries and pensions, the expansion of the state health insurance scheme and ongoing road projects. He disclosed that the organisation had established a coordination structure across the state’s 21 local government areas and 239 wards, with a claimed membership strength of 100 persons per ward, bringing its projected membership to 23,900. He added that the organisation planned to hold inaugurations at the zonal, local government and ward levels to strengthen its grassroots structure. Kehinde said the group’s political mission included mobilising support for Governor Ododo and President Bola Ahmed Tinubu ahead of the next electoral cycle. Also speaking, the Kogi State Chairman of the Special Advisers’ Forum, Hon. Bode Adeyemi, commended the organisation for its growing mobilisation capacity, recalling that about 400 of its members had previously participated in an engagement with his team. He described the group’s participation in a solidarity walk organised in support of President Tinubu as a significant demonstration of youth mobilisation, adding that its recent activities had shown its commitment to the political objectives of the administration. Adeyemi noted that the organisation’s expanding membership across the 239 wards underscored the need for an inclusive structure capable of accommodating young people from different backgrounds. https://leadership.ng/ododo-affirms-fale.body_zh: 科吉州州长阿尔哈吉·艾哈迈德·乌斯曼·奥多罗重申了他与众议院伊凯贾联邦选区议员詹姆斯·阿比奥敦·法莱克的政治关系，称双方之间不存在分歧。州长于周四接待法莱克政治先驱组织成员时作出上述表态。该组织是一个青年支持组织，在科吉州21个地方政府辖区均设有代表，此次到访政府大楼洛科贾进行礼节性拜访。法莱克政治先驱组织协调员阿拉莫·凯欣德·萨缪尔在一份声明中表示，奥多罗解释道，他无法定期与该组织会面，并非因为忽视或存在分歧，而是由于作为州行政长官肩负繁重职责。州长表示，法莱克曾特别指示该组织支持其政府，他欣然承担了这一责任。州长宣称：“我希望让大家知道，我们站在一起，彼此没有分歧。他是我的领导，也是我的伙伴。我一直这样说，不必向任何人道歉。”他还回顾了自己在法律诉讼期间得到法莱克支持的经历，称双方关系建立在相互理解、忠诚和共同政治利益之上。除政治立场外，奥多罗还借此重申其政府推动包容性治理的决心，尤其致力于赋权青年和女性。州长称自己是集体支持的成果，强调其职位不应使自己觉得高人一等。他说：“我并不比任何人更好。没有你们的支持，我没有话语权，也没有权力。但有了你们的支持，我们愿意捍卫青年和女性的利益。”回顾科吉州的政治历史，奥多罗告诫不要把年轻人当作暴力和分裂的工具，并提及过去的经历，其中政治利益据称煽动了各社区及其支持者之间的敌意。早些时候，法莱克政治先驱组织协调员阿拉莫·凯欣德·萨缪尔表示，该组织由从21个地方政府辖区精选的青年领袖和支持者组成，其中许多人是已故前州长阿布巴卡尔·奥杜和詹姆斯·阿比奥敦·法莱克阁下的追随者。他感谢奥多罗州长对该组织及其成员的支持，并称政府重视安全、青年发展和包容性治理，是他们继续与政府互动的关键原因。凯欣德还介绍了政府在医疗、教育、基础设施、劳动者福利和促进投资方面采取的一些措施。他具体提到新建和翻修了88所基层医疗中心，在阿布巴卡尔·奥杜王子大学教学医院设立精神卫生中心，为学生提供教育支持，改善工资和养老金支付，扩大州医疗保险计划，以及正在推进的道路项目。他透露，该组织已在全州21个地方政府辖区和239个行政分区建立了协调架构，声称每个分区拥有100名成员，预计总成员数达到23,900人。他补充说，该组织计划在分区、地方政府辖区和行政分区三级举行成立仪式，以加强基层组织建设。凯欣德称，该组织的政治使命包括在下一轮选举周期前动员支持奥多罗州长和博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努武总统。科吉州特别顾问论坛主席博德·阿德耶米阁下也在会上发言。他赞扬该组织不断增强的动员能力，并回顾约有400名成员此前曾与其团队举行会面。他称，该组织参加了为支持蒂努武总统而举行的声援游行，这是动员青年的重要体现，并补充说，该组织近期的活动表明其致力于实现政府的政治目标。阿德耶米指出，该组织在239个行政分区的成员数量不断增加，这凸显出建立包容性架构、接纳不同背景青年的必要性。他对该组织的领导力和组织能力表示有信心，敦促成员继续专注于目标。我们掌握先机。获取实时报道、独家内幕和独到视角，直接送达您的手机。拒绝陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS，通过WhatsApp获取全天候最新动态 →

https://www.myjoyonline.com/microcredit-.body: The National Board Chairperson of the Micro Credit Association Ghana, Benjamin Turkson Junior, has attributed loan defaults in parts of the microcredit sector to weak risk management systems among some lending institutions. He has urged financial institutions to strengthen their assessment of prospective borrowers and establish effective mechanisms to evaluate their creditworthiness before approving loans. Speaking in an interview at the Association’s Annual General Meeting in Ho, Mr Turkson argued that lenders must take greater responsibility for ensuring that loans are advanced to customers with the capacity and willingness to repay. “I have always personally developed a philosophy where I say we don’t have bad borrowers, but we have bad lenders,” he said. He maintained that a sound risk management framework would help financial institutions identify reliable borrowers and reduce the incidence of loan defaults. “If your risk management framework is very solid, definitely you are going to get good clients to lend to them,” he said. Despite his criticism of lending practices, Mr Turkson acknowledged that some borrowers deliberately fail to meet their repayment obligations. He stressed that lenders and borrowers depend on each other, urging customers to honour their commitments to ensure the sustainability of financial institutions. “We are an ecosystem where we need each other to survive. We need the customers. The customers also need us,” he said. He explained that loan repayments enable financial institutions to maintain their operations, expand their services and continue providing credit to businesses and individuals. Mr Turkson also called on lending institutions to make greater use of credit reference bureaus licensed by the Bank of Ghana to assess the borrowing histories of prospective customers. He said the bureaus maintain records that can help lenders identify applicants with previous loan defaults before approving new credit facilities. He warned that borrowers who fail to repay their loans risk damaging their credit records and may find it difficult to access credit from other financial institutions. “If you are planning to take a loan and not pay, then know that your next facility you are not going to get it because your records will be out there,” he cautioned. He further encouraged all lending institutions to submit relevant borrower information to the credit reference bureaus to strengthen the system and improve access to reliable credit information. The Micro Credit Association Ghana chairperson also urged lenders to exercise patience when customers experience repayment difficulties and pursue outstanding debts through established legal procedures. He said a lawful approach to loan recovery would help protect the interests of both financial institutions and borrowers. “I think we follow through the legal process to recover our loan, and that will bring peace to both the institution and the customers,” he said. https://www.myjoyonline.com/microcredit-.title_zh: 小额信贷协会主席将贷款违约归咎于贷款机构风险评估薄弱
https://www.myjoyonline.com/microcredit-.body_zh: 加纳小额信贷协会全国理事会主席Benjamin Turkson Junior将微信贷部分领域的贷款违约归咎于一些贷款机构薄弱的风险管理体系。他敦促金融机构加强对待借款人资质的评估，并在批准贷款前建立有效机制，评估其信用状况。Turkson先生在霍城举行的协会年度大会上接受采访时认为，贷款机构必须承担更大责任，确保向有能力且愿意偿还贷款的客户放贷。他说：“我始终秉持一种理念，即我们没有坏借款人，但有坏贷款机构。”他坚称，稳健的风险管理框架将帮助金融机构识别可靠的借款人，并降低贷款违约的发生率。他说：“如果你的风险管理框架非常完善，那么毫无疑问，你会获得优质客户，并向他们放贷。”尽管批评贷款做法，Turkson先生也承认，一些借款人会故意不履行还款义务。他强调，贷款机构与借款人相互依存，敦促客户履行承诺，以保障金融机构的可持续经营。他说：“我们是一个相互依存的生态系统，需要彼此扶持才能生存。我们需要客户，客户也需要我们。”他解释道，贷款回款使金融机构得以维持运营、拓展服务，并继续向企业和个人提供信贷。Turkson先生还呼吁贷款机构更多利用加纳银行许可的信用征信机构，评估潜在客户的借款历史。他说，这些机构保存的记录可以帮助贷款机构在批准新的信贷额度前，识别以往有贷款违约记录的申请人。他警告，未偿还贷款的借款人可能损害自己的信用记录，日后可能难以从其他金融机构获得信贷。他提醒：“如果你计划借款却不偿还，那么要知道，你的下一笔贷款就无法获得，因为你的记录会留在那里。”他还鼓励所有贷款机构向信用征信机构提交相关借款人信息，以加强该体系并改善可靠信用信息的获取。加纳小额信贷协会主席还敦促贷款机构在客户遇到还款困难时保持耐心，并通过既定法律程序追讨未偿债务。他说，采用合法方式追收贷款，将有助于保护贷款机构和借款人双方的利益。他说：“我认为，我们应当依法完成追讨贷款的程序，这会给机构和客户双方带来安定。”Turkson先生呼吁立法者理解微信贷行业面临的挑战……

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.title: Friday Sermon: Nigeria is bigger and greater than any politician!, By Murtadha Gusau
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary: The enduring reality is that Nigeria—as a land, a collective soul, and a divine trust and amanah—is immeasurably bigger, greater, and more permanent than any politician, leader, or transient power broker. And know that, our great country Nigeria is an enduring trust and amanah from Allah, a vast land of millions of souls, and an estate far greater than the fleeting shadow of any single politician. Nigeria is bigger than any politician’s ambition.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary_zh: 一个不容忽视的现实是：尼日利亚——作为一片土地、一个集体灵魂，以及一份神圣的信托与信仰托付（amanah）——其体量、格局和恒久性都不可衡量地超越任何政治家、领袖或短暂掌权的权力掮客。请记住，我们伟大的国家尼日利亚是安拉所托付的恒久信托与信仰托付（amanah），是数百万灵魂的辽阔土地，也是一份远胜任何单一政治家转瞬即逝阴影的遗产。尼日利亚比任何政治家的野心都更加宏大。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body: All praise belongs to Allah, the Owner of absolute Dominion. He gives power to whom He wills, and He strips power from whom He wills. He exalts whom He wills, and He abases whom He wills. In His Hand is all good. Dear servants of Allah! Please, look at the soil beneath your feet. This rich, resilient Nigerian earth has outlived empires, colonial masters, military regimes, and democratic administrations. Respected brothers and sisters! The enduring reality is that Nigeria—as a land, a collective soul, and a divine trust and amanah—is immeasurably bigger, greater, and more permanent than any politician, leader, or transient power broker. While leaders come and go like shifting shadows, the land and its people remain accountable to a higher cosmic order. Sincerely speaking, politicians are merely brief tenants on a land owned entirely by the Creator, Allah. They occupy offices for a few short years, but the consequences of their stewardship — and the collective destiny of over 200 million souls — endure long after they are gone. When a politician walks the corridors of power, surrounded by sirens, wealth, and praise, psychology tells us they often fall into the trap of the “hubris syndrome.” They begin to believe that the nation cannot survive without them. But the religion of Islam shatters this illusion through ascetic teachings. Lets ask ourselves, where is Pharaoh today? Where is Qarun? Where are the powerful monarchs of yesterday? They entered the earth with nothing but a shroud, leaving behind a legacy that is either cursed or blessed. Nigeria will not fall because a politician fails; Nigeria belongs to Allah, and its people are its true heartbeat. Dear Muslim believers! We must shift our mindset from political dependency to spiritual agency. We have elevated flawed, mortal men to the status of national architects, forgetting that true change begins within our own psychological and spiritual architecture. We complain about corruption, yet we participate in micro-corruption in our marketplaces, in our schools, and in our offices. A nation is simply a mirror of its collective souls. If we want a greater Nigeria, we must realise that our duty to this land is a religious obligation. “Each of you is a shepherd, and each of you is responsible for his flock.” [Sahih Al-Bukhari] Fellow brothers and sisters! Nigeria’s rivers, forests, mineral wealth, and brilliant minds are blessings we will be questioned about on the Day of Judgment. Some politicians use ethnic and religious fault lines to divide us for temporary electoral gains. Wallahi, to succumb to this is a sign of spiritual disease. Our strength does not come from Aso Rock Villa; it comes from the sweat of the market woman in Kano, the brilliance of the tech youth in Lagos, the endurance of the farmer in Benue, Zamfara, Kogi etc, and the prayers of the righteous people across this land. Imagine a billionaire politician who held the fate of millions in his hands. He signed budgets, decided who ate and who starved, and walked with an army of guards. Now, fast forward a few decades. He lies in a quiet, dark grave in a local cemetery. The sirens are gone. The wealth is distributed. The political parties have moved on to new faces. Above his grave, the ordinary citizens of Nigeria—the ones he ignored—continue to walk, to build, to live, and to survive. Here who was bigger? The man who thought he owned the country, or the country that swallowed him back into its soil? Nigeria is an idea etched into the divine decree. It is a tapestry of over 250 ethnicities woven together by Allah’s wisdom. Allah Almighty says: Fellow servants of Allah! To move from emotional reflection to real-world activation, every Nigerian citizen must adopt three spiritual-psychological shifts as follows: Stop treating elected officials as masters. In Islam, the leader is the servant of the people, The Khadimul-Ummah. Hold them accountable, but never tie your hope, your livelihood, or your patriotism to their names. Despair is a sin. The moment you say “Nigeria can never change,” you have doubted Allah’s power to transform hearts. Keep building, keep educating, and keep doing good in your immediate circle. On the day of elections or civic duties, sell not your soul for a bag of rice, sphagetti or petty cash. Wallahi, that momentary transaction paralyses the future of your children. Act as a guardian of the amanah. O Nigerians! Lift your head high. Know that, governments will rise and fall. Policies will change. Budgets will be spent. But your faith, your resilience, your unity, and your devotion to the Almighty Allah are unshakeable. Do not let transient men ruin a permanent blessing. Build your homes on righteousness, raise your children with integrity, and remember that this giant of Africa is held up by the hands of the Almighty Allah, not the whims of politicians. Dear brothers and sisters! Fear Allah, and know that power belongs solely to Al-Malik, The True Sovereign. And know that, our great country Nigeria is an enduring trust and amanah from Allah, a vast land of millions of souls, and an estate far greater than the fleeting shadow of any single politician. We look at our nation today and see a people consumed by the names of men. We anchor our hopes, our anger, and our entire futures to individual politicians—mortals who breathe the same air we breathe, who sleep, who err, and who will inevitably return to the dust. Respected brothers and sisters! Politicians are but brief actors on a stage. They are transient. They occupy an office for four years, eight years, or a lifetime, and then they disappear into the pages of history. But Nigeria—with its over 200 million souls, its innocent children, its hardworking mothers, its resilient youth, and its spiritual heritage—is a sacred trust. Therefore, do not trade your brotherhood, your peace, or your eternal soul for the temporary ambitions of a mortal leader. When politicians stoke the fires of division, remember that they are small, but the collective destiny of this Ummah and this nation under Allah is immense. Nigeria is bigger than any politician’s ambition. My dear brothers and sisters! Look at the reality of this world through the lens of Zuhd and asceticism. The Prophet Muhammad (Peace be upon him) said: “What have I to do with this world? The relation between me and this world is like a traveler who sits under the shade of a tree and then walks away and leaves it.” [Tirmidhi] If this entire world is just a temporary shade, what then is the seat of a governor, a senator, a president, a house of representative member, a state assembly member, a local government chairman or a councillor? It is a shadow within a shadow. Please, why do we allow our hearts to be broken by their failures? Why do we allow our communities to be fractured by their campaigns? Why do we bleed for men who do not know our names? Fellow Nigerians! Remember, a politician is just one person. But Nigeria is a tapestry of millions of prayers rising to the heavens every single night. Please, do not elevate a servant to the status of a master. Your loyalty belongs to Allah, and your duty of care belongs to your neighbours, your community, and your country. There is a profound lesson from our righteous predecessors, as-Salafus Salih. A powerful leader once rode through his kingdom in grand pomp, surrounded by bodyguards, demanding total subservience. He passed by a wise, ascetic Islamic scholar sitting in the dirt. The leader demanded: “Yes. I know your beginning and your end. Your beginning was a dropped drop of fluid, and your end will be a decaying corpse in the earth. And between the two, you are merely carrying waste.” Let this be our reminder when we look at the political landscape of Nigeria. No matter how loud a politician’s convoy, no matter how vast their wealth, they will face the Grave alone. The land they rule over will outlive them. The people they govern will survive them. The nation is the canvas; the politician is merely a passing drop of ink. Awaken, Nigeria citizens and Muslim believers! Stop waiting for a political messiah to save Nigeria. The salvation of our nation lies in the reformation of our own hearts, our honesty in our marketplaces, our kindness to our neighbours, and our collective turning back to Allah Almighty. Wallahi, a politician cannot fix a home where character has decayed. A politician cannot bring peace to a community that has abandoned justice. Nigeria will stand long after the current political elite are forgotten names in a textbook. Protect the nation, serve the people, and fear none but Allah Subhanahu wa Ta’ala! Dear servants of Allah! When the Prophet Muhammad (Peace be upon him) was forced to leave his birthplace, Makkah, he stood at the edge of the city, looked back with tears in his eyes, and declared: “How sweet you are as a land, and how dear you are to me! If my people had not driven me out from you, I would not have dwelt anywhere else.” [Tirmidhi] This is not mere sentimentality; it is a divine template. The spiritual heart does not exist in a vacuum. It is rooted in the soil that sustains it. To love Nigeria, to prioritise its survival, and to labour for its resurrection is a direct expression of the values taught by Islam. You cannot claim to love the Creator if you actively despise or destroy the cradle of His creation in which He placed you. Our collective suffering—the economic hardship, the insecurity, the fracturing of social trust—is a material reflection of a deeper spiritual drought. The Noble Qur’an provides an unyielding psychological law. Allah Almighty says: We have fallen into the trap of looking outward for saviours while harbouring the very diseases that collapse nations from within: greed, selfishness, mutual distrust, apathy, and the pursuit of individual survival at the expense of the collective. A nation is nothing more than the sum of its individual souls. If we are corrupt in our small daily transactions, our leadership will inevitably reflect that collective deficit. The reform of Nigeria does not begin at the Eagle Square in Abuja; it begins in the quiet chambers of your own conscience. Do not forget! Nigeria is a trust and amanah from Allah. Every resource, every citizen, and every public space is an amanah. Betraying the nation through bribery and corruption, through cutting corners, through nepotism or tribalism is a direct betrayal of this divine trust. Stop asking what Nigeria can do for you when the soil is parched. Ask what you are pouring into the ground. And please, before you point fingers at the leadership, audit your own integrity in your workplace, in your home, and in your community. Also despair is a spiritual failure. To claim Nigeria is beyond redemption is to limit the mercy and power of Allah Almighty. We must actively cultivate hope as a form of resistance against chaos. There is a profound lesson in the classical histories of the righteous predecessors, The Salafus-Salih. A companion once found an old sage painstakingly repairing a community wall in a city plagued by civil strife, insecurity, corruption, and failing governance. The sage did not stop his work. He wiped the sweat from his brow and replied: “When the angels look down upon this city, let them find at least one soul building while everyone else is tearing down. I do not fix this wall because the city deserves it; I fix it because the Lord of this city demands righteousness from me, regardless of what the crowds choose to do.” Dear brothers and sisters! Nigeria will not be saved by systemic overhauls alone. It will be saved when its citizens experience a psychological and spiritual awakening. It requires an ascetic detachment from immediate, selfish gains in exchange for the lasting legacy of a stable society. Dear brothers and sisters! Let this be your reminder: You were placed in Nigeria by divine decree, not by accident.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.title_zh: 周五讲道：尼日利亚比任何政治人物所想象的都更伟大！——Murtadha Gusau
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body_zh: 一切赞颂都归于安拉——绝对统治的主宰。祂赋予祂所意欲者权力，也剥夺祂所意欲者的权力。祂抬高祂所意欲者，也贬低祂所意欲者。一切美善都在祂手中。亲爱的安拉的仆人们！请看看你们脚下的土地。这片肥沃而富有韧性的尼日利亚大地，历经帝国、殖民统治者、军事政权和民主政府而依然长存。尊敬的弟兄姊妹们！一个不容忽视的现实是，尼日利亚——作为一片土地、一个集体灵魂，以及一项神圣的托付与阿玛纳——比任何政治人物、领袖或权势一时的掮客都无可比拟地更宏大、更伟大，也更恒久。领袖如流动的影子般来来去去，但这片土地及其人民仍须对更高的宇宙秩序负责。坦率地说，政治人物不过是这片完全属于造物主安拉的土地上的短期租客。他们在位数年，但他们的施政后果——以及2亿多灵魂的共同命运——在他们离去之后仍会长久延续。当政治人物行走在权力的走廊里，四周警笛鸣响、财富相伴、赞颂相随时，心理学告诉我们，他们往往会陷入“傲慢综合征”的陷阱。他们开始相信，国家没有他们就无法存续。然而，伊斯兰教通过克己的教诲粉碎了这种幻觉。让我们问问自己，法老如今在哪里？卡伦如今在哪里？昔日那些强大的君主如今又在哪里？他们进入尘世时除了一幅裹尸布一无所有，留下的传承要么受到诅咒，要么蒙受祝福。尼日利亚不会因为某个政治人物失败而倒下；尼日利亚属于安拉，其人民才是它真正跳动的心脏。亲爱的穆斯林信众！，我们必须把心态从政治依赖转向精神自主。我们把有缺陷、终有一死的凡提升为国家Architects，却忘记了真正的改变始于我们自身的心理与精神结构。我们抱怨腐败，却又在市场、学校和办公室里参与微腐败。一个国家不过是其集体灵魂的镜像。如果我们想要一个更伟大的尼日利亚，就必须认识到，我们对这片土地的责任是一项宗教义务。《 صحيح البخاري》记载：“你们每个人都是牧人，每个人都应对自己的羊群负责。”尊敬的弟兄姊妹们！尼日利亚的河流、森林、矿产财富和卓越头脑都是Blessings，在审判日，我们将因这些而受到追问。有些政治人物利用族群和宗教断层来分裂我们，以换取一时的选举利益。Wallahi，向这种做法屈从是精神疾病的迹象。我们的力量并不来自Aso Rock Villa；它来自卡诺女商贩的汗水、拉各斯科技青年的才华、本贝努、赞法拉、科吉等地农民的坚韧，以及这片土地上所有正义之人的祈祷。试想一位亿万富翁政治人物，曾把数百万人的命运握在手中。他签署预算，决定谁能吃饱、谁会挨饿，身边还有一队卫兵。如今，把时间快进几十年。他躺在当地一座墓园里安静而阴暗的坟墓中。警笛声消失了，财富被分配了，政党已经转向了新的面孔。在他的坟墓上方，尼日利亚的普通百姓——那些被他无视的人——仍继续行走、建设、生活和生存。在这里，谁更伟大？是那个以为国家属于自己的人，还是最终将他重新吞入泥土的国家？尼日利亚是镌刻在神圣法令中的理念，是由安拉的智慧将250多个族群编织而成的锦锦。万能的安拉说：亲爱的安拉的仆人们！要从情感反思走向现实行动，每一位尼日利亚公民都必须在精神与心理上作出以下三种转变：第一，不要再把民选官员当作主人。在伊斯兰教中，领袖是人民的仆人，即Khadimul-Ummah。要监督他们，但绝不要把自己的希望、生计或爱国心系在他们的名字上。绝望是一种罪。一旦你说“尼日利亚永远不会改变”，你就质疑了安拉改变人心的能力。继续建设，继续教育，也继续在你身边的人中行善。在选举日或履行公民义务时，不要为一袋米、一份意大利面或一点零用钱出卖自己的灵魂。Wallahi，这一瞬间的交易会使你子女的未来陷入瘫痪。要成为这项阿玛纳的守护者。尼日利亚人啊！抬起头来。要知道，政府会兴衰更替，政策会发生变化，预算会被花掉。但你们的信仰、坚韧、团结以及对万能安拉的虔诚坚不可摧。不要让那些转瞬即逝的人毁掉一份恒久的祝福。以正义建设家园，以正直养育孩子，并记住，这头非洲巨兽是由万能安拉的双手托起的，而不是由政治人物的任性摆布。尊敬的弟兄姊妹们！敬畏安拉，并要知道，权力只属于Al-Malik，真正的至高主宰。还要知道，我们伟大的国家尼日利亚是来自安拉的恒久托付与阿玛纳，是一片承载数百万灵魂的辽阔土地，也是一项远远超越任何单一政治人物短暂阴影的产业。今天，我们审视自己的国家，看到的是一群被人的名字吞噬的民众。我们把自己的希望、愤怒和全部未来都系在个别政治人物身上——他们不过是与我们呼吸同样空气的凡人，也会睡觉、犯错，并终将回归尘土。尊敬的弟兄姊妹们！政治人物不过是舞台上的短暂时演员，他们是暂时的，可能占据一个职位4年、8年或一生，随后便消失于历史书页之中。但尼日利亚——拥有2亿多灵魂、无辜的孩子、勤劳的母亲、坚韧的青年和精神传承——是一项神圣的托付。因此，不要为一个凡人领袖暂时的野心，牺牲自己的兄弟情谊、和平或永恒的灵魂。当政治人物煽动分裂之火时，要记住他们十分渺小，而这个乌玛共同体和这个国家在安拉之下的共同命运却无比宏大。尼日利亚比任何政治人物的野心都更伟大。亲爱的弟兄姊妹们！请通过Zuhd和克己的视角审视这个世界的现实。先知穆罕默德（愿主赐他平安）说：“我与这个世界有什么关系？我与这个世界的关系，就像一个旅人在树下避阴，随后起身离去，把树留在身后。”《提尔米济》记载。如果整个世界不过是一片暂时的树荫，那么州长、参议员、总统、众议员、州议会议员、地方政府主席或市政委员的职位又算什么呢？不过是影中之影。为什么我们要让自己的心因他们的失败而破碎？为什么要让自己的社区因他们的竞选活动而分裂？为什么要为那些根本不认识我们的人流血？亲爱的尼日利亚人！记住，政治人物只是一个人。但尼日利亚是一幅由每夜升向天穹的数百万祈祷编织而成的锦绣。请不要再把一个仆人抬高到主人的地位。你的忠诚属于安拉，你关怀他人的责任则属于你的邻人、社区和国家。我们敬虔的前辈——as-Salafus Salih——留下了一堂深刻的课。一位强大的领袖曾在卫队簇拥下，以盛大仪仗穿过自己的王国，要求所有人完全服从。他路过一位坐在地上的智慧伊斯兰学者。那位领袖 命令道：“是的。我知道你的开始与结局。你的开始是一滴液体，你的结局将是土地中一具腐烂的尸体。在这二者之间，你不过是在搬运排泄物。”当我们审视尼日利亚的政治版图时，让这成为我们的提醒。无论政治人物的车队多么喧闹，无论他们的财富多么庞大，他们都将独自面对坟墓。他们统治的土地会比他们长久，他们治理的人民会比他们存续。国家是画布，政治人物不过是掠过画布的一滴墨。尼日利亚公民和穆斯林信众们，觉醒吧！不要再等待政治救世主来拯救尼日利亚。我们国家的拯救，在于我们内心的改革、市场上的诚实、对邻人的善意，以及集体转回万能的安拉。Wallahi，政治人物无法修复一个人品已经腐坏的家庭。政治人物无法为一个已经抛弃正义的社区带来和平。在当前政治精英成为教科书里被人遗忘的名字之后很久，尼日利亚依然会屹立。守护国家、服务人民，除安拉之外不畏惧任何人！亲爱的安拉的仆人们！当先知穆罕默德（愿主赐他平安）被迫离开自己的出生地麦加时，他站在城市边缘，含泪回望，declares：“你作为一片土地是多么美好，你对我来说又是多么珍贵！如果不是我的人把我从你那里驱逐出去，我就不会在任何别处居住。”《提尔米济》记载。这不只是多愁善感；这是一幅神圣的范本。精神之心并非存在于真空中。它植根于养育它的土壤。热爱尼日利亚、优先考虑其生存并为它的复兴而劳作，正是伊斯兰教所教导价值观的直接体现。如果他放在你其中的造物摇篮遭到你主动鄙弃或破坏，你就不可能声称自己热爱造物主。我们collective的苦难——经济困境、不安全局势和社会信任的破裂——是更深层精神干旱的物质反映。高贵的《古兰经》提供了一条不可动摇的心理法则。万能的安拉说：我们已经落入这样的陷阱：向外寻找救世主，同时自身却滋生了那些从内部摧毁国家的疾病：贪婪、自私、互不信任、冷漠，以及以牺牲集体为代价追求个人生存。一个国家无非是其所有个人灵魂的总和。如果我们日常的小额交易充满腐败，我们的领导层必然也会反映这种集体亏损。尼日利亚的改革不是从阿布贾的Eagle Square开始，而是从你自身良知的静室开始。不要忘记！尼日利亚是来自安拉的托付与阿玛纳。每一种资源、每一位公民、每一处公共空间都是一项阿玛纳。通过受贿和腐败，通过偷工减料、裙带关系或部族主义来背叛国家，就是对这项神圣托付的直接背叛。当土地干裂时，不要再问尼日利亚能为你做什么，要问问你正在向土地浇灌什么。也请在指责领导层之前，审视你在工作岗位、家庭和社区中的操守是否清白。绝望同样是一种精神失败。声称尼日利亚已无可救药，就是限制万能安拉的慈悲与力量。我们必须主动培养希望，把它作为抵抗混乱的一种方式。我们敬虔的前辈The Salafus-Salih的经典历史中，也有一堂深刻的课。一位圣Companion曾看见一位年迈智者在一座饱受内战、不安全、腐败和治理失灵困扰的城市里，辛苦修补社区围墙。智者没有停下工作。他擦去额头上的汗水，回答说：“当天使俯视这座城市时，哪怕让他们看到有一个人在建设，而其他所有人都在拆毁，也好。我修补这堵墙，不是因为这座城市值得我这样做；我修补它，是因为这座城市的主要求我保持正义，无论人群选择做什么。”尊敬的弟兄姊妹们！尼日利亚不会仅靠全面改革体制得到拯救。只有当其公民经历一场心理与精神觉醒时，它才能得到拯救。这要求人们摆脱眼前、自私的收益，以换取稳定社会长久流传的遗产。尊敬的弟兄姊妹们！请以此提醒自己：你们被安放在尼日利亚，是出于神圣法令，而非偶然。

https://www.thehindu.com/business/india-.summary: The Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation and the office of Drugs Controller Assam ordered the shutdown on August 20 after a joint federal-state inspection of the facility identified lapses in the system meant to ensure product quality and safety, following Sun Pharma’s move in July to voluntarily recall about 11 eye-care brands.
https://www.thehindu.com/business/india-.summary_zh: 中央药品标准管制组织和阿萨姆邦药品管制专员办公室在联邦与邦联合检查该设施后，于8月20日下令关停该设施；检查发现，旨在确保产品质量和安全的体系存在疏漏。此前，Sun Pharma于7月主动召回了约11个眼科护理品牌。
https://www.thehindu.com/business/india-.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription Indian drug regulators ordered Sun Pharmaceutical Industries to stop manufacturing, selling and distributing ophthalmic products made at its Assam facility after finding failure in its quality management system, documents reviewed by Reuters showed. The Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation and the office of Drugs Controller Assam ordered the shutdown on August 20 after a joint federal-state inspection of the facility identified lapses in the system meant to ensure product quality and safety, following Sun Pharma’s move in July to voluntarily recall about 11 eye-care brands. India’s drug quality standards have come under increased scrutiny at home and overseas in recent years after locally made cough syrups were linked to the deaths of children in India and also in countries including Gambia and Uzbekistan. The regulatory agencies’ move marks an escalation of the action against Sun Pharma, India’s biggest pharmaceutical firm, which will be unable to continue ophthalmic drug production at the Assam factory until it submits a satisfactory compliance report. Sun Pharma said previously the site was expected to become one of its largest manufacturing hubs for sterile products in a business identified as a key global growth driver. The regulator sought more information on the recall of 332 batches of ophthalmic suspension products — liquids used to treat eye conditions — the documents showed. In an internal notice sent to stockists at the time, the company said it was withdrawing the products as a “precautionary measure.” It remains unclear whether all of the recalled products were contaminated. Sun Pharma did not publicly disclose details of the recall. The company has submitted a compliance report in response to the order, which is being reviewed by the regulator, an official familiar with the matter told Reuters on condition of anonymity because they were not authorised to speak to the media. “We voluntarily initiated a temporary cessation of manufacturing activities and informed the regulators,” Sun Pharma said in a statement on Friday (October 30, 2026), adding that remedial measures have been put in place. It did not respond to a request for comment on the recall. The company says on its website it follows a single global quality standard. Some of the recalled products included Lotepred 1% 5ml eye drops, Nepalact OD eye drops, Nepalact-Z, Brinzotim eye drops 5ml and Depopred 2ml. The eye drops are used to treat eye inflammation, infections and chronic eye diseases, according to doctors. It is unclear whether these eye products were exported from India or whether any patients reported any adverse effects. Reuters found that, based on the product packaging, most of the recalled products were manufactured at the Assam state facility in Kokjhar village. Reuters could not independently verify whether the 332 batches cited by regulators were related only to the 11 identified brands in the recall notice or included additional brands. The affected batches could translate into hundreds of thousands of eye-drop bottles, according to industry experts, who declined to be identified because they were not authorised to speak publicly. Ophthalmology contributes about 3% of Sun Pharma’s domestic revenue, according to its 2025-26 annual report. It is also one of its key areas for the U.S. The company reported a drop in second-quarter profit on Friday (October 30) weighed down by a one-time charge related to its acquisition of U.S.-based Organon. The eye product recall coincided with a patient-safety advisory issued in June by the All India Ophthalmological Society (AIOS), an independent body of eye specialists, warning that certain batches of Predmet eye drops appeared to be contaminated. “There were some adverse cases of infections reported in patients who used Predmet and we got sealed bottles investigated and found it was contaminated,” Santosh Honavar, a doctor and secretary of AIOS, told Reuters , adding that Sun Pharma had also recalled those Predmet drops. Sun Pharma did not respond a request for comment on the AIOS advisory. The regulators issued a show-cause notice to Sun Pharma on August 10, citing the quality management system failures, the documents showed. Dissatisfied with the company’s response, the regulators ordered a halt to the manufacturing, sale and distribution of all ophthalmic products from the facility. Indian regulators did not respond to requests for comment. The agency did not issue a public health alert after the recall. It is not the first time Sun Pharma’s sterile manufacturing facilities have faced regulatory scrutiny. https://www.thehindu.com/business/india-.title_zh: 印度因质量问题勒令Sun Pharma停止一家工厂生产眼药
https://www.thehindu.com/business/india-.body_zh: 订阅还可享受 Premium Stories、Editorials、Opinions 等更多内容。印度药品监管机构勒令 Sun Pharmaceutical Industries 停止生产、销售和分销其位于阿萨姆邦工厂生产的眼科产品；路透社审阅的文件显示，监管机构发现其质量管理体系存在缺陷。8月20日，中央药品标准控制组织与阿萨姆邦药品监管专员办公室在联邦与邦联合检查工厂后下令停产。检查发现，旨在确保产品质量和安全的体系存在疏漏；此前，Sun Pharma 于7月主动召回约11个眼护理品牌。近年来，由于印度本土生产的止咳糖浆被指与印度以及冈比亚、乌兹别克斯坦等国的儿童死亡有关，印度药品质量标准在国内外受到更严格审查。监管机构采取的行动标志着针对印度最大制药企业 Sun Pharma 的处置进一步升级。在提交令人满意的合规报告之前，该公司将无法继续在阿萨姆邦工厂生产眼科药品。Sun Pharma 此前表示，该基地有望成为其最大的无菌产品制造枢纽之一，而这项业务被确定为全球关键增长驱动力。文件显示，监管机构要求就召回332批眼用混悬液产品提供更多信息；混悬液是用于治疗眼病的液体。当时，公司在一份发给经销商的内部通知中称，撤回这些产品是出于“预防措施”。目前尚不清楚所有被召回产品是否均受到污染。Sun Pharma 未公开披露此次召回的详细信息。公司已就监管命令提交合规报告；一位知情但因无权对媒体发言而要求匿名的官员告诉路透社，监管机构正在审查该报告。Sun Pharma 在周五（2026年10月30日）发表的声明中表示：“我们主动暂停了生产活动，并告知了监管机构。”公司还称已采取补救措施，但未回应有关召回事件的置评请求。公司表示，其网站上的信息显示，公司遵循统一的全球质量标准。被召回产品包括 Lotepred 1% 5ml 滴眼液、Nepalact OD 滴眼液、Nepalact-Z、Brinzotim 5ml 滴眼液和 Depopred 2ml。医生表示，这些滴眼液用于治疗眼部炎症、感染和慢性眼病。目前尚不清楚这些眼科产品是否从印度出口，也是否有患者报告任何不良反应。路透社根据产品包装发现，大多数被召回产品在位于阿萨姆邦 Kokjhar 村的工厂生产。路透社无法独立核实监管机构提及的332批产品是否仅涉及召回通知中列出的11个品牌，还是还包括其他品牌。行业专家表示，受影响的批次可能相当于数十万瓶滴眼液；这些专家因无权公开发言而拒绝透露姓名。根据 Sun Pharma 2025-26财年年度报告，眼科学业务约占其国内收入的3%，也是其在美国市场的重点领域之一。该公司周五（10月30日）报告第二季度利润下降，原因是收购美国 Organon 产生了一次性费用。眼科产品召回与全印度眼科协会（AIOS）6月发布的一项患者安全通告同期发生。该协会是独立的眼科专家机构，警告称某些批次的 Predmet 滴眼液疑似受到污染。AIOS 秘书、医生 Santosh Honavar 告诉路透社：“有使用 Predmet 的患者报告了一些感染的不良病例。我们对密封瓶进行了检测，发现产品受到污染。”他还表示，Sun Pharma 也召回了这些 Predmet 滴眼液。Sun Pharma 未回应就 AIOS 通告置评的请求。文件显示，监管机构于8月10日向 Sun Pharma 出具说明原因通知，列举其质量管理体系方面的失职。监管机构对公司的回应不满意，遂下令停止生产、销售和分销该工厂的全部眼科产品。印度监管机构未回应置评请求。召回事件后，该机构没有发布公共卫生警报。这并非 Sun Pharma 的无菌生产设施首次受到监管审查。去年，美国食品药品监督管理局在检查员指出其污染控制存在缺陷后，暂停了该公司从古吉拉特邦 Halol 工厂发货。评论必须使用英语，并以完整句子表述。评论不得含有辱骂性或针对个人的内容。请遵守我们的社区评论准则。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果你已经是《The Hindu》的注册用户并已登录，可以继续参与文章互动。如果你没有账户，请注册并登录后发表评论。用户登录自己的账户后，可以访问以前的评论，评论系统为 Vuukle

https://www.euronews.com/2026/10/30/eu-d.body: Share Comments Add Euronews on Google Share Facebook Twitter Flipboard Send Reddit Linkedin Messenger Telegram VK Bluesky Threads Whatsapp The meeting in Atlanta will go ahead as planned, ahead of a G20 leaders’ summit hosted by President Donald Trump at his Miami golf club in December. The United States cancelled a planned group photo of foreign ministers from the world's 20 largest economies (G20) on Friday after several European diplomats objected to being photographed alongside Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and threatened to walk out. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio decided to cancel the photo to avoid further controversy, according to two US officials who spoke on condition of anonymity because of the sensitivity of the matter. Opening the talks, Rubio looked ahead, saying he hoped for “a productive meeting.” “We are in a critical moment — I would call it a moment of choosing, and I would say not just for my country, the United States of America, but frankly, for the world," he said. The cancellation of the traditional group photo highlighted tensions within the G20, as diplomats face difficult negotiations over the war in Ukraine, the US-Israeli war against Iran, US tariffs and disputes in the South China Sea. German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul said “there is no normality with Russia” but “we must exchange the controversies at the table here,” the German news agency dpa reported. He added that “we also must not send falsely optimistic signals.” Even before the dispute over the photo, several G20 countries had raised concerns about Russia's invitation amid intensified attacks on Ukraine. Tensions have also grown after Trump waived new sanctions on Moscow and temporarily restricted logistical and intelligence support for Kyiv, further straining US-Ukraine relations

https://www.euronews.com/2026/10/30/eu-d.body_zh: 分享 评论 在 Google 上添加 Euronews 分享 Facebook Twitter Flipboard 发送 Reddit Linkedin Messenger Telegram VK Bluesky Threads Whatsapp 亚特兰大的会议将按计划举行。此举是在唐纳德·特朗普总统于12月在迈阿密高尔夫俱乐部主持二十国集团领导人峰会之前进行的。美国于周五取消了原定的20个世界最大经济体外国部长合影，即二十国集团部长合影，原因是数名欧洲外交官反对与俄罗斯外长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫同框拍照，并威胁退出。两名美国官员表示，美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥决定取消合影，以避免引发更多争议；由于此事敏感，他们以匿名身份向外界透露。鲁比奥在会议开场时展望称，希望此次会议“富有成果”。他说：“我们正处于一个关键时刻——我会称之为选择的时刻，而且我只想说，这不仅关系到我的国家美利坚合众国，坦白说，也关系到全世界。”取消这项传统合影凸显了二十国集团内部的紧张关系。面对乌克兰战争、美国和以色列对伊朗的战争、美国关税以及南海争端，各国外交官将展开艰难谈判。德国新闻社 DPA 报道称，德国外长约翰·瓦德富尔表示，“与俄罗斯之间不存在正常状态”，但“我们必须在这里的谈判桌上交流争议”。他还说，“我们也不能传递虚假的乐观信号”。甚至在围绕合影的争议发生之前，二十国集团中已有多个国家因俄罗斯获邀参会而表示担忧，此举发生在针对乌克兰的袭击加剧之际。特朗普豁免了对莫斯科的新一轮制裁，并暂时限制向基辅提供后勤和情报支持，此后紧张局势进一步加剧，美乌关系也承受了更大压力。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/ypyc-foundat.body: The Young Professionals and Youth Coalition (YPYC) Foundation has announced its shortlist for the 17th Africa Role Model Awards, with several prominent personalities from Ghana and other African countries nominated for recognition. The winners will be announced at the 17th Transform Summit and Africa Role Model Awards ceremony scheduled for Saturday, October 31, 2026, at the ISSER Conference Hall of the University of Ghana, Legon. Chief of Staff, Dr Julius Debrah, is expected to attend as the Special Guest of Honour. The awards seek to recognise individuals whose contributions have made an impact in areas including traditional leadership, academia, religion, business, media, engineering, politics, education, law, energy and philanthropy. Among those shortlisted are the Ga Mantse, HRM King Tackie Teiko Tsuru II; Central University Vice-Chancellor, Professor Kwesi Dartey-Baah; and General Superintendent of the Assemblies of God, Reverend Dr Stephen Wengam. Others include psychologist, pastor and entrepreneur Lady Rosemond Prempeh of the Ultimate Charismatic Centre; Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Northshore Apparel Ghana Limited, Mohammed Nurideen; and Media General broadcaster Naa Ashorkor Mensah-Doku. Chief Executive Officer of Stratcom Africa and convenor of the Flower and Garden Movement, Esther Cobbah, has also been nominated, alongside retired PwC partner and consultant Michael Asiedu Antwi and University of Ghana School of Engineering senior lecturer, Ing. Dr Peace Amoatey. The list further features Samuel Naamgina, a student at the University of Energy and Natural Resources in Sunyani, and Kenyan educationist and trainer Sonali Thakrar. Other nominees are Marietta Brew Appiah-Oppong, Legal Adviser to the President and Council Chairperson of the University of Ghana; Afigya Kwabre North MP Collins Adomako; and Minister of Youth Development and Empowerment, George Opare Addo. Energy and power plant consultant and philanthropist Ing. Philip Badger completes the list. In a statement issued in Accra on October 28, 2026, the YPYC Foundation invited the public to participate in the event, which it said would celebrate leadership, innovation and empowerment across Africa. The foundation said the summit and awards ceremony would bring together distinguished personalities and other participants to recognise individuals whose work reflects leadership, service and efforts to break barriers to success. The announcement was signed by Hilary Achiaa Osei-Okrah, Media Officer of the YPYC Foundation
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ypyc-foundat.title_zh: YPYC基金会公布第17届非洲榜样奖提名名单
https://www.myjoyonline.com/ypyc-foundat.body_zh: 青年专业人士和青年联盟（YPYC）基金会宣布了第17届非洲榜样奖候选名单，来自加纳及其他非洲国家的多位知名人士获提名。获奖者将在定于2026年10月31日星期六举行的第17届转型峰会暨非洲榜样奖颁奖典礼上公布，地点设在勒贡加纳大学ISSER会议厅。幕僚长朱利叶斯·德布拉博士预计将作为特邀贵宾出席。奖项旨在表彰在传统领导、学术界、宗教、商业、媒体、工程、政治、教育、法律、能源和慈善等领域作出贡献并产生影响的人士。候选名单包括加纳酋长HRM塔基·泰科·楚鲁二世；中央大学副校长夸西·达泰-巴阿教授；神召会总监督史蒂芬·温加姆牧师博士。其他候选人还包括终极神恩中心心理学家、牧师和企业家罗丝蒙德·普雷姆佩夫人；Northshore Apparel Ghana Limited创始人兼首席执行官穆罕默德·努里丁；以及Media General播音员纳·阿肖科·门萨-多库。Stratcom Africa首席执行官兼花卉与园艺运动召集人埃丝特·科巴也获提名；此外还有已退休的PwC合伙人兼顾问迈克尔·阿谢杜·安特维，以及加纳大学工程学院高级讲师佩丝·阿莫阿泰工程师博士。名单还包括就读于苏尼亚尼能源与自然资源大学的学生塞缪尔·纳姆吉纳，以及肯尼亚教育家兼培训师索纳莉·塔克拉。其他候选人有总统法律顾问兼加纳大学校务委员会主席玛丽埃塔·布鲁·阿皮亚-奥蓬；Afigya Kwabre North议员科林斯·阿多马科；以及青年发展与赋权部长乔治·奥帕雷·阿多。能源和发电厂顾问兼慈善家菲利普·巴杰工程师博士为名单最后一人。YPYC基金会在2026年10月28日于阿克拉发表声明，邀请公众参加此次活动，并称活动将颂扬非洲各地的领导力、创新和赋能精神。基金会表示，峰会和颁奖典礼将汇聚杰出人士及其他参与者，表彰那些以工作体现领导力、服务精神以及突破成功障碍的人士。公告由YPYC基金会媒体官希拉里·阿奇亚·奥塞-奥克拉签署。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary: The African Action Congress (AAC) presidential candidate, Omoyele Sowore, and the Ekiti State Police Command have given conflicting accounts of an incident in Ado-Ekiti, with the politician alleging that armed thugs attacked him and his team, while the police described it as an “altercation” at a restaurant.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: 非洲行动党（AAC）总统候选人奥莫耶莱·索沃雷与埃基蒂州警察指挥部对阿多-埃基蒂发生的一起事件各执一词。这名政治人物称武装暴徒袭击了他和他的团队，警方则称此事是餐厅里的一场“冲突”。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The African Action Congress (AAC) presidential candidate, Omoyele Sowore, and the Ekiti State Police Command have given conflicting accounts of an incident in Ado-Ekiti, with the politician alleging that armed thugs attacked him and his team, while the police described it as an “altercation” at a restaurant. The disagreement followed an incident on Friday at a restaurant in the Dalimore area of Ado-Ekiti, where Mr Sowore and members of his team were involved in a confrontation with some individuals. Around 1:54 p.m., the X handle of Mr Sowore posted that he had been kidnapped and his whereabouts were not yet known, and alleged that the attackers were sponsored by the Ekiti State Government with operational support from operatives of the State Security Service (SSS). “We have been brutally attacked and injured by well armed government-sponsored thugs in Ado-Ekiti, Ekiti State.” The X account tweeted . “Since our arrival yesterday, DSS (SSS) operatives have been trailing and harassing us. They even threatened the manager of the first place where we ate, warning him never to allow us to use his premises again,” he added in the post. In response to Mr Sowore’s attack claim and allegations against the state police, the Ekiti State Police Command in a statement dismissed reports that the presidential candidate was kidnapped, saying its operatives responded to a distress call and rescued him from the scene. The police said Mr Sowore sustained a minor injury and was receiving medical attention at the Police Hospital in Ado-Ekiti. “The Command wishes to categorically clarify that Mr Sowore was not kidnapped. Rather, preliminary information indicates that he had an altercation with some individuals at a restaurant around Dalimore area, Ado-Ekiti, following which the Police were immediately alerted,” the command said. It added that the police commissioner subsequently ordered a discreet investigation to establish the circumstances surrounding the incident and identify those involved. “The Commissioner of Police, Ekiti State Command, Falade Adegoroye Michael, has ordered a discreet investigation into the incident to establish the full circumstances surrounding the altercation, identify all individuals involved and ensure that anyone found culpable is brought to justice,” the statement read.. It, however, described the claims and allegations against the command as “misleading,” urging the public to disregard the claims. It added that it maintained commitment to protecting lives and property, irrespective of political affiliation. Following the police statement which described the event as “altercation,” Mr Sowore disputed the police account, insisting that he and his team were attacked by armed men and that the incident was not an altercation. “There was no altercation! We were attacked!” he wrote in a post on X, while accusing the police command of downplaying the severity of the incident. He said the commissioner’s description of the injuries as minor was inconsistent with what he described as the extent of the violence. In a statement signed by its National Publicity Secretary, Rex Elanu, AAC said it was alarmed by reports of the attack and called on the Ekiti State governor, the Inspector-General of Police and the state commissioner of police to establish Mr Sowore’s whereabouts, guarantee his safety and arrest those responsible. The party warned that it would organise a mass protest at the Ekiti State Government House if the authorities failed to act. “We call on the Ekiti State Governor, the Inspector-General of Police, and the Ekiti State Commissioner of Police to immediately establish Sowore’s whereabouts, guarantee his safety, arrest the perpetrators, and ensure their prompt prosecution,” the statement read. Mr Sowore, an anti-corruption and human rights campaigner vying for the presidency for the third time in the 2027 election. For years, the Sahara Reporters publisher has been at odds with security agencies, incessantly coming under attacks and facing long detentions in custody. Since 2019, Mr Sowore has faced a series of prosecutions by the police and the SSS as a result of the protests he led and public comments
