https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 非洲行动大会（AAC）总统候选人奥莫耶莱·索沃雷与埃基蒂州警察司令部对阿多-埃基蒂一起事件的说法相互矛盾。这名政治人物声称武装暴徒袭击了他和他的团队，而警方则称这是发生在一家餐馆的“冲突”。争议源于周五阿多-埃基蒂达利莫尔地区一家餐馆发生的事件，当时索沃雷先生及其团队成员与一些人发生对峙。下午1时54分左右，索沃雷先生的X账号发帖称自己遭绑架，目前下落不明，并指控袭击者得到埃基蒂州政府资助，且得到州安全局（SSS）特工的行动支持。他说：“我们在埃基蒂州阿多-埃基蒂遭到政府资助、装备精良的暴徒残暴袭击并受伤。”该X账号发帖称：“我们昨天抵达后，DSS（SSS）特工就一直尾随和骚扰我们。他们甚至威胁我们首先用餐地点的经理，警告他绝不允许我们再次使用其场所。”针对索沃雷先生关于遭到袭击的说法及其对州警方的指控，埃基蒂州警察司令部发表声明，否认有关总统候选人遭绑架的报道，称警方人员接到求救电话后赶到现场，将他救出。警方表示，索沃雷先生受轻伤，正在阿多-埃基蒂警察医院接受治疗。警方司令部说：“本司令部郑重澄清，索沃雷先生并未遭绑架。相反，初步信息显示，他于下午1时54分左右在阿多-埃基蒂达利莫尔地区的一家餐馆与一些人发生冲突，随后警方立即接到警报。”声明补充说，警察局长随后下令秘密调查，以查明事件情况并确认相关人员。声明称：“埃基蒂州司令部警察局长法拉德·阿德戈罗耶·迈克尔已下令对该事件展开秘密调查，以查明冲突的全部情况，确认所有相关人员，并确保任何被发现有责任的人都被绳之以法。”不过，警方司令部称针对该司令部的说法和指控具有“误导性”，敦促公众 disregard 这些说法。它补充说，无论政治立场如何，警方差会致力于保护生命和财产安全。在警方将事件描述为“冲突”后，索沃雷先生否认警方的说法，坚持称他和团队遭到武装人员袭击，该事件并非冲突。他在X上发帖称：“根本不存在冲突！我们遭到了袭击！”同时指控警方司令部淡化了事件的严重程度。他说，警察局长将伤势描述为轻微，与他所描述的暴力程度不符。AAC在一份由全国宣传秘书Rex Elanu签署的声明中表示，对有关袭击的报道感到震惊，并呼吁埃基蒂州州长、警察总监和州警察局长查明索沃雷先生的下落、保证其安全并逮捕责任人。该党警告称，如果当局不采取行动，它将在埃基蒂州政府大楼组织大规模抗议。声明称：“我们呼吁埃基蒂州州长、警察总监和埃基蒂州警察局长立即查明索沃雷的下落，保证他的安全，逮捕肇事者，并确保迅速起诉他们。”索沃雷先生是一名反腐和人权活动人士，将参加2027年选举，第三次竞选总统。多年来，《Sahara Reporters》出版人一直与安全机构不和，频繁遭到袭击，并在羁押期间长期被拘留。自2019年以来，索沃雷先生因领导的抗议活动及公开言论而多次面临警方和SSS的起诉……

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.title: Ibrahim Muazzam and the quest for philosophical understanding, By Jibrin Ibrahim
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary: Last Saturday, I was the reviewer for a book presented as a festschrift organised by CITAD in honour of my good friend, Ibrahim Muazzam. It is appropriate that the focus of the book is the quest for philosophical understanding, as Ibrahim Muazzam is indeed a philosopher. The book, The Quest for Philosophical Understanding: Essays in Honour of Malam Ibrahim Muazzam has 23 chapters spread across six sections and 342 pages.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary_zh: 上周六，我担任了一部由CITAD组织编辑、用于向我的好友Ibrahim Muazzam致敬的纪念文集的审稿人。这本书以追求哲学理解为重点十分恰当，因为Ibrahim Muazzam确实是一位哲学家。《追求哲学理解：纪念Malam Ibrahim Muazzam文集》共有23章，分为六部分，全书342页。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body: Last Saturday, I was the reviewer for a book presented as a festschrift organised by CITAD in honour of my good friend, Ibrahim Muazzam. It was in recognition of his fifty years of scholarship, research, documentation, teaching, writing and reflections on life, society and human organisation. If everybody calls him Malam, it is because that is what he is, a teacher. I was particularly glad to notice many articles published over the past few weeks by many of his former students thanking him for the intellectual guidance and inspiration he gave them. It is appropriate that the focus of the book is the quest for philosophical understanding, as Ibrahim Muazzam is indeed a philosopher. This means he is a critical thinker who has spent his life in the systematic, rational, and critical study of fundamental questions about existence, knowledge, values, reason, the mind, and language. The word, as we all know, comes from the ancient Greek philosophia , meaning the “love of wisdom.” Rather than gathering basic facts or running scientific laboratory experiments, philosophy investigates the underlying meanings, concepts, and assumptions on how we live, think, and understand the world. Muazzam has also been a documentarist with great respect for words, texts and their significance. He has a massive library and has lived a life of collecting sources of data before artificial intelligence emerged to redefine human existence on the basis of the power of access to big data, and unleashing the massive strength and capabilities locked therein. Over the next five years, as AI accesses Muazzam’s library, a lot will be revealed about knowledge and alternative futures. Unlike Muazzam, I am not a philosopher. I am a simple and mundane political scientist and the editors of the book, YZ Ya’u and Murtala Muhammad had no business asking me to review this book. In the end I accepted to try the task is because I am his classmate who might offer some insights into the background that produced him. I met Ibrahim Muazzam in January 1973 as students at the School of Basic Studies (BASICO) of Ahmadu Bello University. We were 18-years old and had two assets – solid secondary school educations and blank minds that were ready to learn. In our time, being Basico meant having a great ambition – to understand the world and change it into a better one. We were that arrogant and we needed to be. It was a great beginning and we had the teachers to guide us. We had a great teacher of World Contemporary History, Paul Claugh, who was in his twenties, rode a powerful motor bike and taught us that our mission of changing the world would only happen if we understood it. He analysed the post-industrial world by tracing the three industrial revolutions that had transformed the globe into a single system of exploitation based on control systems over human beings, natural resources and nations. Imperialism is real, he argued, but it is also contested and he trained us on the imperative of contesting, conquering and transforming the system. And then then the turning point came. We gained membership into STAR (Social Theory and African Reality), a Marxist-Leninist Study group initially established by Peter Waterman, where we learnt the theoretical basis for the praxis that would lead to the revolution. It was STAR that was transformed into the Movement for a Progressive Nigeria (MPN) when we decided that we would start the world revolution by launching the Nigerian one. We had the ambition and belief, we learnt the theoretical tools, and we were set to change the world as teenagers. Two voices in the SBS moved us towards political science. One was the young lecturer, Mr Jacobs, later renaming himself as Professor AT Gana, who was inspirational in painting the beauty of political science as a discipline. The other was Mrs Amusa, a young Afro-American who introduced us to Malcolm X and his radical ideas. After our Basico beginnings, Muazzam and I then moved to the Department of Government in 1974 to study political science. Our first move was to demand from the patriarch of the Department, Reverend Father (Professor) James O’Connell that the Senate must immediately change the name of the department from government to political science. He refused, saying the word ‘politics’ would irritate the military who would not want to employ a specialist in politics. We fought him saying that our ambitions were not to end up in government jobs but to overthrow the government. We harassed him by writing articles criticising his poster article, “The inevitability of Instability in Nigeria,” pointing out that he was the current incarnation of the colonial divide-and-rule tactics we were combating. Father O’Connell ran into troubles on two fronts. In his personal life, he fell in love with a colleague in the Faculty, married, and had to leave the priesthood of the Catholic Church. On the political from, Murtala Mohammed came into power in 1975 and our professor was given a 24-hour deadline to leave the country and the department he had led since 1967. The Department of Government then became Political Science. Muazzam’s love for philosophy was deepened by our political philosophy teacher, Ayuba Kadzai. The young and restless philosopher trained in the Chicago School introduced us to the approach of architectonic philosophy. It refers to the systematic classification of human knowledge and the art of building a unified, coherent philosophical system. Derived from the Greek word “architekton” (master builder), architectonics treats philosophy not as a collection of isolated ideas, but as a structured edifice in which every part fits together logically. It seeks to map out how different branches of knowledge, science, and morality relate to and support one another. Muazzam and I were less convinced about Ayuba’s obsession to transform Nigeria into a great power, as if that status was a higher order than building cadres for the revolution which was, in our view, the fastest route to a great power status with the people, rather than against the people. May the souls of our teachers rest in perfect peace. The final point about the Ahmadu Bello University of our time was the strong ideological position not to have a department of philosophy. The position was that philosophy is not an ordinary discipline that you learn in a department. It is about architectonics and is integral to all disciplines. That is why PhD as a terminal degree is a doctorate in philosophy. What ABU taught us is that the acquisition of knowledge must be purpose-driven but also based on strong ethics. Knowledge must always go beyond self-interest and aggrandisement. That what we do with knowledge must flow from the output of our knowledge, which reveals the domination and exploitation of our continent by capitalism and its system of imperialism. There is no surprise when purpose emerged as the liberation, and emancipation of our people and our resources. These fundamentals have not changed. The book, The Quest for Philosophical Understanding: Essays in Honour of Malam Ibrahim Muazzam has 23 chapters spread across six sections and 342 pages. It is a labour of love for the honouree, Ibrahim Muazzam, from friends, colleagues, former students and mentees. It is the sign that his long-life commitment to critical thinking has produced fruits. Section one is on the foundations and frameworks of philosophy and has six chapters. It looks at the value of philosophy, which guides us in knowing the types of questions we should pose, so that our critical thinking could develop. Philosophy is about human conduct towards others, what is right, what is wrong, and the norms and values that define society. Western philosophy is based on the Cartesian notion of personhood, in which reason is embedded in individuals who have personal autonomy and freewill. African philosophy, on the other hand, blurs the distinction between the individual and society. In the five chapters in section two, the issue of philosophical approaches to governance and society is addressed. Nigeria and, indeed, Africa need to pose the question of why we have the recurrence of poor leadership. Good governance has become a rare phenomenon on the continent. There has been no clear approach to developing a philosophy of governance, which means that we do not have the basis for the establishment of responsible and legitimate governance systems. In addition, many feel they are marginalised from governance, and the imperative of developing an inclusive system is yet to be addressed. Section three has four chapters on the philosophies of security, peace and inclusion. The classic position is that the state has responsibility for the provision of security. Perspectives however differ on what security means, and for whom. There is also a wide gap between narrowly or broadly defined approaches to what security is. What is security has remained a persistent question. In the fourth section, four authors address the epistemology of knowledge systems in Africa. One such system known as “Igwebuike” is presented and analysed. It is based on solidarity and complementarity within the society and could be viewed as part of the process of decolonising Africa’s theory of knowledge. Feminist epistemology and theories of power offering a gendered perspective are also presented. There is also a presentation of the intellectual history of Malam Amina Kano, a radical leader who advocated for the promotion of people’s power and the emancipation of the masses, talakawa. The three chapters in section five present philosophical reflections on leadership and ethics. It is proposed that the Nelson Mandela model of leadership recruitment provides enough elements for a philosophy of leadership in Africa. There is thus a path to follow in improving our leadership selection system. A professor of Political Science and development consultant/expert, Jibrin Ibrahim is a Senior Fellow of the Centre for Democracy and Development, and Chair of the Editorial Board of PREMIUM TIMES
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.title_zh: Ibrahim Muazzam与追求哲学理解——Jibrin Ibrahim
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body_zh: 上周六，我担任了一本书的评论员。这本书由CITAD组织筹办，以献给挚友Ibrahim Muazzam，形式为论文纪念集，以表彰他50年来在学术研究、资料整理、教学写作以及对社会、生命和人类组织的思考与反思方面所作的贡献。大家都称他为Malam，是因为他本来就是一名教师。我尤其注意到，他过去几周发表了许多文章，许多昔日学生借此感谢他在知识和思想方面给予他们的指导与启发。这本书把重点放在对哲学理解的探索上是恰当的，因为Ibrahim Muazzam确实是一位哲学家。这意味着，他是一位批判性思想者，一生都在系统、理性而批判地研究有关存在、知识、价值、理性、心灵和语言的根本问题。众所周知，“哲学”一词源自古希腊语philosophia，意为“对智慧的热爱”。哲学并非搜集基本事实或在科学实验室进行实验，而是探究我们如何生活、思考和理解世界的深层含义、概念与预设。Muazzam也是一位文献记录者，对言辞、文本及其意义怀有崇敬之情。他拥有庞大的藏书库；在人工智能尚未凭借获取大数据的力量重新定义人类存在、释放蕴藏其中巨大力量与能力之前，他毕生都在收集各种数据来源。未来5年，当人工智能接入Muazzam的藏书库时，知识与另类未来的许多面向都将被揭示。与Muazzam不同，我不是哲学家，只是一名普通而平凡的政治学者。该书编辑YZ Ya’u和Murtala Muhammad本不该请我评论这本书，但最终我还是答应尝试完成这项任务，因为我是他的同学，或许能就造就他的背景提供一些见解。我于1973年1月在Ahmadu Bello大学基础研究学院（BASICO）求学时结识Ibrahim Muazzam。当时我们18岁，拥有两项财富：扎实的中等教育基础，以及准备学习的一片空白头脑。在我们那个时代，进入BASICO意味着怀有远大志向——理解世界，并把它变成更美好的世界。我们当时非常傲慢，而且确实需要如此。这是一个了不起的开端，也幸好有老师引导我们。我们有一位出色的世界当代史老师Paul Claugh，他当时只有20多岁，骑着一辆 powerful 摩托车，教导我们，只有理解世界，我们改变世界的使命才可能实现。他通过追溯三次工业革命来分析后工业世界；这些革命把地球变成了一个单一的剥削体系，其基础是对人、自然资源和国家的控制机制。他认为帝国主义确实存在，但它也是可争议的；他训练我们必须去挑战、征服并改变这一体系。随后，转折点出现了。我们加入了STAR（Social Theory and African Reality），这是一个最初由Peter Waterman创建的马克思列宁主义研究小组。在那里，我们学习了通往革命的实践活动的理论基础。后来，我们决定从发起尼日利亚革命开始推进世界革命，STAR便转型为Movement for a Progressive Nigeria（MPN）。我们拥有志向和信念，掌握了理论工具，准备在青少年时期改变世界。SBS的两位声音把我们引向政治科学。一位是年轻讲师Jacobs先生，后来改名为AT Gana教授，他以充满感召力的方式描绘了政治科学作为一门学科的美。另一位是Amusa夫人，一位年轻的非裔美国人，她向我们介绍了Malcolm X及其激进思想。结束BASICO阶段后，Muazzam和我于1974年进入政府学系学习政治科学。我们采取的第一步行动，就是要求系主任、尊敬的James O’Connell神父（教授）让参议院立即把系名从“政府学”改为“政治学”。他拒绝了，说“政治”一词会惹恼军方，因为他们不愿雇用政治学专家。我们则反驳他，说我们的志向不是在政府任职，而是推翻政府。我们通过撰写文章批评他的海报文章《尼日利亚不稳定的必然性》来纠缠他，指出他正是我们反对的殖民分而治之策略的当代化身。O’Connell神父在两个方面陷入困境。在个人生活中，他爱上了一位同系同事，结婚后不得不离开天主教神职。在政治方面，Murtala Mohammed于1975年掌权，我们的教授接到24小时最后通牒，必须离开这个国家以及他自1967年起领导的系。政府学系随后改名为政治学系。我们的政治哲学老师Ayuba Kadzai进一步加深了Muazzam对哲学的热爱。这位年轻而不安的哲学家受训于芝加哥学派，向我们介绍了架构哲学的方法。它指的是对人类知识进行系统分类，以及构建统一连贯的哲学体系的艺术。架构学源自希腊语“architekton”（营造大师），并不把哲学视为孤立理念的集合，而是把它看作一座结构严密的大厦，其中每个部分都在逻辑上相互契合。它试图勾勒不同知识分支、科学与道德之间如何相互联系、相互支撑。对于Ayuba执迷于把尼日利亚变成伟大强国一事，Muazzam和我并没有那么信服，仿佛这种地位比培养革命干部更为高尚。在我们看来，培植革命干部才是借助人民而非反对人民成为伟大强国的最快道路。愿我们老师的灵魂安息。我们那个时代的Ahmadu Bello大学最后一点值得强调之处，是学校坚决反对设立哲学系的鲜明意识形态立场。其理由是，哲学并非一门在系里学习的普通学科，而是关乎架构学并与所有学科不可分割。正因如此，博士作为最高学位，是哲学博士学位。ABU教给我们的，是获取知识必须以目标为导向，同时也要建立在坚强伦理之上。知识必须始终超越私利与自我膨胀。我们如何运用知识，必须源于知识本身所揭示的内容，即资本主义及其帝国主义体系对我们大陆的支配与剥削。当目标明确为解放我们的人民和资源时，这并不令人意外。这些根本原则从未改变。《追求哲学理解：纪念Malam Ibrahim Muazzam文集》分为6个部分，共23章，篇幅达342页。这是朋友、同事、昔日学生和后辈献给受纪念者Ibrahim Muazzam的一份深情之作，也表明他毕生对批判性思考的投入已经结出果实。第一部分探讨哲学的基础与框架，共6章，审视哲学的价值。哲学引导我们认识应当提出哪些类型的问题，从而发展批判性思维。哲学关乎人们如何对待他人、什么是对与错，以及界定社会的规范与价值。西方哲学以笛卡尔式的人格观念为基础，认为理性植根于具有个人自主性和自由意志的个人之中。相比之下，非洲哲学模糊了个人与社会之间的区别。第二部分的5章讨论以哲学方法处理治理与社会的问题。尼日利亚乃至整个非洲都需要追问，为什么糟糕的领导会反复出现。良好治理已成为非洲大陆上的罕见现象。迄今尚无明确的治理哲学发展路径，这意味着我们缺乏建立负责任且合法治理体系的基础。此外，许多人认为自己被边缘化于治理之外，而建立包容性体系的迫切要求仍未得到处理。第三部分有4章讨论安全、和平与包容的哲学。经典立场认为，国家有责任提供安全。然而，人们对于安全意味着什么以及安全所面向的对象存在不同看法，对安全作狭义或广义界定的方法之间也相距甚远。“安全是什么”始终是一个悬而未决的问题。第四部分的4位作者讨论非洲知识体系的认识论。其中介绍了并分析了一种称为“Igwebuike”的体系。它以社会内部的团结与互补为基础，可以被视为非洲知识理论去殖民化进程的一部分。书中还介绍了女性主义认识论以及提供性别化视角的权力理论。此外，还讲述了Malam Amina Kano的思想史。他是一位激进领袖，主张推动人民权力以及群众即talakawa的解放。第五部分的3章从哲学角度反思领导力与伦理。书中提出，Nelson Mandela式的领导人遴选模式，为非洲领导哲学提供了足够的要素。因此，改善领导人遴选体系已有一条可以遵循的路径。政治学教授、发展顾问与专家Jibrin Ibrahim是Centre for Democracy and Development高级研究员，也是PREMIUM TIMES编辑委员会主席

Unlock these with Subscription India has over the last decade made “remarkable progress” in reducing poverty across both monetary and non-monetary dimensions, the World Bank said in a new report, adding the country saw one of the fastest reductions in poverty in the world. Further, it said it projected poverty to continue declining, “albeit more gradually”, with the poverty rate as measured according to the $4.20/day line expected to fall from 14.2% in 2026 to 12.1% by 2028. “On the non-monetary dimensions, as measured by the Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative’s (OPHI) Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI), poverty fell sharply from 53.8% in 2005-06 to 16.4% in 2019-21, with the World Bank MPI measure at 15.5% in 2022-23,” the World Bank said. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman welcomed the findings and, in a social media post, highlighted the various positive aspects the data revealed. “The World Bank identifies strong consumption growth, rising employment — especially among women — and expanded social transfers, including food subsidies, as major drivers,” Ms. Sitharaman said. “Under the leadership of Hon’ble PM Shri @narendramodi, the Government’s sustained policy efforts are yielding tangible results, strengthening the foundations for inclusive growth and greater economic opportunity,” she added. The World Bank's October 2026 Poverty & Equity Brief records India's progress as one of the fastest poverty declines in the world. The report highlights several significant gains: ✅ 49.6 crore people moved above the lower-middle-income poverty line of $4.20 a day between 2011 and 2023, with the poverty rate declining from 57.7% to 16.1%. ✅ Extreme poverty declined from 27.1% to 2.6% over the same period, measured at $3 a day. Both monetary poverty thresholds use 2021 purchasing power parity. ✅ Employment increased by 13.4 crore people between 2017 and 2023, nearly twice the increase in the working-age population. ✅ Rural women accounted for much of the employment gain, entering paid work and increasing the number of earners in their households. ✅ Both rural and urban households experienced substantial welfare gains, with faster progress in rural India narrowing the rural–urban gap. ✅ Access to electricity reached 99% of the population, according to the report's 2022 survey data. The World Bank identifies strong consumption growth, rising employment - especially among women—and expanded social transfers, including food subsidies, as major drivers. Under the leadership of Hon'ble PM Shri @narendramodi, the Government's sustained policy efforts are yielding tangible results, strengthening the foundations for inclusive growth and greater economic opportunity. This is the reason why NDA govt wins people's trust and mandate of our citizens. We remain committed to building on this progress through productive employment, stronger household incomes and effective delivery of public services, so that aspirations of our people are met. The World Bank report further said that as poverty declined, it became concentrated among households with lower education, fewer assets, limited access to stable employment, and higher dependency ratios. “Wage disparities, however, remain pronounced, as median earnings among the top 10% of workers were about 13 times those of the bottom 10% in 2023,” the report said. “Poverty has also become increasingly concentrated geographically,” it added. “While living standards improved across most States, households in a contiguous belt stretching from Uttar Pradesh to West Bengal account for about 57% of India’s poor population.” The report further noted that, between 2017 and 2023, employment increased by about 134 million people, nearly twice the growth of the working-age population, with much of the gain driven by rural women entering paid work and raising the number of earners per household. “However, youth unemployment rose from 14.6% to 15.9% between the two quarters [Q1 FY2026 and Q1 FY2027], particularly among rural young women,” the World Bank highlighted. “Moreover, real earnings remained broadly unchanged with employment growth concentrated in relatively low-productivity activities.” Comments have to be in English, and in full sentences. 印度在过去十年里，在货币和非货币两个维度减少贫困方面取得了“显著进展”，世界银行在一份新报告中表示，并补充称，印度的贫困人口降幅位居世界前列。报告进一步指出，预计贫困将继续减少，“但降幅会有所放缓”；按照每天4.20美元的标准衡量，贫困率预计将从2026年的14.2%降至2028年的12.1%。

世界银行表示：“在非货币维度方面，根据牛津贫困与人类发展研究所（OPHI）的多维贫困指数（MPI）衡量，贫困率从2005—06年的53.8%大幅降至2019—21年的16.4%；按照世界银行MPI衡量，2022—23年的贫困率为15.5%。”

财政部长尼尔马拉·西塔拉曼对这些调查结果表示欢迎，并在社交媒体帖子中强调了数据所反映的各个方面积极进展。

西塔拉曼女士说：“世界银行认为，消费强劲增长、就业增加——尤其是女性就业增加——以及社会转移支付扩大，包括食品补贴，是主要推动因素。”她补充道：“在尊敬的总理 Narendra Modi 先生的领导下，政府持续实施的政策正在取得切实成果，为包容性增长和创造更多经济机会夯实基础。”

世界银行2026年10月《贫困与公平简报》将印度的进展记录为世界上贫困降幅最快的国家之一。报告突出说明了多项重大成果：

✅ 2011年至2023年，有4960万人跨过每天4.20美元的中低收入贫困线，贫困率从57.7%降至16.1%。

✅ 同期，极端贫困率从27.1%降至2.6%，极端贫困线按每天3美元计算。两个货币贫困线均采用2021年购买力平价。

✅ 2017年至2023年，就业人数增加1.34亿，增幅接近劳动年龄人口增幅的两倍。

✅ 农村女性贡献了大部分就业增长，她们开始从事有酬工作，提高了家庭收入者的数量。

✅ 农村和城市家庭的福利均显著改善，农村地区进展更快，农村与城市之间的差距有所缩小。

✅ 根据报告中的2022年调查数据，电力覆盖率已达到人口的99%。

世界银行认为，消费强劲增长、就业增加——尤其是女性就业增加——以及社会转移支付扩大，包括食品补贴，是主要推动因素。

在尊敬的总理 Narendra Modi 先生的领导下，政府持续实施的政策正在取得切实成果，为包容性增长和创造更多经济机会夯实基础。

这正是全国民主联盟（NDA）政府赢得民众信任以及我国公民授权的原因。我们将继续致力于通过创造生产性就业、提高家庭收入和有效提供公共服务来巩固这些进展，从而实现人民的愿望。

世界银行报告进一步指出，随着贫困减少，贫困日益集中在教育程度较低、资产较少、获得稳定就业的机会有限以及人口抚养比较高的家庭之中。报告说：“然而，工资差距依然明显，2023年，劳动收入最高的前10%劳动者的收入中位数约为收入最低的后10%劳动者的13倍。”报告还补充道：“贫困在地理上也日益集中。虽然大多数邦的生活水平有所改善，但从北方邦延伸至西孟加拉邦的连续地带内的家庭，占印度贫困人口的约57%。”

报告进一步指出，2017年至2023年，就业人数增加约1.34亿，增幅接近劳动年龄人口增幅的两倍，其中大部分增长得益于农村女性开始从事有酬工作，并提高每个家庭的收入者数量。

世界银行强调：“然而，在两个季度[2026财年第一季度和2027财年第一季度]之间，青年失业率从14.6%升至15.9%，农村青年女性尤其如此。”

“此外，实际收入总体保持不变，新增就业集中在生产率相对较低的活动领域。”

https://leadership.ng/sowore-was-not-kid.body: The Command said Sowore sustained minor injuries during the incident and was receiving medical attention at the Police Hospital in Ado-Ekiti. The Police Public Relations Officer, SP Abutu Sunday, disclosed this in a statement while addressing reports circulating on social media that armed thugs had kidnapped the politician and whisked him away to an unknown destination. According to the police, preliminary information indicated that Sowore had an altercation with some individuals at a restaurant around the Dallimore area of Ado-Ekiti, following which the police were alerted. “Upon receiving the report, police operatives swiftly mobilised to the scene and successfully rescued him. He, however, sustained a minor injury and is currently receiving medical attention at the Police Hospital, Ado-Ekiti,” the statement said. The Command disclosed that the Commissioner of Police, Michael Falade, had ordered a discreet investigation to establish the circumstances surrounding the altercation, identify those involved and ensure that anyone found culpable was brought to justice. It urged members of the public to remain calm and refrain from circulating unverified information capable of creating unnecessary panic and tension. The Command also reaffirmed its commitment to protecting lives and property across the state, irrespective of political affiliation, status or background. However, another report alleged that suspected political thugs had stormed Tawakalitu Restaurant in the Dallimore area of Ado-Ekiti, where Sowore was, and whisked him away to an unknown destination. Sowore was reportedly in Ekiti State to participate in the annual Ikogosi 17.5-kilometre marathon scheduled for Saturday, October 31, 2026. He also participated in the race last year. The marathon is scheduled to begin in Ilawe-Ekiti and end at Ikogosi-Ekiti, in Ekiti West Local Government Area of the state. We’ve got the edge. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.body: A former National Publicity Secretary of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP), Olisa Metuh, has urged the National Assembly to amend relevant laws on counterfeit products to prescribe stiffer penalties for those involved in the production and distribution of fake drugs and other adulterated goods in Nigeria. Mr Metuh, a member of the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) and the Director of Mobilisation and Organisation of the Renewed Hope Ambassadors (RHA), recommended longer prison sentences and asset forfeiture for anyone convicted of producing or distributing counterfeit products. He made the call in a statement on Friday while reacting to the conviction of Innocent Okoye by the Federal High Court in Abia State for producing and distributing fake Extra Virgin Olive Oil. Mr Okoye was sentenced to five years’ imprisonment, with an option of a N5 million fine. Mr Metuh, a lawyer, described the sentence, particularly the option of a fine, as too lenient for an offence that could endanger the health of millions of Nigerians. He warned that counterfeiting would persist if tougher penalties were not introduced to deter offenders. “A five-year jail term or N5 million fine amounts to a mere slap on the wrist. Such punishment could make counterfeiting and product adulteration a manageable business expense for unscrupulous manufacturers and distributors. “The law must respond with consequences that fit the crime. The absence of direct physical confrontation between offenders and their victims does not make product counterfeiting any less dangerous than conventional violent crimes,” he said. He urged the National Assembly to urgently review existing laws governing drug counterfeiting, pharmaceutical adulteration and the falsification of consumer products, arguing that the penalties should reflect the potential harm such offences could cause to public health. Counterfeit and substandard products remain a public-health concern in Nigeria despite repeated raids, seizures, arrests and prosecutions by the National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC). The problem extends beyond medicines to adulterated food, beverages, cosmetics, medical devices and other regulated products. Such products may contain harmful ingredients, incorrect quantities of active pharmaceutical ingredients or substances that have not undergone the required safety and quality checks. The consequences of using substandard and falsified medicines, according to NAFDAC, include treatment failure, prolonged hospitalisation, increased hospital admissions, antimicrobial resistance and, in severe cases, death. The persistence of the trade is illustrated by the repeated discovery of illegal manufacturing and distribution facilities, including in major pharmaceutical markets such as Onitsha, Aba and Lagos. A BusinessDay investigation published in August found that NAFDAC’s enforcement records showed that products worth more than N1.1 trillion had been seized or destroyed between 2023 and 2025, yet the agency continued to encounter counterfeit and substandard products in previously raided distribution centres. Between January and August. NAFDAC’s Directorate of Investigation and Enforcement arrested 52 suspects, raided 213 locations, seized 821 products and sealed 179 premises. The NAFDAC’s Director-General, Mojisola Adeyeye, recently said the agency had secured 64 convictions for counterfeiting, with sentences ranging from one to seven years’ imprisonment without the option of a fine. Two separate but related legislative bills are before the Senate, sponsored by Sadiq Umar (APC, Kwara North). They are: the Counterfeit Medical Products, Fake Drugs and Unwholesome Processed Foods (Prohibition and Control) Bill, 2026, and the Food, Drugs and Related Products (Registration, etc.) (Repeal) Bill, 2026. The amendment to the counterfeit medical products bill seeks to repeal and replace the existing Counterfeit and Fake Drugs and Unwholesome Processed Foods (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act, 2004, with a more comprehensive framework for addressing counterfeit medical products, fake drugs and unsafe processed foods. It prescribes a 15-year prison term for offenders upon conviction, alongside asset forfeiture and compensation for victims. It also seeks to strengthen NAFDAC’s enforcement powers. While the proposed Food, Drugs and Related Products Bill focuses directly on criminalising counterfeiting and prescribing punishments, it also modernises the regulatory framework governing food, drugs and other products under NAFDAC’s control

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/more.body_zh: 人民民主党（PDP）前全国宣传秘书Olisa Metuh敦促尼日利亚国民议会修改有关假冒产品的法律，对参与生产、销售假药及其他掺假商品的人规定更严厉的处罚。Metuh先生是执政的进步大会党（APC）成员，也是“重燃希望大使”（RHA）动员与组织主任；他建议，对任何被判定生产或销售假冒产品的人，判处更长的刑期并没收其资产。他于星期五发表声明，回应阿比亚州联邦高等法院对Innocent Okoye的定罪；Okoye因生产并销售假冒特级初榨橄榄油被判刑。Okoye被判处5年监禁，也可选择缴纳N5 million罚款。身为律师的Metuh先生表示，这一判决，尤其是可以缴纳罚款的选择，对于一种可能危及数百万尼日利亚人健康的罪行来说过于宽缓。他警告，如果不引入更严厉的处罚以震慑违法者，制假活动就会持续存在。他说：“5年监禁或N5 million罚款不过是轻轻拍一下手。这样的惩罚可能让制假和产品掺假成为不法制造商和销售商可以轻松承担的经营成本。法律必须以与罪行相称的后果予以回应。违法者与受害者之间没有直接的身体冲突，并不会使产品制假比传统暴力犯罪更不危险。”他敦促国民议会紧急审查现行有关药品制假、药品掺假和伪造消费品的法律，并认为处罚力度应反映此类罪行可能对公共健康造成的危害。尽管国家食品药品监督管理总局（NAFDAC）多次开展突袭、查扣、逮捕和起诉，假冒及不合格产品在尼日利亚仍是公共卫生问题。这一问题不仅涉及药品，还涉及掺假食品、饮料、化妆品、医疗器械和其他受监管产品。这些产品可能含有有害成分、含量不符的活性药物成分，或含有未经必要安全与质量检测的物质。NAFDAC表示，使用不合格和伪造药品的后果包括治疗失败、住院时间延长、住院人数增加、抗微生物药物耐药性，严重情况下还会致死。非法生产设施和销售点不断被发现，反映出这一非法贸易依然存在，其中包括奥尼查、阿巴和拉各斯等主要药品市场。BusinessDay于8月发布的一项调查发现，NAFDAC的执法记录显示，2023年至2025年间，该机构查扣或销毁了价值超过N1.1 trillion的产品，但在此前遭突袭的销售中心，仍持续发现假冒和不合格产品。1月至8月间，NAFDAC调查与执法局逮捕了52名嫌疑人，突袭213个地点，查扣821件产品，并查封179处场所。NAFDAC总干事Mojisola Adeyeye近日表示，该机构已就制假行为取得64项定罪，刑期从1年至7年不等，且不得以缴纳罚款代替服刑。参议院目前审议着两项彼此独立但相互关联的法案，均由夸拉北区的Sadiq Umar（APC）提出，分别是《2026年假冒医疗产品、假药和不安全加工食品（禁止与管制）法案》和《2026年食品、药品及相关产品（登记等）（废止）法案》。对假冒医疗产品法案的修订拟废止并取代现行《2004年假冒与假药及不安全加工食品（杂项规定）法》，以建立更全面的框架，处理假冒医疗产品、假药和不安全加工食品问题。法案规定，违法者一经定罪将被判处15年监禁，并没收资产、赔偿受害者，同时寻求加强NAFDAC的执法权。拟议中的《食品、药品及相关产品法案》重点将制假行为入刑并规定处罚，同时还将更新NAFDAC监管食品、药品和其他受管制产品的监管框架。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.summary: This question is central to the Nigeria Revenue Service’ s (NRS) ongoing transformation of tax administration through Rev360, its next-generation digital tax administration platform. Building on previous advances in digital tax administration, the platform is designed to simplify compliance, improve service delivery, strengthen transparency and support more efficient revenue administration.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.summary_zh: 这一问题正是尼日利亚税务局（NRS）借助其下一代数字税收管理平台Rev360持续推进税收管理转型的核心。该平台以此前数字税收管理取得的进展为基础，旨在简化纳税合规流程、改善服务供给、增强透明度，并支持更加高效的税收征管。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.body: For many taxpayers, the true measure of an effective tax system is not the complexity of its laws or the sophistication of its technology, but a much simpler question: how easy is it to comply? This question is central to the Nigeria Revenue Service’ s (NRS) ongoing transformation of tax administration through Rev360, its next-generation digital tax administration platform. Since its go-live on 30th April, 2026, Rev360 has marked an important milestone in the Service’s transition towards a more integrated, intelligent and taxpayer-centric system. Building on previous advances in digital tax administration, the platform is designed to simplify compliance, improve service delivery, strengthen transparency and support more efficient revenue administration. As implementation progresses, attention is increasingly shifting from the introduction of the platform to its adoption, operational effectiveness and the tangible improvements it delivers for taxpayers and other stakeholders. Rev360 comprises an interconnected digital architecture designed to serve different participants in the tax ecosystem. The Unified Revenue Collections Workspace (URCW) is the internal workspace for NRS personnel. It provides staff with a digital environment for administering revenue and managing taxpayer-related processes and information. The Taxpayer Self-Service Portal (TSSP) is the principal digital channel for taxpayers. It enables taxpayers to access tax services and interact with the NRS without depending entirely on physical offices and manual paperwork. Through the TSSP, taxpayers can undertake key compliance activities and access relevant services digitally. The Tax Consultants’ Portal (TCP) provides a dedicated channel for tax consultants and professionals who assist taxpayers with their obligations. It gives them a structured digital interface through which they can support their clients. The Government Tax Portal (GTP) is designed for Ministries, Departments and Agencies (MDAs), extending the digital tax environment into government institutions and supporting their interaction with tax administration. The Developers’ Portal provides a connection point for third-party software developers and supports interoperability between external technology solutions and the wider Rev360 ecosystem. The significance of these channels lies not merely in the existence of separate portals, but in their connection within a broader digital tax administration environment. Taxpayers, tax professionals, government institutions, NRS personnel and technology developers can therefore engage with the Service through channels designed around their respective roles. For taxpayers, however, the technology behind Rev360 matters less than the experience it creates. The important questions are practical: Can a taxpayer register more easily? Can returns be filed without unnecessary complications? Can payments be made conveniently? Can compliance issues be resolved more efficiently? Can taxpayers obtain assistance without repeated visits to tax offices? The TSSP is particularly significant because it creates a direct digital channel between taxpayers and the NRS, providing access to services such as tax filing, payments, tax clearance, assessments and other taxpayer services. The Tax ID also plays an important role in the wider digital tax administration framework by providing a basis for identifying taxpayers and supporting access to tax services. However, the Tax ID framework should be distinguished from Rev360 itself. The NRS Tax ID service states that the Tax ID is jointly issued by the NRS and the Joint Revenue Board in accordance with Nigerian tax laws. For businesses, predictable processes and easier access to tax services can reduce the administrative burden associated with compliance. The objective, therefore, is not simply to digitise existing procedures but to make the overall experience of dealing with the tax authority more convenient, accessible and predictable. Since its introduction, Rev360 has progressed through a phased implementation process designed to support an orderly transition for taxpayers and other stakeholders. Beyond the deployment of technology, the NRS has prioritisedstakeholder sensitisation, user training, technical support and continuous engagement to facilitate adoption and address implementation challenges. The early implementation period is naturally one of adjustment. Taxpayers, professionals, government institutions and NRS personnel have to become familiar with the digital environment and adapt to processes that may differ from previous ways of working. The success of Rev360 will ultimately be determined by measurable improvements in taxpayer experience, service reliability, processing efficiency, accessibility and voluntary compliance. As implementation progresses, user feedback and operational performance data will remain essential to identifying opportunities for improvement and ensuring that the platform delivers on its objectives. Another important dimension of digital tax administration is data. Tax administration generates enormous amounts of information. When that information exists in disconnected systems, its usefulness can be limited. When appropriately integrated, it can provide a clearer picture of taxpayer behaviour, compliance patterns and revenue trends. Rev360’s digital architecture is intended to support greater integration of tax administration processes and information. Such integration can help reduce duplication, improve coordination and strengthen the Service’s ability to use data in administering tax obligations. The potential benefits extend beyond revenue collection. Reliable tax data can support economic planning and policy decisions by providing government with a stronger evidence base on economic activity. This makes the digital transformation of tax administration relevant not only to taxpayers and the revenue authority but also to the wider economy. Rev360 is being implemented at a time when tax administration globally is becoming increasingly digital. Businesses increasingly operate across borders, while tax authorities are relying more heavily on digitalisation, data integration, transparency and information exchange. Nigeria therefore needs a tax administration capable of operating effectively within this changing international environment. A modern digital tax ecosystem can improve domestic administration while strengthening the country’s capacity to respond to developments in international taxation and cross-border economic activity. Rev360 consequently represents an important stage in Nigeria’s continuing transition towards a more connected and digitally enabled tax administration. Nigeria’s taxpayer population is diverse, ranging from large corporations to medium-sized businesses, entrepreneurs, professionals and individual taxpayers. Their levels of digital literacy, access to technology and familiarity with tax processes vary. This makes communication, taxpayer education and user support essential to the success of Rev360. Users need clear information about which channel applies to them, what services they can access, how to use those services and where to obtain assistance when problems arise. The success of digital tax administration will therefore depend not only on the technology itself but also on the ability of taxpayers and other stakeholders to understand, trust and effectively use the system. As implementation continues, sustained engagement, responsive support and attention to user feedback will be critical to ensuring that the benefits of digitalisation are experienced across different categories of taxpayers and stakeholders. Nigeria needs stronger domestic revenue to finance infrastructure, public services and development. At the same time, businesses need a tax environment that provides greater certainty, accessibility and predictability. A more efficient digital tax administration can contribute to both objectives by making compliance easier for taxpayers while providing the revenue authority with more effective tools for administering the tax system. The transformation of the NRS under the leadership of Executive Chairman Dr Zacch Adedeji reflects a broader effort to reposition tax administration around technology, data, efficiency and improved taxpayer experience. But the real measure of that transformation will not be the sophistication of the technology or simply the number of digital channels created. It will be whether taxpayers experience a meaningful difference. Can taxpayers register and access services more easily? Can businesses file and pay with fewer complications? Can tax consultants manage their clients more efficiently? Can government institutions interact more effectively with the tax authority? Can NRS personnel work with better-integrated information? And can the Service use reliable data to improve compliance and revenue administration? These are the questions that will increasingly define the success of Rev360. Nigeria is moving from a tax administration shaped largely by physical processes towards one increasingly built around digital connectivity, integrated information and self-service. Rev360 provides an important architecture for that transition. Its ultimate achievement, however, will not be measured by technology alone. It will be measured by whether taxation becomes simpler for taxpayers, more efficient for government, more transparent for stakeholders and more predictable for the Nigerian economy. *Emmanuel Jonathan, a Communications Expert and Manager with the Nigeria Revenue Service, writes from Abuja
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.title_zh: Rev360：为数字化尼日利亚重新构想税务管理——Emmanuel Jonathan
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.body_zh: 对许多纳税人而言，衡量税收制度是否有效的真正标准，并非其法律规定的复杂程度或技术手段的先进程度，而是一个简单得多的问题：纳税合规究竟有多容易？这一问题正是尼日利亚税务局（NRS）通过Rev360推进税收管理转型时的核心。Rev360是其新一代数字税收管理平台。自2026年4月30日上线以来，Rev360在该局向更加一体化、智能化和以纳税人为中心的体系转型过程中迈出了重要一步。该平台建立在数字税收管理此前取得的进展之上，旨在简化纳税合规、改善服务交付、增强透明度，并为更加高效的税收管理提供支持。随着实施推进，关注重点正逐渐从平台引入转向平台采用、运营成效以及它为纳税人和其他利益相关方带来的切实改善。Rev360由一套互联互通的数字架构构成，旨在服务税收生态系统中的不同参与者。统一收入征收工作区（URCW）是NRS工作人员使用的内部工作区，为员工提供数字环境，用于管理收入以及处理与纳税人有关的流程和信息。纳税人自助服务门户（TSSP）是面向纳税人的主要数字渠道。纳税人可通过该门户使用税收服务并与NRS互动，而不必完全依赖实体办公室和纸质文件。纳税人可通过TSSP完成关键合规事项，并以数字方式获取相关服务。税务顾问门户（TCP）为协助纳税人履行义务的税务顾问和专业人士提供专门渠道，通过结构化的数字界面支持其为客户服务。政府税收门户（GTP）面向各部委、部门和机构（MDAs）设计，将数字税收环境延伸至政府机构，并支持其与税收管理部门互动。开发者门户为第三方软件开发者提供连接点，支持外部技术解决方案与更广泛的Rev360生态系统实现互操作。这些渠道的重要性不仅在于设有不同的门户，更在于它们在更广泛的数字税收管理环境中彼此连接。因此，纳税人、税务专业人士、政府机构、NRS工作人员和技术开发者均可通过针对各自角色设计的渠道与该局互动。然而，对纳税人而言，Rev360背后的技术远不如其实际体验重要。重要问题都切中实际：纳税人能否更轻松地登记？能否在不产生不必要复杂程序的情况下提交申报？能否便捷地缴纳税款？能否更高效地解决合规问题？纳税人能否获得协助，而无需反复前往税务办公室？TSSP尤其重要，因为它在纳税人与NRS之间建立了直接数字渠道，可使用纳税申报、缴款、税务清证、税务评估及其他纳税人服务。纳税人识别号（Tax ID）也在更广泛的数字税收管理框架中发挥重要作用，为识别纳税人和获取税收服务提供基础。不过，Tax ID框架应当与Rev360本身区分开来。NRS的Tax ID服务说明，Tax ID由NRS与联合收入委员会依照尼日利亚税法共同签发。对企业而言，可预期的流程和更便捷的税收服务获取方式，可以减轻与纳税合规相关的行政负担。因此，该项目的目标并非仅仅将现有程序数字化，而是让纳税人与税务机关交涉的整体体验更加便利、可及且可预期。自推出以来，Rev360一直按照分阶段实施流程推进，以支持纳税人及其他利益相关方有序过渡。除部署技术外，NRS还优先开展利益相关方宣传、用户培训、技术支持和持续沟通，以促进平台采用并解决实施中面临的挑战。实施初期自然需要适应。纳税人、专业人士、政府机构和NRS工作人员必须熟悉数字环境，并适应可能不同于以往工作方式的流程。Rev360最终能否成功，将取决于纳税人体验、服务可靠性、处理效率、可及性和自愿合规等方面的可衡量改善。随着实施不断推进，用户反馈和运营绩效数据仍将是发现改进机会、确保平台实现目标的关键。数字税收管理的另一重要维度是数据。税收管理会产生海量信息。当这些信息分散在不同系统中时，其效用可能受限；若得到适当整合，则能更清晰地反映纳税人行为、合规模式和收入趋势。Rev360的数字架构旨在促进税收管理流程与信息进一步整合。这种整合有助于减少重复工作、改善协调，并增强该局利用数据管理纳税义务的能力。其潜在益处不止于收入征收。可靠的税收数据能为经济规划和政策决策提供支持，为政府提供更充分的经济活动证据。因此，税收管理的数字化转型不仅关系到纳税人和收入征管部门，也关系到更广泛的经济体系。当前全球税收管理正日益数字化之际，Rev360正在实施。企业的跨境经营日益增多，税务机关也越来越依赖数字化、数据整合、透明度和信息交换。因此，尼日利亚需要建立能够在这一变化的国际环境中有效运作的税收管理体系。现代化数字税收生态系统既能改善国内管理，也能增强该国应对国际税收和跨境经济活动变化的能力。因此，Rev360代表尼日利亚继续向更加互联互通和数字化税收管理模式转型的重要阶段。尼日利亚纳税人群体构成多样，既包括大型企业，也包括中型企业、创业者、专业人士和个人纳税人。他们在数字素养、技术可及性以及税收流程熟悉程度方面各不相同。因此，沟通、纳税人教育和用户支持是Rev360取得成功的必要条件。用户需要清楚了解哪个渠道适用于自己、可以获取哪些服务、如何使用这些服务，以及遇到问题时到哪里寻求帮助。因此，数字税收管理能否成功，不仅取决于技术本身，还取决于纳税人和其他利益相关方理解、信任并有效使用该系统的能力。随着实施继续推进，持续沟通、及时支持和重视用户反馈，将是确保不同类别纳税人和利益相关方均能感受到数字化益处的关键。尼日利亚需要更强的国内收入，为基础设施、公共服务和发展提供资金。与此同时，企业需要一个更具确定性、可及性和可预期性的税收环境。更加高效的数字税收管理既能让纳税人的合规更加轻松，也能为收入征管部门提供更有效的税收体系管理工具，从而推动这两项目标实现。在执行主席Zacch Adedeji博士的领导下，NRS开展的转型体现了更广泛的努力，即围绕技术、数据、效率和更好的纳税人体验重新定位税收管理。但衡量这一转型的真正标准，并非技术有多先进，也不只是创建了多少数字渠道，而在于纳税人是否切实感受到有意义的差别。纳税人能否更轻松地登记并获取服务？企业能否以更少复杂程序申报和缴税？税务顾问能否更高效地管理客户？政府机构能否与税务机关进行更有效的互动？NRS工作人员能否使用整合程度更高的信息开展工作？该局能否利用可靠数据改善合规和收入管理？这些问题将日益成为衡量Rev360成败的关键。尼日利亚正在从主要依靠实体流程的税收管理，转向日益以数字互联、信息整合和自助服务为基础的模式。Rev360为这一转型提供了重要架构。然而，其最终成就不会仅以技术来衡量，而在于税收是否对纳税人而言更加简单、对政府而言更加高效、对利益相关方而言更加透明，以及对尼日利亚经济而言更加可预期。*尼日利亚税务局通信专家兼经理Emmanuel Jonathan撰写于阿布贾

https://dailytrust.com/asuu-fg-agreement.summary_zh: 卡杜纳州立大学（KASU）教职工工会（ASU）分会赞扬州长Uba Sani全面落实了2025年联邦政府与ASUU达成的协议。工会上周五在新闻发布会上表示，落实该协议并承诺改善教职工福利，将提升士气和工作效率，并加强劳资关系。
https://dailytrust.com/asuu-fg-agreement.body: The Kaduna State University(KASU) branch of the Academic Staff Union of Universities(ASUU), has commended Governor Uba Sani for fully implementing the 2025 Federal Government-ASUU Agreement. In a press briefing on Friday, the union noted that the implementation of the agreement and the commitment to the welfare of academic staff, will enhance morale, improved productivity and strengthen industrial relations. The briefing which was delivered by Comrade Abubakar Abdullahi and Comrade Silas Amos Bakut, Chairman and Secretary respectively, also recalled other welfare initiatives that Governor Uba Sani had earlier extended to their members. According to the duo, the latest intervention represents a significant milestone in the development of the university and it is expected to contribute to the overall advancement of the institution. ‘’We consider this development a positive demonstration of the State Government’s recognition of the vital role of academic staff in advancing quality university education and sustainable development,’’ ASUU noted. The union commended Kaduna State Government and the Management of KASU for their commendable and exemplary handling of the earlier industrial action. ‘’For the avoidance of doubt, we wish to state categorically that, at no point during the strike action, were the union or its members subjected to intimidation, threats or any form of harassment. ‘’Remarkably, our salaries were paid while the strike was still ongoing, and engagements between the union, the Government and University Management remained cordial, constructive and focused on addressing the fundamental issues in dispute. ‘’This approach represents a significant departure from some of the unfortunate experiences of the past and demonstrates a renewed commitment to mutual respect, dialogue and the peaceful resolution of industrial disputes,’’ ASUU disclosed. ‘’Specifically, the Government has addressed the 60 percent withheld salary of 2017, paid outstanding Students Industrial Work Experience Scheme (SIWES) allowances for the period 2016-2020 and settled five months of withheld salaries covering May to September 2022,’’ the union disclosed. ‘’Furthermore, the Governing Council and Management of Kaduna State University are working collaboratively with the union towards resolving outstanding death benefits and promotion arrears dating from 2021,’’ ASUU added. While commending the Governor and the varsity management for demonstrating the leadership, courage and the political will required to address these longstanding challenges, the union noted that the interventions have brought considerable relief to affected members. The ASUU executives also listed other initiatives that the Kaduna State Government, under Governor Uba Sani, have extended to them in the last three and half years, to enhance staff welfare. ‘’Beyond the land allocation, His Excellency graciously approved a subsidy of 4,000,000,00 for each beneficiary, amounting to approximately 400,000,000.00 for the project. ‘’This intervention has reduced the cost of a housing unit from 40,000,000.00 to 136,000,000.00, thereby making homeownership more accessible to the beneficiaries,’’ ASUU pointed out. The union expressed appreciation for the genuine commitment in prioritising dialogue over confrontation and seeking sustainable solutions to their concerns, exhibited by Government and KASU Management. ‘’We reiterate our commitment to constructive engagement with the State Government, the Governing Council and University Management towards resolving all outstanding welfare issues, strengthening industrial harmony and positioning Kaduna State University among the leading universities in Nigeria and globally, ‘’ they promised. ASUU also commended the invaluable contributions, leadership and commitment of the Commissioner of Education and Chairman of the Negotiation Committee, Emeritus Professor Abubakar Sani Sambo. The union also praised the ‘’Chairman of the Governing Council, Dr. Ibrahim Umar; the Chairman of the Sub-Committee, Professor Usman Abubakar; and all other members of the Negotiation Committee for their dedication and concerted efforts towards resolving the issues in dispute.’’ Join Daily Trust WhatsApp Community For Quick Access To News and Happenings Around You

https://dailytrust.com/asuu-fg-agreement.body_zh: 卡杜纳州立大学（KASU）教职工工会全国高校学术工作人员工会（ASUU）分会赞扬州长乌巴·萨尼全面落实2025年联邦政府与ASUU的协议。工会于周五举行的新闻发布会上表示，落实该协议并承诺改善学术工作人员的福利，将提升士气、提高工作效率并加强劳资关系。新闻发布会由工会主席阿布巴卡尔·阿卜杜拉希和秘书西拉斯·阿莫斯·巴库特分别代表工会进行。会上还回顾了州长乌巴·萨尼此前为其成员提供的其他福利举措。两人表示，政府的最新干预措施是大学发展进程中的重要里程碑，预计将推动学校整体进步。ASUU指出：“我们认为，这一进展积极体现了州政府认可学术工作人员在推动优质大学教育和可持续发展方面发挥的关键作用。”工会赞扬卡杜纳州政府和KASU管理层妥善且堪称典范地处理了此前的劳资行动。工会称：“为避免任何疑问，我们郑重声明，在罢工行动期间，工会及其成员任何时候都未遭受恐吓、威胁或任何形式的骚扰。值得注意的是，罢工仍在进行期间，我们的工资就已获得支付；工会、政府与大学管理层之间的交涉始终保持友好、建设性，并专注于解决争议中的根本问题。这种做法与过去一些不幸经历相比有着显著不同，体现了各方重新承诺相互尊重、对话以及和平解决劳资争端。”ASUU透露：“具体而言，政府已补发2017年被扣留的60%工资，支付2016年至2020年期间尚未发放的学生工业工作经验计划（SIWES）津贴，并结清2022年5月至9月共5个月被扣留的工资。”工会补充道：“此外，卡杜纳州立大学理事会和管理层正与工会合作解决尚未落实的死亡福利以及自2021年以来积压的晋升待遇问题。”在赞扬州长和大学管理层展现出解决这些长期遗留问题所需的领导力、勇气和政治意愿的同时，工会指出，这些干预措施给受影响的成员带来了极大缓解。ASNU执行机构还列举了卡杜纳州政府在乌巴·萨尼州长领导下于过去三年半间为其成员提供的其他福利举措，以改善员工待遇。工会表示：“除土地分配外，阁下还慷慨批准为每位受益人提供4,000,000,00的补贴，该项目总额约为400,000,000.00。这项干预措施将每套住房的成本从40,000,000.00降至136,000,000.00，使受益人更容易实现拥有住房的愿望。”工会对政府和KASU管理层优先通过对话而非对抗、并 seeks seeking可持续解决方案解决其所关关切所表现出的真诚投入表示感谢。工会承诺：“我们重申，将与州政府、理事会和大学管理层保持建设性合作，解决所有尚未落实的福利问题，加强劳资和谐，并推动卡杜纳州立大学跻身尼日利亚乃至全球领先大学行列。”ASUU还赞扬了教育专员兼谈判委员会主席、荣休教授阿布巴卡尔·萨尼·桑博作出的宝贵贡献、领导力和投入。工会还表扬了理事会主席易卜拉欣·乌马尔博士、专门委员会主席乌斯曼·阿布巴卡尔教授以及谈判委员会其他全体成员，感谢他们为解决争议问题所作的奉献和共同努力。加入 Daily Trust WhatsApp 社群，即可快捷获取身边的新闻与动态

https://dailytrust.com/corps-members-kid.summary: The driver of the bus conveying the 20 prospective members of the National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) kidnapped in Imo State on Independence Day, has told the state High Court that the five suspects arrested by the Department of State Services (DSS) were the same persons who attacked his bus and abducted the persons on the fateful day.
https://dailytrust.com/corps-members-kid.summary_zh: 运送20名在独立日于伊莫州遭绑架的国家青年服务团（NYSC）准成员的巴士司机已向该州高等法院表示，国家安全局（DSS）逮捕的五名嫌疑人，正是在不幸袭击其巴士并绑架相关人员的同伙。
https://dailytrust.com/corps-members-kid.body: The driver of the bus conveying the 20 prospective members of the National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) kidnapped in Imo State on Independence Day, has told the state High Court that the five suspects arrested by the Department of State Services (DSS) were the same persons who attacked his bus and abducted the persons on the fateful day. Another prosecutoion witness identified as Mr. Light Timothy, also told the court that the he saw two of the five suspects wielding AK-47 rifles shortly after the abduction of the 20 prospective NYSC members along the Owerri–Mgbidi–Onitsha expressway. Both witnesses gave their testimonies at the resumed trial of the five suspected kidnappers on Friday at the high Court in Imo State. The witnesses maintained in their evidence in-chief and cross examination that they saw the defendants allegedly commit the crimes of conspiracy, hostage taking and unlawful possession of arms. The driver, who is the third witness, told the court that he could clearly identify the first defendant as the person who on the day of the attack, first approached his bus clutching an AK-47 rifle. The driver also stated that it was the first defendant he saw marching the 20 prospective NYSC members into the nearby bush after taking them hostage. In his testimony, Mr. Timothy told the court that, aside sighting the first and second accused persons after the abduction, he also identified both men as those who attacked the bus, at the identification parade conducted at the DSS state office. Under cross examination, the defence counsel demanded the identity card of the bus driver. The trial judge, Justice Emeka Orafu confirmed that the colour photograph on the identity card presented by the driver looked very much like him. Thereafter, testimonies of both witnesses, alongside the driver’s identity card, were admitted in evidence. At the conclusion of proceedings, the trial judge, Justice Orafu adjourned trial of both sets of suspects to November 3rd, 4th, 5th, and 6th, 2026, for continuation of hearing. https://dailytrust.com/corps-members-kid.body_zh: 在独立日于伊莫州遭绑架的20名国家青年服务团（NYSC）准成员的所乘巴士发生绑架案后，巴士司机已向该州高等法院表示，国家安全局（DSS）逮捕的5名嫌疑人，就是在事发当天袭击其巴士并绑架相关人员的同一批人。另一名控方案件证人Light Timothy先生也告诉法院，在20名NYSC准成员于奥韦里—姆格比迪—奥尼查高速公路上遭绑架后不久，他看到5名嫌疑人中的两人手持AK-47步枪。两名证人均于周五在伊莫州高等法院对5名疑似绑架者的案件复审中作证。证人在主询问和交叉询问中均坚持称，他们看到被告涉嫌实施共谋、劫持人质和非法持有武器等罪行。作为第三名证人，司机告诉法院，他能清楚辨认第一名被告人，即袭击当天首先手持AK-47步枪走近其巴士的人。司机还表示，正是他看到第一名被告在将这20名NYSC准成员劫持为人质后，押着他们进入附近的灌木丛。Timothy先生在证词中告诉法院，除了在绑架后看到第一和第二名被告外，他还在国家安全局州办公室进行的列队辨认中确认了这两人就是袭击巴士的人。在交叉询问中，辩方律师要求查看巴士司机的身份证。审判法官Emeka Orafu法官确认，司机出示的身份证上的彩色照片与其本人非常相像。此后，两名证人的证词连同司机的身份证均被采纳为证据。庭审结束时，审判法官Orafu法官将两组嫌疑人的审判延至2026年11月3日、4日、5日和6日继续举行。加入《每日信任报》WhatsApp社群，快速获取身边的新闻与动态

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: INCHEON — South Korea and the United States have complementary strengths and are capable of driving "great" progress in the nuclear sector amid a heated global race to develop next-generation reactors, a U.S. State Department official said. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: INCHEON — South Korea and the United States have complementary strengths and are capable of driving "great" progress in the nuclear sector amid a heated global race to develop next-generation reactors, a U.S. State Department official said. Christopher Klein, the deputy assistant secretary for nuclear nonproliferation and commercial competitiveness at the U.S. Department of State, made the remarks in an exclusive interview with Yonhap News Agency on Wednesday, saying the global landscape has transitioned into a "nuclear renaissance." "We are countries that both have a lot of experience and expertise, and when we work together ... we can achieve great things," Klein said during the interview on the margins of the International Ministerial Conference on Nuclear Power held in Incheon, west of Seoul. The three-day event, organized by the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA), was held in South Korea for the first time this year. Klein's comment comes amid growing attention to Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) — a new class of nuclear power plants -- as countries seek reliable, carbon-free power to meet surging electricity demand driven by artificial intelligence (AI) and data centers. The technology is viewed as a more flexible and potentially less costly alternative to traditional large-scale nuclear power plants. It also comes as the U.S. and South Korea have drawn closer in the SMR sector, with local companies actively partnering with U.S. firms in the development and construction of such reactors. SK Group made financial investments in TerraPower LLC, a U.S. nuclear power company founded by Bill Gates, in 2022 to develop and commercialize SMRs in the U.S. and global markets. Doosan Enerbility, a local nuclear power plant builder, has recently won a supply contract from the U.S.-based SMR developer NuScale Power to supply a key reactor component. Such tightening private sector ties are being reinforced by institutional efforts. In July, South Korea, the U.S. and Japan signed a memorandum of cooperation (MOC) to establish a government-led framework to combine their respective strengths in the nuclear sector to jointly respond to surging energy demand and geopolitical competition. The three countries agreed to work together in deploying nuclear reactors, supply chain optimization, and knowledge transfer and training, according to a fact sheet on the MOC. The trilateral agreement is still in its early stages, in which the three countries are closely communicating to identify where to start deploying SMRs together, the U.S. official said. But Washington hopes to move "quickly" toward some actual projects "as soon as possible," he noted. "I think working together, the United States, the Republic of Korea and Japan, we wouldn't just survive. ... We would thrive, and I think we would be a formidable competitor around the world (in the nuclear sector)," the official said, referring to South Korea by its official name. "I look forward to some big announcements to come. There's a big market out there, and there's a competition, and you got to be in it to win it."
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 美国国务院官员：韩国和美国能够在小型模块化反应堆方面取得“重大”进展
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 仁川——美国国务院官员表示，在全球竞相开发下一代反应堆的激烈竞争中，韩国和美国优势互补，有能力推动核能领域取得“重大”进展。美国国务院负责核不扩散与商业竞争力的副助理国务卿克里斯托弗·克莱恩周三接受韩联社独家采访时说，全球格局已经进入“核能复兴”时期。克莱恩是在首尔以西仁川举行的国际核电部长级会议期间接受采访的。他说：“我们两国都拥有丰富的经验和专业知识，而当我们携手合作时……就能取得重大成就。”这次为期三天的活动由国际原子能机构（IAEA）组织，今年首次在韩国举行。随着各国寻求可靠、无碳的电力，以满足人工智能（AI）和数据中心推动的用电需求激增，小型模块化反应堆（SMR）——一种新型核电站——受到越来越多的关注。这种技术被视为比传统大型核电站更灵活、且可能成本更低的替代方案。与此同时，美国和韩国在SMR领域的联系日益密切，韩国本土企业正积极与美国企业合作开发和建设此类反应堆。2022年，SK集团投资美国核电企业TerraPower LLC，以在美国和全球市场开发并商业化SMR；该公司由比尔·盖茨创立。韩国本土核电站制造商斗山能源近期获得了美国SMR开发商NuScale Power的供应合同，将供应一种关键反应堆部件。机构层面的努力也在加强这种私营部门联系。今年7月，韩国、美国和日本签署了一份合作谅解备忘录（MOC），拟建立政府主导的合作框架，整合三方在核能领域的优势，共同应对能源需求激增和地缘政治竞争。根据该谅解备忘录的概况文件，三国同意在部署核反应堆、优化供应链以及知识转移和培训方面开展合作。这名美国官员说，这项三方协议仍处于早期阶段，三国正密切沟通，确定从何处开始共同部署SMR。不过，他指出，华盛顿希望“尽快”推进相关工作，“尽早”落实具体项目。他说：“我认为，美国、大韩民国和日本如果携手合作，就不只是能够生存下去。……我们会蓬勃发展，而且我认为我们会成为全球核能领域里一支强大的竞争力量。”他以韩国的正式国名称呼该国。他表示：“我期待接下来能有一些重大消息公布。外面有一个巨大的市场，也存在竞争，而你必须参与其中，才能赢得竞争。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Security chief outlines response to DMZ mine blast, Ukraine policy, possible expansion of Cheonghae Unit National Security Adviser Wi Sung-lac said Friday that Seoul expects to make progress on the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) at defense talks with Washington early next year. Speaking at a press briefing at Cheong Wa Dae, Wi said the two countries plan to hold another defense ministers’ meeting in Washington in December, followed by the annual Security Consultative Meeting (SCM) in early 2027. “We expect to make substantive progress on the OPCON transfer,” Wi said. He said U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth reaffirmed Washington’s commitment to the transfer during Wednesday’s meeting with Defense Minister Kang Shin-chul in Cebu, Philippines. A senior presidential official said Washington was not opposed to the transfer itself, although the allies still needed to meet the agreed conditions. Wi also said the allies completed an assessment for full operational capability (FOC) verification during this year’s Ulchi Freedom Shield exercise, as part of the conditions-based transfer process. The SCM, traditionally held in the fall, had been expected to take place later this year but was postponed until early 2027. The allies have yet to announce when FOC verification will be completed or agree on a target year for the transfer. The postponement was due to scheduling issues, while the December talks are expected to cover North Korea’s nuclear and missile capabilities and broader alliance cooperation, according to the official. Regarding the land mine explosion in the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ), Wi said the government would continue taking necessary measures following the incident that injured South Korean soldiers south of the Military Demarcation Line (MDL) in September. “The government will continue to take necessary measures in response to the DMZ land mine explosion, guided by clear principles,” he said. Wi said Seoul conducted a joint investigation with the United Nations Command, demanded an apology and responsible measures from North Korea and destroyed the North Korean minefield at the site. The government also sent a letter to the U.N. Security Council and explained its position to other countries, he said. Wi added that the military was responding to North Korean crossings of the MDL under its operational guidelines, while Seoul had repeatedly proposed military talks to resolve differences in how the two sides identify the MDL. A senior presidential official said North Korea had rejected Seoul’s proposal for military talks, but the government had renewed its offer and was awaiting a response. Seoul would not recognize fences or other structures unilaterally erected by North Korea as an international border, the official added. On Ukraine, Wi said Seoul would maintain its support despite a diplomatic dispute with Kyiv over an alleged breach of a confidential agreement concerning the transfer of North Korean prisoners of war to South Korea. “We will continue to participate in international efforts to support Ukraine as a responsible member of the international community, separately from this issue,” he said. He said Seoul was continuing consultations with Kyiv to establish the facts and restore bilateral trust. Seoul would also maintain its sanctions against Russia and export controls, he added. Wi also said the government was considering expanding and strengthening the Cheonghae Unit, a naval contingent deployed to protect shipping in waters near the Strait of Hormuz. “We are considering options, including expanding and strengthening the Cheonghae Unit, but the review has not yet been completed,” he said. He stressed that Korea would not become involved in the war under any circumstances, while considering limited measures to protect Korean commercial vessels, secure oil shipping routes and safeguard its citizens. Wi said the government would explain its plans to the public and the National Assembly once a decision is made. Any relocation of the Cheonghae Unit or expansion of its operational area would require parliamentary approval, but the government has not yet developed a proposal for submission to the National Assembly, according to the official
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 首尔预计，2027年初与美国举行的防务会谈将在移交作战指挥权方面取得实质性进展
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国国家安全顾问 Wi Sung-lac 说明政府针对非军事区地雷爆炸、乌克兰政策及扩大清海部队的应对方案。Wi Sung-lac 周五表示，首尔预计明年初将与华盛顿举行防务会谈，在战时作战指挥权移交方面取得进展。Wi 在青瓦台举行的新闻发布会上说，两国计划于12月在华盛顿再次举行防务部长会议，随后于2027年初举行年度安全战略磋商会议。他说：“我们预计将在战时作战指挥权移交方面取得实质性进展。”他表示，美国国防部长 Pete Hegseth 周三在菲律宾宿务与国防部长 Kang Shin-chul 会晤时，重申了华盛顿对移交战时作战指挥权的承诺。一名总统府高级官员说，华盛顿本身并不反对移交，但双方盟友仍需满足既定条件。Wi 还说，在以条件为基础的移交程序中，双方盟友已于今年“乙巳自由护盾”军演期间完成全面作战能力核查。安全战略磋商会议通常于秋季举行，原本预计今年稍晚举行，但已推迟至2027年初。双方盟友尚未宣布何时完成全面作战能力核查，也未就移交目标年份达成一致。该名官员表示，推迟是由于日程安排问题，而12月的会谈预计将讨论朝鲜的核与导弹能力以及更广泛的联盟合作。关于非军事区地雷爆炸事件，Wi 说，政府将继续采取必要措施，以应对今年9月军事分界线以南发生地雷爆炸并造成韩国士兵受伤的事件。他说：“政府将在明确原则的指导下，继续采取必要措施，应对非军事区地雷爆炸事件。”Wi 说，首尔与联合国司令部进行了联合调查，要求朝鲜道歉并采取负责任的措施，还摧毁了事发地点的朝鲜雷区。他说，政府还向联合国安理会提交了信函，并向其他国家说明了韩方立场。Wi 补充说，军方正依据行动准则应对朝鲜越过军事分界线的行为，而首尔已多次提议举行军事会谈，以解决双方对军事分界线认定方式存在的分歧。一名总统府高级官员说，朝鲜拒绝了首尔举行军事会谈的提议，但政府已再次提出，正在等待回应。该官员补充说，首尔不会承认朝鲜单方面设置的围栏或其他设施为国际边界。在乌克兰问题上，Wi 说，尽管首尔与基辅因据称违反一项有关将朝鲜战俘移交韩国的保密协议而发生外交争端，但首尔仍会维持对乌支持。他说：“我们将继续参与国际社会支持乌克兰的国际行动，并独立处理这一问题。”他说，首尔正继续与基辅磋商，以查明事实并恢复双边信任。他补充说，首尔还将维持对俄罗斯的制裁和出口管制。Wi 还说，政府正在考虑扩大并加强清海部队；这是一支部署在霍尔木兹海峡附近水域、用于保护航运的海军部队。他说：“我们正在考虑包括扩大和加强清海部队在内的各种方案，但相关评估尚未完成。”他强调，韩国无论如何都不会卷入战争，同时正考虑采取有限措施保护韩国商船、保障石油运输线路安全并保护韩国公民。Wi 说，一旦作出决定，政府将向公众和国会说明有关计划。该名官员表示，调动清海部队或扩大其行动区域均须获得国会批准，但政府尚未制定提交国会的方案。

https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/.body: With its all-stock acquisition of European Lithium now moving toward the issue of new shares, Critical Metals ( NASDAQ:CRML ) is sliding as critical minerals peers pull back after the previous session’s rally. Critical Metals stock is at $7.59, down 7% during the morning session. Meanwhile, USA Rare Earth ( NASDAQ:USAR ) stock is at $10.07, down 3%. United States Antimony ( NYSEAMERICAN:UAMY ) stock is at $3.22, down 3%. Critical Metals disclosed on October 27 that its schemes of arrangement to acquire 100% of European Lithium’s issued share capital and all of its listed options became effective after approval by the Supreme Court of Western Australia. Eligible European Lithium shareholders receive 0.045 new shares per European Lithium share under the share scheme. On October 28, Critical Metals confirmed the option scheme consideration at 0.0353158621 new Critical Metals shares per European Lithium option, or approximately 35.32 shares for every 1,000 options, subject to rounding. That ratio comes from a cashless exercise formula, which converts options into stock without option owners paying cash to exercise them. According to Critical Metals, the formula used a scheme volume-weighted average price (VWAP) of $7.25. The record date is October 29, followed by implementation and the issue of new shares on November 5, with trading on Nasdaq expected to begin November 6. Those dates are preliminary and subject to change, the company noted. Paying for an acquisition with newly issued stock raises the share count at Critical Metals, which spreads ownership of the company across more shares, but no total share count for the issuance appears in the releases, so the size of that dilution isn’t clear yet. For existing shareholders, the coming batch of stock is an burden to consider alongside the sector’s pullback. European Lithium’s interests tie into the Tanbreez rare earth project in Southern Greenland, which Critical Metals calls one of the world’s largest rare earth deposits. Critical Metals also holds the Wolfsberg lithium project in Austria, described by the company as the first fully permitted mine in Europe. Each asset remains pre-revenue, and the company’s own reports have raised substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern. That risk profile stands against a strong run for Critical Metals stock, which climbed sharply over the past week and is up 14% year to date (YTD). Both USA Rare Earth and United States Antimony are down more than Critical Metals. Year to date, USA Rare Earth stock is down 15%, though the company is building a U.S.-based rare earth magnet supply chain. United States Antimony stock is down 36% YTD, even as the company already generates revenue from antimony and zeolite and supplies the U.S. defense supply chain under a sole-source Defense Logistics Agency contract. MP Materials ( NYSE:MP ) stock is at $40, down 2%. Shares of MP Materials are down 20% YTD. A pullback after the previous session’s group rally fits the declines across MP Materials, USA Rare Earth and United States Antimony. A key question for Critical Metals is whether former European Lithium shareholders sell their new stock once it can trade. A smooth debut after the record date and the early-November issue could ease the burden, while heavy selling could add pressure. Progress on Tanbreez development and funding may matter as much, since Critical Metals is still seeking project financing for both projects. Interest rates are another factor, with the Federal Reserve’s policy decision due October 28 and the upper bound of the federal funds target range at 4% heading in. Speculative pre-revenue small caps like Critical Metals tend to be sensitive to rate expectations, so a dovish tone could lift risk appetite while a hawkish one could weigh on the group. A conservative approach could make sense while the burden from the new Critical Metals shares resolves. Lithium全部已发行股本及所有上市期权的安排方案已生效。根据股份方案，符合资格的European Lithium股东每持有1股European Lithium股份，可获得0.045股Critical Metals新股。10月28日，Critical Metals确认，期权方案的对价为每份European Lithium期权换取0.0353158621股Critical Metals新股，即每1,000份期权约可获得35.32股，具体数量将按取整规则调整。该比例来自一项无现金行权公式，可将期权转换为股票，期权持有人无需支付现金即可行权。据Critical Metals称，该公式采用每7.25美元安排成交量加权平均价（VWAP）计算。记录日为10月29日，随后将实施相关安排并于11月5日发行新股，预计11月6日开始在Nasdaq交易。公司指出，这些日期暂定，可能变更。使用新发行股票支付收购对价会提高Critical Metals的股份总数，使公司所有权分散至更多股份，但相关公告没有披露本次发行的股份总数，因此目前尚不清楚摊薄规模。对现有股东而言，即将发行的这批股票所构成的压力，需要结合该板块的回调一并考量。European Lithium的权益涉及格陵兰南部的Tanbreez稀土项目，Critical Metals称其为全球最大的稀土矿藏之一。Critical Metals还持有位于奥地利的Wolfsberg锂项目，公司将其描述为欧洲第一座获得全部许可的矿山。每项资产目前均未产生收入，公司自身报告也对其持续经营能力提出重大疑问。这一风险状况与Critical Metals股价此前强势上涨形成反差，该股过去一周大幅攀升，年初至今（YTD）上涨14%。USA Rare Earth和United States Antimony的跌幅均超过Critical Metals。USA Rare Earth股价年初至今下跌15%，尽管该公司正在建设总部位于美国的稀土磁体供应链。United States Antimony股价年初至今下跌36%，尽管该公司已经通过锑和沸石业务创造收入，并依据独家供应商合同向美国国防供应链供货，合同方为Defense Logistics Agency。MP Materials（NYSE:MP）股价报40美元，下跌2%，其股价年初至今下跌20%。在上一交易日板块集体上涨后出现回调，与MP Materials、USA Rare Earth和United States Antimony的下跌相符。Critical Metals面临的一个关键问题是，European Lithium原股东是否会在新股票能够交易后将其卖出。若股票在记录日后及11月初发行后平稳上市，压力可能得到缓解；若出现大量抛售，则可能加剧下行压力。Tanbreez项目的开发进展和资金筹措同样值得关注，因为Critical Metals仍在为这两个项目寻求项目融资。利率也是另一项影响因素，美联储定于10月28日公布政策决定，联邦基金目标区间上限正逐步升至4%。Critical Metals这类尚无收入的小盘投机股往往对利率预期十分敏感，因此，鸽派表态可能提振风险偏好，而鹰派表态则可能对整个板块构成压力。在新增Critical Metals股票带来的压力消化完毕前，采取保守策略或许更为合理。David Moadel是专门研究股票、ETF、期权、贵金属和Bitcoin的财经撰稿人。David已为多家知名在线出版物撰写远超1,000篇文章，帮助投资者理解市场、收益策略和风险。他的作品发表于The Motley Fool、InvestorPlace、U.S. News & World Report、TipRanks、ValueWalk、Benzinga、Market Realist、TalkMarkets、Finmasters、24/7 Wall St.等媒体。David拥有教育学硕士学位，曾在小学、高中和大学层级任教。这段教学经历塑造了他的写作风格：清晰、具有教育意义且实用。David还通过在YouTube、X/Twitter和StockTwits提供可信的财经内容，积累了忠实的社交媒体受众。European Lithium股东刚刚将一个备受关注的格陵兰稀土项目的完全控制权交给Critical Metals，但市场对买方的惩罚几乎甚于该板块其他任何公司。以下是……市场动态 Critical Metals飙升19%，MP Materials和United States Antimony落后：European Lithium合并是否推动股价变动？Critical Metals股价飙升近20%，而其稀土同业持平或继续走低，却没有公司公告解释这一差距。交易员圈子里反复出现一个未经核实的催化剂，而且它……一项炼厂研究刚刚为Critical Metals投资者提供了一个可供争论的具体金额，该股正在上涨，而其根基更稳固的同业几乎纹丝不动。这种差距究竟反映了真正的估值重估，还是……市场动态 忘掉MP Materials，这只矿业股上涨274%，并持有3.54亿美元的五角大楼合同，另一只则掌控中国境外最大的稀土矿藏 MP Materials（NYSE:MP）不断凭借其持有的五角大楼股权以及Apple承购前景抢占稀土市场聚光灯，而这恰恰是问题所在。MP相关交易拥挤、入场偏晚，而且……在稀土股随着大盘上涨而下跌之际，一家关键矿产生产商凭借一份多数投资者才刚刚发现的独家供应商军事合同，正朝相反方向疾驰。市场动态 2026年上涨158%，Critical Metals是否已经涨得太高？Critical Metals（NASDAQ:CRML）股价昨日暴涨32.6%，此前公司宣布其位于格陵兰南部的Tanbreez稀土项目2025年钻探计划首批化验结果。结果确认了更多高品位……United States Antimony今早飙升8%，既没有新闻稿，也没有业绩或当日备案文件作出解释，而更广泛的关键矿产板块悄然走低。这只股票背后有什么因素在推动，以及……市场动态 格陵兰涨势遭遇获利回吐，Critical Metals下跌6%；USA Rare Earth走低，MP Materials回落 一项格陵兰安全协议推动Critical Metals周一飙升，但周二出现剧烈反转，而这与Tanbreez项目本身无关。以下是同业板块及更广泛的……

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body: The Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Nyesom Wike, has commended Dunamis International Gospel Centre (DIGC) for building a pedestrian bridge along the busy Airport Road, Abuja. Mr Wike gave the commendation in Abuja on Friday during the inauguration of the pedestrian bridge built at the Church headquarters, the 100,000-capacity Glory Dome, Abuja. He described the project as an exemplary model of Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR). The minister revealed that while the church applied for approval to construct the facility in 2018, the application was brought to his attention only in February 2026, leading to swift approval within one month. He described the approval as evidence of President Bola Tinubu’s commitment to good governance, urging members of the Church to support government with proven capacity to respond to the needs of the people. He said, “Government cannot do everything alone; there is nowhere in the world where government carries every burden. That is why we emphasise comprehensive social responsibility.” To further encourage community-driven infrastructure, the minister announced that the FCT Administration (FCTA) would defray 50 per cent of the total cost the church incurred in constructing the bridge. He commended the Senior Pastor of Dunamis, Paul Enenche, and his wife, Becky Enenche, for demonstrating leadership and sacrificing church resources to save lives and enhance human welfare rather than focusing solely on soul-winning. The minister, however, decried the habitual refusal of many pedestrians to use constructed bridges, choosing instead to risk their lives crossing high-speed expressways. He warned against continuous public criticism of government actions on social media when enforcement measures were deployed to maintain public order and safety. Earlier, Mr Enenche, the senior pastor of the DIGC, said the decision to construct the pedestrian bridge was borne out of concern over the frequent fatal accidents recorded along the Airport Road axis. He urged public-spirited individuals and leaders to live for societal impact and keep eternity in view, emphasising that resources must be deployed for the collective good of humanity. On her part, the senator representing the FCT, Ireti Kingibe, commended the church for backing its faith with compassionate action. Mrs Kingibe described the ministry as “a beacon of light” and urged residents and leaders across the territory to unite to build a safer, more peaceful capital
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.title_zh: Wike赞扬Dunamis Church为阿布贾建造人行天桥
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body_zh: Federal Capital Territory (FCT) 部长 Nyesom Wike 赞扬 Dunamis International Gospel Centre (DIGC) 在阿布贾繁忙的 Airport Road 沿线修建了一座人行天桥。周五，Wike 先生在阿布贾可容纳100,000人的教会总部 Glory Dome 举行的这座人行天桥竣工仪式上表达了上述赞扬。他称该项目是企业社会责任 (CSR) 的典范。部长透露，该教会于2018年申请批准建设这座设施，但直到2026年2月才提交他审议，随后在1个月内迅速获批。他称此次批准证明 President Bola Tinubu 致力于推行良政，并鼓励该教会成员支持政府，因为政府已经展现出回应民众需求的实际能力。他说：“政府无法独自完成所有事情；世界上没有任何地方由政府承担一切责任。因此，我们强调全面社会责任。”为进一步鼓励社区主导的基础设施建设，部长宣布，FCT Administration (FCTA) 将承担该教会修建这座天桥所产生总成本的50%。他还赞扬 Dunamis 高级牧师 Paul Enenche 及其妻子 Becky Enenche 展现出领导力，并奉献教会资源来挽救生命、改善人类福祉，而不是仅仅专注于使人灵魂得救。不过，部长谴责许多行人习惯性拒绝使用已经建成的天桥，反而选择冒险穿越高速公路，置自身生命于险境。他警告，当局为维护公共秩序与安全而采取执法措施时，不应在社交媒体上持续批评政府的行动。此前，DIGC 高级牧师 Enenche 先生表示，决定修建这座人行天桥，是因为担忧 Airport Road 沿线频繁发生致命事故。他敦促富有公益精神的人士和领袖以社会影响为人生追求，并始终着眼永恒，强调资源必须用于全人类的共同福祉。代表 FCT 的参议员 Ireti Kingibe 也赞扬该教会以富有同理心的行动践行信仰。Kingibe 女士称这一事工是“一盏明灯”，并敦促全境居民和领袖团结起来，共同建设一个更安全、更和平的首都

https://leadership.ng/ncdmb-un-women-con.summary: Central to this effort is expanding access to the dedicated $40 million Women in Oil and Gas Fund, ensuring that more women-owned businesses and professionals benefit from industry’s opportunities and play a stronger role across the sector’s value chain. In April 2021, the NCDMB established a $20 million fund dedicated to supporting women-owned and women-led businesses in the oil and gas sector.
https://leadership.ng/ncdmb-un-women-con.summary_zh: 这项努力的核心是扩大对专项4000万美元“石油与天然气女性基金”的准入，确保更多女性拥有的企业和专业人士能够受益于行业机会，并在整个行业价值链中发挥更重要的作用。2021年4月，尼日利亚本地内容开发与监督委员会设立了一笔2000万美元的专项基金，用于支持石油和天然气行业由女性拥有及女性领导的企业。
https://leadership.ng/ncdmb-un-women-con.body: Central to this effort is expanding access to the dedicated $40 million Women in Oil and Gas Fund, ensuring that more women-owned businesses and professionals benefit from industry’s opportunities and play a stronger role across the sector’s value chain. In April 2021, the NCDMB established a $20 million fund dedicated to supporting women-owned and women-led businesses in the oil and gas sector. The Nigerian Export-Import Bank (NEXIM) complemented this effort by matching the fund with an additional $20 million. However, despite this significant commitment and favorable loan terms, the uptake of the scheme has remained below expectations to date. On Thursday, UN Women’s Country Representative to Nigeria and the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS), Ms. Beatrice Eyong, led a delegation to the Nigerian Content Development and Monitoring Board’s (NCDMB) Abuja liaison office. The team was received by the Board’s General Manager of Corporate Communications, Dr. Obinna Ezeobi, on behalf of the Executive Secretary, Engr. Felix Omatsola Ogbe. The meeting explored proposed capacity-building initiatives for NCDMB personnel, aimed at mainstreaming gender perspectives into the Board’s project planning, budgeting, and execution frameworks. Other key areas of discussion included vendor development schemes to better position women-led oil and gas businesses for industry opportunities, strategies to raise awareness of available financing options, and potential affirmative procurement measures designed to expand the participation of women-owned companies across the oil and gas value chain. The UN official commended NCDMB for its ongoing gender inclusion efforts, noting that the Board is already implementing several measures consistent with its mandate. She proposed conducting a study to identify the reasons women face challenges in accessing the financing facility, including potential barriers related to documentation, business registration, tax compliance, and limited awareness. She further highlighted key initiatives currently being undertaken by the UN Office, such as programs on women’s economic empowerment, leadership development, and the elimination of gender-based violence, among others. NCDMB’s General Manager of Corporate Communications, Dr. Obinna Ezeobi, welcomed the proposals and affirmed the Board’s readiness to partner with UN Women. He highlighted several innovative initiatives already implemented by the Board to create opportunities for women to participate, grow, and lead in Nigeria’s oil and gas industry. These include the establishment of a dedicated funding scheme with NEXIM Bank that enables women-owned or women-led firms to access financing at a highly competitive 5% interest rate, as well as the creation of a Diversity Sectoral Working Group within the Nigerian Content Consultative Forum (NCCF), designed to mainstream women’s issues into local content policy and decision-making processes. The Board also supports associations of women who work across the Energy Industry value chain, where they network, build confidence and links to progress their careers or businesses. Dr. Ezeobi noted that NCDMB has also invested significantly in capacity-building programs for women entrepreneurs and business leaders, covering critical areas such as business sustainability, corporate governance, and strategic management. The Board has further supported women’s participation in technical occupations while encouraging young girls to pursue careers in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM). He acknowledged that women remain underrepresented in the oil and gas industry, citing limited access to technical education, finance, and commercial opportunities, as well as entrenched perceptions of the sector as predominantly male. Dr. Ezeobi reaffirmed NCDMB’s willingness to collaborate with UN Women to address these challenges and recommended strategies to accelerate the Board’s support for UN Women’s programmes, thereby advancing gender inclusion across the industry.
