https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/27/s.title_zh: 州警察：总统指示私营部门制定全面融资和实施方案
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/27/s.body_zh: 总统府已责成全国有组织私营部门为拟议中的州警察制度制定一套全面的融资与实施蓝图。总统府表示，企业必须积极参与建设维护投资、创造就业和增强经济韧性所需的安全机构。总统幕僚长兼国家警务法案总统工作组主席Femi Gbajabiamila阁下提出这一任务，并特别要求尼日利亚经济峰会组织（NESG）、商会和商业协会提出切实可行的融资方案、机构管理方案以及问责伙伴关系，以支持警务权力下放。他说，私营部门与改革成效直接相关，因为不安全状况已通过供应链中断、投资搁置、工厂扩建推迟和经济机会流失，给企业造成巨额成本。Gbajabiamila在阿布贾举行的第32届尼日利亚经济峰会“安全、稳定与经济韧性”全体会议上发言时表示，总统Bola Tinubu推动建立州警察，为企业直接参与建设支撑可持续经济增长的安全机构创造了机会。“因此，我请尼日利亚经济峰会组织把这项工作延伸到本次会议之外。认真提出私营部门关于州警察融资与实施的贡献意见，并就问责伙伴关系提出切实可行的建议。“将这项工作纳入立法进程，以及你们与州政府的沟通之中。就我们而言，我们仍负责把改革转化为公众可以信赖的保护措施。”他说。Gbajabiamila敦促商业领袖就拟议改革与州长和议员沟通，并提请他们关注有效的地方警务、创造就业与投资决策之间的关系。他解释称，企业管理机构、控制支出和评估风险的经验，可以强化新警务框架的设计与实施。他说，有组织私营部门还应提供安全失灵导致原本可行的投资无法推进的证据，使政策制定者能够确定哪里最迫切需要增加安全能力。“他的话是：“你们的参与还应提升改革的实质内容。随着立法进程推进，请审查有关融资和监督的各项建议。“请把你们管理机构和控制支出的经验带入讨论，帮助我们了解阻碍可行项目推进的安全失灵问题。”不过，这位幕僚长警告称，私营部门参与必须保持透明，绝不能损害警察机构的独立性。他说，企业可以在通信基础设施、设备维护和财务规划方面贡献专业知识，但此类伙伴关系必须在界限明确的法律和问责框架内运作。“凡是企业提供资源，这些投入都必须公布账目并接受独立审查。“公共资金必须保持稳定可靠，任何捐赠都绝不能换取对调查的影响力或优待待遇。目标是强化一项每位公民都能信赖的公共服务。”他警告道。Gbajabiamila表示，政府决心建立财政上可持续的州警察机构，并强调，希望运营自有警察服务的州必须证明其有能力承担经常性支出义务。他说，行动启动时提供车辆、制服和其他设备并不足够，还必须为人员薪资、专业培训和行动维护作出可持续安排。“财务准备同样重要。一个承担警务任务的州，必须能够在初步购置车辆和制服后继续维持该服务。“按时发放薪酬和持续培训是专业履职的必要条件。一个无法履行对警员义务的机构，会容易受到私人资助方控制以及非法公共要求的侵蚀。”他提醒道。这位幕僚长保证，对于尚未在财政或机构层面做好自建警察服务准备的州，联邦警务仍将继续运作。在介绍立法进程进展时，Gbajabiamila确认，截至2026年10月23日，已有24个州议会批准了关于设立州警察的宪法修正案，达到法定三分之二门槛。他透露，总统工作组已于10月19日向联邦司法部提交《国家警务法案》草案和29项配套修正案，供立法审议。他说，在完成审议和工作组最终审议后，这些提案将提交总统Tinubu批准，再送交国民议会。他解释称，拟议框架将使有意愿且有能力的州承担更多保护本州居民的责任，同时保留强大的联邦警察机构，以应对跨州犯罪活动和其他专业国家安全需求。Gbajabiamila说，这项改革旨在纠正一种结构性失衡，即州政府须应对不安全状况造成的后果，却无权组织警务。“让警务更贴近其服务的社区，可以改善地方情报工作，并缩短从求助到有效响应之间的时间。”他解释道。针对州警察可能被部署用于对付政治对手的担忧，他向尼日利亚人保证，拟议立法将包含可执行的保障措施、国家专业标准和独立监督机制。“警察权力可能被用于对付政治对手或弱势社区，这种担忧十分严肃。我们的应对办法是对这些权力设置可执行的限制，并在权力遭滥用时提供救济。“公民获得保护的权利不能取决于其支持谁或来自哪里。”这位幕僚长宣称。他说，该框架受益于与州政府、安全机构、公众成员以及由公共和私营部门人员组成的政策咨询委员会进行的磋商。Gbajabiamila解释企业为何应支持这项改革时表示，不安全状况对投资决策造成的影响，远远超出雇佣私人保安人员所带来的直接财务负担。他说：“现行安排的成本已经计入你们的账目。你们为额外安保和交付中断付费。“你们还承担从未作为单独费用出现的损失，例如工厂扩建推迟，或某个适宜生产的地点被排除在投资计划之外。”他论证称，如果周边社区仍不安全，企业仅靠保护自身场所无法保障持续运营。他说：“企业可以加强外围防护，但员工仍要回家，供应商仍要经过周边社区。“你们的长期安全取决于大门之外公共机构的力量。”谈及政府更广泛的安全干预措施时，Gbajabiamila表示，总统Tinubu支持通过将直升机列装陆军航空兵以及恢复100多辆经过翻新的装甲战斗车辆投入现役，推动武装部队现代化。他回忆称，总统于6月为其余3艘海军舰艇主持启用，以加强海上安全，并指出，针对原油盗取的持续行动已促进石油产量、外汇收入和政府财政收入增加。在粮食安全方面，这位幕僚长披露，政府已在19个州和联邦首都地区部署10,000名Agro-Rangers，以促进农业生产与安全保障相结合。他解释称，政府认识到，如果不保障农民能够进入自己的土地，对改良种子、农业信贷和其他支持计划的投入将难有成效。“在土地所有者因害怕而不敢耕种的农田上，改良种子和信贷获取都难以发挥作用。安全保障才能使这些农业干预措施真正落地。”Gbajabiamila还强调总统森林守卫倡议，根据该倡议，截至2025年12月，来自7个前线州的7,000多名人员已完成训练，以支持在犯罪团伙活动地区的安全行动。他透露，总统Tinubu已于8月指示编制《国家威胁评估》和滚动五年期《战略防务行动计划》，以改善协调工作、使安全支出与行动重点保持一致，并强化机构问责。Gbajabiamila承认，尽管政府不断增加安全投入，尼日利亚人仍持续面临绑架和暴力袭击威胁，但他表示，政府认识到，其成效最终必须以公民安全来衡量。“生活在绑架或袭击威胁中的尼日利亚人，有权依据自身安全状况评价我们。我们认识到，国家能力提升与每个社区都获得可靠保护之间仍有差距。”这位幕僚长进一步将政府的安全干预与其经济改革计划联系起来，包括取消燃油补贴、外汇结构调整和税收改革。他承认，这些改革给家庭和企业带来了相当大的压力，但坚持认为，经济生产率与安全相互依存。“收入不足的政府无法维持保护公民所需的机构。在人们无法安全工作的情况下，经济也无法创造政府所需的收入。“因此，我们不得不同时处理这两个问题，尽管转型成本已对尼日利亚家庭和企业造成相当大的压力。”这位幕僚长解释道。Gbajabiamila敦促投资者因安全状况改善而重返那些商业活动曾受干扰的地区，并认为，恢复投资将创造就业、恢复本地供应链并扩大公共收入。他向商业领袖保证，政府欢迎建设性批评和切实可行的建议，并强调，总统Tinubu正视长期结构性挑战的意愿，需要所有利益相关方持续合作。“返乡的农民和重新开业的雇主将在为家人的未来作出决定。我们共同的努力必须给他们充分理由继续前进。”THISDAY于1995年1月22日创刊，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，社址位于尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕克里克路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都地区以及世界各地设有办公室。它是尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，通过全平台面向政治、商业、专业和外交精英及更广泛的中产阶级报道，同时为有抱负者和千禧一代提供新思想、文化与技术的交汇平台。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.title: Dangote Refinery’s historic IPO nets investors from 120 countries worldwide, 54 in Africa
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.summary: Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals has successfully concluded its landmark Initial Public Offering (IPO), attracting investor applications from 120 countries across all six inhabited continents, including all 54 African countries.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.summary_zh: 丹格特炼油与石化公司已成功完成其里程碑式首次公开募股（IPO），吸引了来自全球六个有人居住大洲120个国家的投资者申请，其中包括非洲全部54个国家。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.body: Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals has successfully concluded its landmark Initial Public Offering (IPO), attracting investor applications from 120 countries across all six inhabited continents, including all 54 African countries. In a statement on Tuesday, the company described the development as an unprecedented demonstration of the continent’s capacity to mobilise capital and broaden ownership of strategic industrial assets. The historic offering, widely described as The People’s IPO, achieved 100 per cent geographical coverage of Africa, bringing together investors from across the continent and beyond in a transaction that could redefine the scale, accessibility and international reach of African capital markets. More than a conventional fundraising exercise, the IPO has become a landmark in financial inclusion, showing how digital technology, coordinated financial institutions, and innovative distribution channels can connect millions of potential investors to opportunities previously dominated by institutional and high-net-worth participants. The transaction was supported by an extensive network of commercial banks, stockbroking firms, fintech platforms, capital market institutions and distribution partners, whose collaboration expanded access to the offer across national boundaries and created new pathways for retail participation. For Dangote Industries Limited, the IPO’s conclusion marks a defining moment in its industrial journey, shifting the refinery’s ownership proposition from an investment driven by a single entrepreneurial vision to an opportunity for broader African participation. President and Chief Executive of Dangote Industries Limited, Aliko Dangote, described the outcome as a powerful affirmation of African confidence, enterprise, and the continent’s ability to mobilise its own resources for development. “When we set out to build this refinery, many doubted that a project of this scale could be delivered by Africans. We proved that Africa could build it. Today, through this historic IPO, we have demonstrated something equally important: Africans are ready to own and participate in the prosperity created by their own industries. “To have investor applications from all 54 African countries is deeply significant to me. It shows our people don’t just want to consume what Africa produces; they want to invest in it, own it, and share in its future. This is the Africa we have always believed in,” he said. “We did not undertake this IPO simply because we needed to raise capital. We wanted to open the doors of ownership, give ordinary Africans an opportunity to participate in an enterprise of global significance and establish a new culture of shared prosperity. We built the refinery in Africa, through African determination, and its future must create opportunities for Africans. “Today, we have made history together. But the greater achievement will be the generation of African investors, entrepreneurs, and industrialists that this transaction inspires. Our ambition is not merely to build successful businesses. It is to help build a prosperous, self-reliant Africa whose people are participants in its economic destiny. As we advance our expansion programme and Vision 2030 strategy, we remain committed to strengthening our operational performance, deepening our contribution to Africa’s energy security and building an enterprise that rewards the confidence placed in it.” The statement said the IPO’s geographical reach is particularly significant for a continent where capital markets have historically been fragmented by national boundaries, differing regulatory environments and limited retail investor participation. By attracting applications from all 54 African countries, the transaction has shown the potential for a more connected investment ecosystem, allowing Africans to participate in major industrial opportunities beyond their domestic markets. The offering also highlights the growing importance of digital financial infrastructure in widening investment access. Through partnerships involving traditional financial institutions and technology-driven investment platforms, the transaction created multiple channels for eligible investors to express interest and submit applications. Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals, David Bird, said the international response reflected confidence in the refinery’s operating capabilities, industrial scale and long-term growth prospects. “The successful conclusion of this IPO is a remarkable milestone for Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals. Investor applications from 120 countries demonstrate extraordinary international interest in our business and the confidence investors place in this refinery’s future. We have built one of the world’s most significant refining and petrochemical complexes, and our focus remains on translating that industrial scale into operational excellence, sustainable growth and long-term shareholder value,” he said. “What makes this transaction particularly meaningful is the breadth of participation. The opportunity to own a stake in a major African industrial enterprise has reached investors across every African country and all six inhabited continents. That is a powerful endorsement of the refinery’s potential and of Africa’s growing relevance in global investment markets.” The refinery’s IPO opened on 14 September, offering 4.1 billion ordinary shares at N525 per share, representing a proposed capital raise of approximately N2.15 trillion. Initially scheduled to close on 13 October, the offer was extended to 27 October after the Securities and Exchange Commission approved it, giving investors across Africa and other international markets more time to participate. The extension reflected the Group’s stated ambition to prioritise broad ownership alongside the transaction’s financial objectives. Beyond the refinery’s industrial significance, the IPO also established a model for collaboration across Africa’s financial services ecosystem. Its distribution network brought together institutions across banking, securities trading, financial technology, and investor engagement, showing how coordinated infrastructure can expand access to large-scale investment opportunities. Dangote Industries Limited Group Chief Financial Officer Murat Erden said the transaction set an important precedent for the continent’s capital markets, speaking to the offering’s execution and broader significance. “The Dangote Refinery People’s IPO represents much more than a landmark capital-raising exercise. It marks a defining moment in the evolution of African capital markets, demonstrating our continent’s ability to mobilise domestic savings, connect investors across borders and broaden ownership of strategic industrial assets. Reaching investors in 120 countries, including all 54 African nations, is an extraordinary achievement and a powerful testament to the continent’s growing appetite for investment. By bringing together banks, capital market institutions, stockbrokers, fintech platforms and innovative digital distribution channels, we have demonstrated that African capital markets can transcend national boundaries and connect millions of people to investment opportunities previously beyond their reach,” he said. “Importantly, this transaction is underpinned by exceptional industrial and financial fundamentals. With US$22.5 billion in revenue and US$5.52 billion in EBITDA in the first nine months of 2026, Dangote Refinery combines world-class industrial scale, strong profitability and significant long-term growth potential. Our greatest achievement is not simply the capital we mobilise, but the doors we open and the foundation we lay for future generations of African investors, entrepreneurs and businesses. We believe the People’s IPO will be remembered not only as a landmark transaction in African capital market history, but also as a blueprint for a more inclusive, interconnected and globally competitive African financial ecosystem — one in which Africans increasingly finance, own and share in the prosperity created by their continent’s industrial transformation.” The successful conclusion of the offer comes as Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals pursues an ambitious programme to expand its refining and petrochemical operations, strengthen its distribution network and support greater energy security across Africa. Located in Lagos, the refinery represents one of the continent’s largest private industrial investments and a major effort to reduce dependence on imported refined petroleum products while building domestic processing capacity
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.title_zh: Dangote炼油厂历史性首次公开募股吸引全球120个国家的投资者，其中54个来自非洲
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.body_zh: 丹格特炼油与石化公司已成功完成其具有里程碑意义的首次公开募股（IPO），吸引了来自六大有人居住洲120个国家的投资者申购申请，其中包括非洲全部54个国家。该公司周二发表声明称，这一进展前所未有地展现了非洲大陆调动资本、扩大战略工业资产所有权覆盖范围的能力。此次历史性发行被广泛称为“人民IPO”，实现了对非洲100%的地域覆盖，将非洲各地乃至海外投资者汇聚到一起完成交易，可能重新定义非洲资本市场的规模、可及性和国际影响力。这次IPO不只是传统的融资活动，更成为金融普惠的里程碑，展示了数字技术、协同配合的金融机构以及创新分销渠道如何将数百万潜在投资者与过去主要由机构投资者和高净值人士主导的投资机会连接起来。此次交易得到了广泛商业银行、证券经纪公司、金融科技平台、资本市场机构和分销合作伙伴网络的支持，各方协作突破了国界限制、扩大了本次发行的参与范围，并为散户参与开辟了新路径。对丹格特集团有限公司而言，IPO的完成标志着其工业发展历程中的决定性时刻，使该炼油厂的所有权模式从依靠单一企业家愿景推动的投资，转变为更广泛的非洲投资者共同参与的机会。丹格特集团有限公司总裁兼首席执行官阿里科·丹格特表示，这一成果有力印证了非洲的信心、进取精神以及调动自身资源推动发展的能力。“当初我们着手建设这座炼油厂时，许多人怀疑如此规模的项目能否由非洲人建成。我们证明了非洲能够建设它。如今，通过这次历史性IPO，我们展示了一项同样重要的事实：非洲人已经准备好拥有并参与自身产业所创造的繁荣。“来自非洲全部54个国家的投资者提交申购申请，对我而言意义重大。这表明我们的人民不只想消费非洲生产的产品，还愿意投资并拥有这些产业，分享其未来。这就是我们始终坚信的非洲。”他说。“我们推动这次IPO并非仅仅因为需要筹集资本。我们希望打开所有权的大门，让普通非洲人有机会参与一家具有全球意义的企业，并建立一种共享繁荣的新文化。我们依靠非洲人的决心在非洲建设了这座炼油厂，它的未来也必须为非洲人创造机会。“今天，我们共同创造了历史。但更大的成就，将是这次交易激励起来的非洲投资者、创业者和实业家群体。我们的目标不只是打造成功的企业，还要帮助建设一个繁荣、自给自足的非洲，使非洲人民成为其经济命运的参与者。随着我们推进扩张计划和“2030愿景”战略，我们将继续专注于提升运营表现，深化对非洲能源安全的贡献，并打造一家能够回报投资者信任的企业。”声明称，这次IPO的地域覆盖范围尤其重要，因为非洲大陆的资本市场历来受到国界分割、监管环境差异以及散户参与度有限等因素影响。通过吸引非洲全部54个国家提交申购申请，此次交易展示了一个更加互联的投资生态所具有的潜力，使非洲人能够参与本国市场之外的重要工业投资机会。此次发行还凸显了数字金融基础设施在扩大投资可及性方面日益重要的作用。通过传统金融机构与技术驱动型投资平台之间的合作，此次交易为符合条件的投资者提供了多种表达投资意愿并提交申购申请的渠道。丹格特炼油与石化公司董事总经理兼首席执行官戴维·伯德表示，国际市场反响反映出投资者对该炼油厂运营能力、工业规模及长期增长前景的信心。“这次IPO成功完成，是丹格特炼油与石化公司的重要里程碑。来自120个国家的投资者申购申请证明，国际社会对我们的业务展现出非凡兴趣，也体现了投资者对这家炼油厂未来的信心。我们已经建成全球最具规模的炼油与石化综合体之一，当前重点仍是将这种工业规模转化为卓越运营、可持续增长和长期股东价值。”他说。“让此次交易更具意义的是广泛参与。投资者遍布非洲每一个国家以及六大有人居住洲，并有机会持有一家重要非洲工业企业的股份。这是对该炼油厂潜力以及非洲在全球投资市场中日益提升重要性的有力背书。”该炼油厂的IPO于9月14日开放认购，以每股525奈拉的价格发行41亿股普通股，拟募集资金约2.15万亿奈拉。此次发行原定于10月13日结束，但在证券交易委员会批准后延长至10月27日，为非洲及其他国际市场的投资者提供了更多参与时间。延长期限体现了集团在追求交易财务目标的同时，优先推动广泛所有权的既定愿景。除炼油厂本身的重要工业意义外，此次IPO还为非洲金融服务生态体系内的协作建立了范例。其分销网络将银行、证券交易、金融科技和投资者互动等领域的机构汇聚起来，展示了协同基础设施如何扩大公众参与大规模投资机会。丹格特集团有限公司首席财务官穆拉特·尔登表示，这次交易为非洲大陆资本市场树立了重要先例，其执行过程和广泛意义同样值得关注。“丹格特炼油厂人民IPO远不只是一次具有里程碑意义的融资活动。它标志着非洲资本市场演进过程中的决定性时刻，展现了我们大陆调动国内储蓄、连接跨境投资者以及扩大战略工业资产所有权覆盖范围的能力。投资者覆盖120个国家，包括非洲全部54个国家，这是一项非凡成就，也是非洲大陆投资意愿日益增强的有力证明。通过汇聚银行、资本市场机构、证券经纪商、金融科技平台和创新的数字分销渠道，我们证明了非洲资本市场能够跨越国界，让数百万人获得过去难以触及的投资机会。”他说。“尤为重要的是，这次交易建立在卓越的工业和财务基本面之上。2026年前九个月，丹格特炼油厂实现225亿美元收入和55.2亿美元EBITDA，兼具世界级工业规模、强劲盈利能力及显著的长期增长潜力。我们最大的成就不仅是调动资本，更是打开大门，为未来几代非洲投资者、创业者和企业奠定基础。我们相信，人民IPO不仅会作为非洲资本市场史上的里程碑交易被铭记，也将成为建设更具包容性、更互联且具备全球竞争力的非洲金融生态的蓝图。在这个生态中，非洲人将越来越多地为自身大陆的工业转型提供资金、拥有产业，并分享其创造的繁荣。”此次发行成功完成之际，丹格特炼油与石化公司正推进一项雄心勃勃的计划，以扩大炼油和石化业务、加强分销网络，并支持提升非洲整体能源安全。该炼油厂位于拉各斯，是非洲大陆规模最大的私人工业投资之一，也是非洲为减少对进口成品油依赖、建设本土加工能力所作的重大努力。

https://businesspost.ng/general/illegal-.summary: The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) has arrested 15 suspects, comprising 14 Chinese and one Nigerian, at four illegal lithium processing plants in the Ogere area of Ogun State. The commission disclosed this in a post on its official X account, stating that operatives of its Lagos Zonal Directorate 2 carried out the arrests on Friday, October 23, 2026, following credible intelligence and surveillance.
https://businesspost.ng/general/illegal-.summary_zh: 经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）在奥贡州奥格雷地区4家非法锂加工厂逮捕了15名嫌疑人，其中包括14名中国人和1名尼日利亚人。该委员会在官方X账号发布的一则帖文中透露，拉各斯第2分局执法人员于2026年10月23日星期五根据可靠情报和 surveillance 实施了逮捕。
https://businesspost.ng/general/illegal-.body: The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) has arrested 15 suspects, comprising 14 Chinese and one Nigerian, at four illegal lithium processing plants in the Ogere area of Ogun State. The commission disclosed this in a post on its official X account, stating that operatives of its Lagos Zonal Directorate 2 carried out the arrests on Friday, October 23, 2026, following credible intelligence and surveillance. Items recovered during the operation included bags of lithium rocks, 18 mobile devices, four computer laptops, two decoders, a television remote control and a trailer truck. The EFCC said the recovered items had been taken as part of its investigation into the activities of the facilities, adding that the suspects would be charged to court upon the conclusion of investigations. However, the agency did not disclose the specific offences the suspects were alleged to have committed or the ownership of the processing plants. Lithium has become a highly sought-after mineral globally because of its critical role in manufacturing rechargeable batteries used in electric vehicles, smartphones, laptops and renewable energy storage systems. Growing demand for electric vehicles and clean energy technologies has intensified the race to secure lithium supplies, making the mineral increasingly valuable and creating incentives for illegal mining and processing. Nigeria is emerging as a new source of lithium in Africa as the world’s largest producers, like Australia and Chile, are unable to fulfil the growing demand worldwide. However, illegal activities thrive in Nigeria’s extractive sector, denying the government due revenues of up to $9 billion, according to the Nigeria Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (NEITI). The country’s lithium deposits have attracted growing interest from local and foreign operators, while concerns over unregulated extraction, revenue losses, environmental degradation, and the potential circumvention of mining regulations have heightened calls for stricter enforcement. https://businesspost.ng/general/illegal-.title_zh: 非法锂矿开采：经济和金融犯罪委员会在奥贡州拘捕14名中国人和1名尼日利亚人
https://businesspost.ng/general/illegal-.body_zh: 经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）在奥贡州奥盖雷地区的4家非法锂加工厂逮捕了15名嫌疑人，其中14名为中国人、1名为尼日利亚人。该委员会在其官方X账号发布的一则消息中披露，拉各斯第2区分局行动人员于2026年10月23日星期五根据可靠情报和监视行动实施了逮捕。行动中缴获的物品包括装在袋中的锂矿石、18部移动设备、4台笔记本电脑、2个解码器、1个电视遥控器和1辆拖挂卡车。EFCC表示，缴获的物品已作为调查这些工厂经营活动的一部分被查扣，并称调查结束后将把嫌疑人移交法院起诉。然而，该机构没有披露嫌疑人被指控实施的具体罪行，也没有披露这些加工厂的归属。锂已成为全球备受追捧的矿产，因为它在制造用于电动汽车、智能手机、笔记本电脑和可再生能源储存系统的可充电电池方面发挥着关键作用。电动汽车和清洁能源技术需求不断增长，加剧了各国争夺锂供应的竞争，使这种矿产的价值日益提高，也刺激了非法采矿和加工活动。随着澳大利亚和智利等全球最大生产国无法满足全球不断增长的需求，尼日利亚正成为非洲新的锂来源。然而，尼日利亚采掘业的非法活动十分猖獗，使政府损失最高达90亿美元的收入，据尼日利亚采掘业透明度倡议（NEITI）称。该国的锂矿藏吸引了越来越多的本地和外国运营商关注，同时，对不受监管的开采、收入流失、环境破坏以及规避采矿法规的担忧，也强化了要求加强执法的呼声。Adedapo Adesanya是一名记者、多才多艺的学者，也是艺术各个领域的行家。不写作时，他不是埋首阅读自己收藏夹中的众多书籍或文章之一，就是拿着一瓶啤酒或葡萄酒聆听好音乐。他支持世界上最伟大的俱乐部——Manchester United F.C.

https://leadership.ng/niger-republic-tig.body: The new policy says marketers would not sell fuel between nine at night and six in the morning to enable suppliers, including the Nigerien Petroleum Company (Sonidep), to restock them. It said this temporary measure aimed to improve the smooth running of operations while guaranteeing deliveries and the availability of petrol, following a countrywide shortage. But the measure is impacting taxis drivers, like Moussa Idé Boubacar, who said he has not been able to make his payments for two days. “Normally, we generate revenue of around 20,000 a day, of which 8,000 is for payments and 12,000 is for fuel. With this shortage, we’ve had some management issues,” he said. As the fuel shortage spread, motorists have been facing increasingly long queues at stations. Residents in the capital, Niamey, and elsewhere said this was disrupting daily life, making it difficult to get to work and carry out their daily activities. The taxi union, Synctaxi, has called for the new curfew to be relaxed for operators who are struggling to make ends meet. “To obtain fuel, you need authorisation. The petrol station must be open around the clock,” said it secretary-general, Ganda Sanda. “We are appealing to the governorate and the governor as well to reconsider because it does not suit us,” he said. Sanda added that the union wanted to draw the authorities’ attention to the fact that the transport sector “makes a significant contribution to the country’s development”. https://x.com/annamalindoguy/status/2116.title: REAPER DRONES IN PALAWAN: IS THE PHILIPPINES BECOMING AMERICA’S FORWARD MILITARY OUTPOST?
https://x.com/annamalindoguy/status/2116.snippet:
REAPER DRONES IN PALAWAN: IS THE PHILIPPINES BECOMING AMERICA’S FORWARD MILITARY OUTPOST?

The reported deployment of American MQ-9A Reaper drones to Antonio Bautista Air Base in Puerto Princesa, Palawan, raises a consequential geopolitical question: Is the Philippines strengthening its national defense, or progressively transforming itself into a forward operating platform for American military operations against China?

According to an October 28, 2026, USNI News report, the US Marine Corps’ Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Squadron 1 (VMU-1) is operating Reaper drones from Palawan, placing sophisticated American intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities closer to the disputed Spratly Islands.

This is not the first American Reaper deployment in the Philippines. Similar operations have previously been conducted from Basa Air Base in Pampanga. What makes Palawan strategically significant is its geographical proximity to sensitive South China Sea flashpoints, particularly Ayungin Shoal.

Geography, in geopolitics, is never incidental.

Is Philippine territory increasingly being integrated into America’s military containment strategy against China??

For Manila, the implications are considerably more complicated.

First, the deployment potentially transforms Philippine territory into a more consequential node in the US military’s regional surveillance network. While enhanced intelligence capabilities may strengthen Philippine maritime domain awareness, they also increase the country’s exposure to geopolitical retaliation and military escalation.

Second, the deployment raises fundamental questions about operational sovereignty. Who determines the drones’ missions? Who controls the intelligence collected? Who authorizes surveillance activities? Can Manila veto operations that compromise Philippine national interests?

These questions matter because hosting foreign military capabilities is not synonymous with controlling their strategic consequences.

Third, Palawan’s increasing military significance creates potential vulnerabilities. In a hypothetical US-China confrontation, facilities supporting American military operations could become strategically relevant targets. The Philippines could consequently face risks arising from decisions made beyond its direct control.

Fourth, this development further complicates already deteriorating Philippines-China relations. Beijing may perceive the deployment not merely as defensive surveillance but as evidence of expanding American military encirclement. Such perceptions could intensify countermeasures, accelerate militarization, and narrow diplomatic space. Strengthening national defense should not come at the expense of strategic autonomy.

The Marcos administration must therefore explain the deployment’s operational parameters, intelligence-sharing arrangements, and safeguards against unauthorized military activities.

The Philippines must distinguish between being an American ally and becoming an American frontline. The two are not necessarily the same.

Ultimately, the strategic question is not whether American Reapers can monitor Chinese vessels from Palawan. They can.

The more consequential question is whether Manila controls the risks associated with their presence.

Because when great powers confront each other, geography determines exposure, but political decisions determine vulnerability.

And the Philippines cannot afford to become the battlefield of a confrontation it neither initiated nor controls.

https://x.com/annamalindoguy/status/2116.title_zh: “死神”无人机部署于巴拉望：菲律宾是否正在成为美国的前沿军事据点？
https://x.com/annamalindoguy/status/2116.snippet_zh:
巴洛克无人机部署巴拉望：菲律宾是否正在成为美国的前沿军事据点？

据报道，美国将MQ-9A“死神”无人机部署至位于巴拉望省普林塞萨港的安东尼奥·包蒂斯塔空军基地，这引发了一个影响深远的地缘政治问题：菲律宾是在加强国防，还是正逐步转变为美军针对中国开展行动的前沿作战平台？

据美国海军研究所新闻网站2026年10月28日报道，美国海军陆战队无人航空飞行中队1（VMU-1）正在巴拉望省操作“死神”无人机，使美国先进的情报、监视和侦察能力更接近存在争议的南沙群岛。

这并非美国首次在菲律宾部署“死神”无人机。此前也曾从邦板牙省巴萨空军基地开展类似行动。巴拉望省具有重要战略意义，在于其地理位置靠近南海敏感热点，尤其是仁爱礁。

在地缘政治中，地理位置从来都不是无关紧要的因素。

菲律宾领土是否正日益被纳入美国针对中国的军事遏制战略？

对马尼拉而言，这一问题的影响要复杂得多。

首先，此次部署可能使菲律宾领土成为美军区域监视网络中一个更加重要的节点。情报能力的增强固然可能提升菲律宾对海上领域的态势感知，但也会增加该国遭遇地缘政治报复和军事升级的风险。

其次，此次部署引出了有关行动主权的根本性问题。无人机的任务由谁决定？所收集的情报由谁掌控？监视行动由谁批准？马尼拉能否否决损害菲律宾国家利益的行动？

这些问题之所以重要，是因为接纳外国军事能力并不等于能够控制其战略后果。

第三，巴拉望省军事重要性的提升也会带来潜在脆弱性。在美中发生对抗的假设情境下，支援美军行动的相关设施可能成为具有战略价值的目标。因此，菲律宾可能因自身无法直接控制的决策而面临风险。

https://x.com/theclemeast/status/2116053.title: 1/ A Chinese mining company has offered about $210 million in cash to buy Atlantic Lithium, the firm trying to open Ghana's first lithium mi
https://x.com/theclemeast/status/2116053.snippet:
1/ A Chinese mining company has offered about $210 million in cash to buy Atlantic Lithium, the firm trying to open Ghana's first lithium mine.
But if you hold its shares on the GSE, there's a catch. 🧵

2/ Atlantic Lithium (GSE: ALLGH) is developing the Ewoyaa lithium project in Ghana, about 100km from Accra.

On May 7, 2026, a company called Huayou agreed to buy ALL of Atlantic Lithium's shares for cash. The latest quarterly report (Oct 27) updates the deal.
3/ The offer: US$0.25486 per share.

That's roughly GH₵3.00 at about GH₵11.7 per dollar (my conversion). It's also A$0.354 or £0.188.

It values the whole company at about US$210 million. That's a 26.6% premium over its Australian price the day before the deal was announced.

4/ Here's the catch.

The last GSE price I found for ALLGH was GH₵5.30 (Oct 2). That's nearly 80% HIGHER than the offer in cedis.

It also barely trades. The price sat unchanged for days, on a few thousand shares at most.

5/ If GSE shareholders are paid the same per share as everyone else, the payout would be about 44% below that GSE price (my calculation).

Check with your broker, and read the Scheme Booklet, to see how GSE-held shares are treated. I couldn't confirm that.

6/ Even in Australia, the shares trade below the offer: A$0.265 (Oct 16) vs A$0.354. That's about 25% under.

My reading: the market isn't sure the deal will close.

7/ What still has to happen:
• Court hearing: Nov 5 
• A shareholder vote 
• Court approval in Western Australia 
• Other regulatory approvals

Australia's foreign-investment approval is already done. The board recommends voting yes, unless a better offer appears or the independent expert disagrees.

8/ Huayou has already stepped in on the project.

It took over the rights of Elevra (formerly Piedmont Lithium), now holds 22.5% of the Ghana lithium projects, and will fund US$66 million of development costs to reach 50%.

So the mine project keeps moving while the takeover is pending.

9/ The money side:
• Cash: A$7.7M, no debt 
• Spent A$6.0M this quarter 
• Cash alone covers only about 1 to 1.5 quarters (my calculation)

The company can also tap a £20M equity facility, and Huayou now pays project costs.

10/ The lesson: when a takeover offer is on the table, compare it with the market price. Check how thinly the stock trades.

Source: Atlantic Lithium quarterly report, 27 Oct 2026; ALLGH price: MarketScreener; ASX price: ListCorp.

https://x.com/mrhgovgh/status/2115730990.snippet:
Hon. Agbodza Explores Stronger Ghana-China Partnership in Road Infrastructure Development

The Minister of Roads and Highways, Hon. Kwame Governs Agbodza, has reaffirmed Government’s commitment to strengthen bilateral relations between Ghana and China while exploring opportunities for further collaboration in road infrastructure development. 

He made this known when a joint delegation from the Jiangxi Provincial State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (Jiangxi Provincial SASAC) and China Jiangxi International Economic and Technical Cooperation Company Ltd. paid a courtesy call on him to discuss existing relations and prospects for future partnerships with the Ministry.

Hon. Agbodza underscored government’s commitment to maintaining a mutually beneficial relationship between the two countries. “President Mahama has arguably made the largest scale of infrastructure investment within the road sector under the Big Push Programme and Chinese companies are participating significantly. The relationship between Ghana and China is very important to us and we promise to do what we can to sustain it,” he said. 

He noted that cooperation with international institutions and development partners remains important in mobilising investment, technical expertise and other resources to support the country’s road infrastructure priorities.

The delegation was led by Mr. Xiao Yun, Director-General of Jiangxi Provincial SASAC, together with Mr. Xu Zhenghua, Vice President of CJIC.

https://x.com/mrhgovgh/status/2115730990.title_zh: 阿格博扎阁下探讨加强加纳与中国的道路基础设施伙伴关系。道路与公路部长Kwame Gov
https://x.com/mrhgovgh/status/2115730990.snippet_zh:
阿博扎议员探索加纳与中国在道路基础设施发展方面的更强伙伴关系

道路和公路部长、尊敬的夸梅·戈文斯·阿博扎重申，政府致力于加强加纳与中国之间的双边关系，同时探索在道路基础设施发展方面进一步合作的机会。

他在江西省国有资产监督管理委员会（江西省国资委）和中国江西国际经济技术合作有限公司联合代表团对他进行礼节性拜访时发表上述言论，双方讨论了现有关系以及与该部未来伙伴关系的前景。

阿博扎议员强调了政府致力于维持两国之间互利关系的承诺。“马哈马总统可以说在‘大推动计划’下对道路部门进行了最大规模的基础设施投资，中国公司正在发挥重要作用。加纳与中国之间的关系对我们非常重要，我们承诺将尽我们所能维持它，”他说。

他指出，与国际机构和发展伙伴的合作在调动投资、技术专长和其他资源以支持该国道路基础设施优先事项方面仍然很重要。

代表团由江西省国资委主任肖云先生率领，江西国际经济技术合作有限公司副总裁徐正华先生陪同。

https://x.com/tribunephl/status/21156445.snippet:
CHINA OWNS 40% OF THE COMPANY RUNNING OUR POWER GRID

The Philippine government owns the country's electricity transmission infrastructure, but the private company operating it, the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (#NGCP), is 40 percent owned by China's state-owned State Grid Corporation.

That means the Chinese government holds a substantial stake in the company responsible for transmitting electricity across the Philippines, even as tensions between Manila and Beijing persist in the West Philippine Sea.

NGCP maintains that Filipino engineers operate the grid, and there is no established evidence that China possesses a secret mechanism to shut it down.

But the ownership arrangement raises a national security question: Should a foreign government with which the Philippines has an ongoing territorial dispute own part of the company operating its electricity transmission network?

https://x.com/tribunephl/status/21156445.snippet_zh:
运营我国电网的公司40%股权归中国所有

菲律宾政府拥有该国的输电基础设施，但负责运营这些设施的私营公司菲律宾国家电网公司（#NGCP）有40%的股权由中国国有国家电网公司持有。

这意味着，在马尼拉与北京于西菲律宾海持续紧张对峙之际，中国政府仍持有这家负责向菲律宾各地输电的公司相当可观的所有权权益。

NGCP坚持表示，菲律宾工程师负责电网运营，而且没有确凿证据表明中国掌握着秘密手段，可以关闭该电网。

但这种股权安排提出了一个国家安全问题：菲律宾与一个存在持续领土争端的国家，该国政府是否应持有负责运营菲律宾输电网络之公司的部分股权？

https://x.com/amborin/status/21154911112.snippet:
"Russia can technologically help the US build an LNG plant in Alaska...the Polar LNG project worth $25 billion"

"What does Russia need from the US in the Arctic? "two things...first is the market, second is iron. The lifting of sanctions on the Arctic LNG-2 and its LNG carriers will bring back buyers from Japan, India, Southeast Asia and remove the discount that is now being taken away by the only client - China"

"A diesel deal with the United States, an opportunity to expand the supply of Russian fertilizers, and now Russia is offering to work together in the Arctic. How could the Arctic unite Russia and the United States, and what can Moscow offer Washington in return for lifting sanctions on Russian gas?

Russia is working on the possibility of joint work with the United States in the Arctic, Russian President Vladimir Putin said.

"In the Arctic, which I mentioned, we are actively working with many countries of the world and are interested in working together. Quite recently, European partners worked with us in our fields. Now we are working on the possibility of joint work with American partners," Putin said at the summit of the Gas Exporting Countries Forum (GECF).

What kind of joint work with the United States can Russia have?

We are talking about LNG projects. Indeed, after 2022, due to sanctions against Russia, European companies withdrew from participating in gas projects with Russia - in Yamal LNG and Arctic LNG-2. However, cooperation with Chinese companies has reached a new level, says Igor Yushkov, an expert at the National Energy Security Fund (NEF) and the Financial University under the Government of the Russian Federation. There are two Chinese shareholders in the Arctic LNG 2 - CNPC and CNOOC, which were initially afraid of US sanctions against the project and froze their participation. However, Beijing did not change its policy, just the Chinese companies CNPC and CNOOC did not risk access to the dollar, says Mikhail Vakilyan, an expert at the Institute for the Development of Fuel and Energy Technologies.

But after a year and a half, everything changed. In the second half of 2025, China began buying gas from the sanctioned Arctic LNG-2 plant, allocating an entire terminal for the project, and this year opened a second terminal only for Russian LNG. China has even resumed the delivery of modules for the completion of the third stage of the Arctic LNG-2, although earlier deliveries were suspended.

What does Russia need from the United States in the Arctic? "Russia needs two things. The first is the market, the second is iron. The lifting of sanctions on the Arctic LNG-2 and its LNG carriers will bring back buyers from Japan, India, Southeast Asia and remove the discount that is now being taken away by the only client - China. As for iron, the liquefaction compressors at Yamal LNG and Arctic LNG-2 drive the turbines of Baker Hughes, and this is an American company. Service, spare parts and modernization of these cars run into American export bans," says Vakilyan.

"Here is the same scheme as with the diesel deal. We offer the United States mutually beneficial projects and cooperation in the economy in general in exchange for easing anti-Russian sanctions and putting pressure on Ukraine. We show that this cooperation can be very multifaceted and in different areas: diesel, fertilizers, LNG, and so on,"
says the expert of the National Energy Security Fund and the Financial University under the Government of the Russian Federation.

What can Russia offer the United States in the field of LNG in exchange for the lifting of sanctions? Russia can technologically help the United States build an LNG plant in Alaska. We are talking about the Polar LNG project worth $25 billion.

"Novatek has a technological solution for the LNG project in Alaska, which it applied to the Arctic LNG 2. These are reinforced concrete platforms on which liquefaction equipment is poured - and this is, in fact, an LNG plant. Novatek has already built two such platforms with equipment, and has built a center for the construction of large-capacity offshore structures in Belokamenka. The problem is that both this center and the Arctic LNG-2 plant itself fell under US sanctions. Therefore, we can build such a plant in Alaska in exchange for the lifting of sanctions at least from the center for the construction of large-capacity platforms," Yushkov says.

According to him, Russia can pour a platform in this center, build the LNG plant itself on it and only then drive it to Alaska. This is a simpler solution, because it is expensive to build something in the Arctic itself, and creates restrictions on time and the possibility of importing equipment, etc.

"It is not a fact that this story will come to fruition, because there are many sanctions problems and questions about the economics of the project, but nevertheless, the Americans are interested in our technologies for Alaska, and Russia uses and says that it can do it,"
says Yushkov. However, we should not forget that Russia is the main competitor of the United States in terms of gas, and in recent years, the American leadership has consistently squeezed Russian gas out of the European market, the expert adds. And helping LNG from the United States to occupy the market share that the Russian Federation has lost is not a good idea.

However, in addition to the Arctic LNG 2, there is another Russian project that could benefit from cooperation with the United States. This is Yamal LNG, which is not affected by US sanctions. However, the problem is different. From January 1, 2027, the EU bans the supply of any Russian LNG. "In the first half of the year, Europe took almost all of the plant's products - 9.89 million tons. In two months, these volumes need a new route and a new buyer – and an American trader looks natural in this place," says Vakilyan."

-Vzglyad

https://x.com/amborin/status/21154911112.title_zh: “俄罗斯可以在技术上帮助美国在阿拉斯加建设液化天然气厂……即价值250亿美元的Polar LNG项目。” “俄罗斯需要从……获得什么
https://x.com/amborin/status/21154911112.snippet_zh:
“俄罗斯可以在技术上帮助美国在阿拉斯加建造液化天然气工厂……这就是价值250亿美元的极地LNG项目”

“俄罗斯在北极地区需要美国提供什么？有两样东西……第一是市场，第二是钢铁。取消对Arctic LNG-2及其液化天然气运输船的制裁，将让日本、印度和东南亚的买家回归，并消除目前唯一客户——中国所获得的折扣。至于钢铁，Yamal LNG和Arctic LNG-2的液化压缩机会驱动Baker Hughes的涡轮机，而Baker Hughes是一家美国公司。这些设施的维护、备件供应和现代化改造都受到美国出口禁令的限制。”——瓦基利扬

“俄罗斯与美国达成柴油协议、扩大俄罗斯化肥供应的机会，如今俄罗斯又提出在北极地区合作。北极地区如何促成俄罗斯与美国联手，作为解除对俄罗斯天然气制裁的回报，莫斯科又能向华盛顿提供什么？

俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京表示，俄罗斯正在研究与美国在北极地区合作的可能性。

普京在天然气出口国论坛峰会上说：“在我刚才提到的北极地区，我们正积极与世界上许多国家开展合作，也希望携手合作。就在不久前，欧洲伙伴还曾在我们的油气田与我们合作。现在，我们正在研究与美国伙伴开展合作的可能性。”

俄罗斯可以在哪些方面与美国开展合作？

这涉及液化天然气项目。确实，2022年以后，由于对俄罗斯实施制裁，欧洲企业退出了参与俄罗斯天然气项目，包括Yamal LNG和Arctic LNG-2。然而，俄罗斯联邦政府下属国家能源安全基金和金融大学的专家伊戈尔·尤什科夫表示，与中国企业的合作已经提升到新的水平。Arctic LNG 2有两名中国股东，即CNPC和CNOOC。两家公司最初担心美国会制裁该项目，因而暂停参与。不过，北京并未改变政策，只是中国公司CNPC和CNOOC不愿冒着使用美元结算的风险。燃料与能源技术发展研究所专家米哈伊尔·瓦基利扬如是说。

但一年半后，情况发生了变化。2025年下半年，中国开始从受制裁的Arctic LNG-2工厂采购天然气，为该项目划拨了一整座码头，今年又启用了一座专门接收俄罗斯液化天然气的码头。中国甚至恢复了为Arctic LNG-2第三阶段完工所需模块的交付，而此前这些交付已暂停。

俄罗斯在北极地区需要美国提供什么？瓦基利扬说：“俄罗斯需要两样东西。第一是市场，第二是钢铁。取消对Arctic LNG-2及其液化天然气运输船的制裁，将让日本、印度和东南亚的买家回归，并消除目前唯一客户——中国所获得的折扣。至于钢铁，Yamal LNG和Arctic LNG-2的液化压缩机会驱动Baker Hughes的涡轮机，而Baker Hughes是一家美国公司。这些设施的维护、备件供应和现代化改造都受到美国出口禁令的限制。”

“这与柴油协议采用的是同一套模式。我们向美国提供互利项目以及整体经济合作，以换取放松对俄制裁，并向乌克兰施压。我们表明，这种合作可以非常广泛，涵盖不同领域，包括柴油、化肥和液化天然气等。”——俄罗斯联邦政府下属国家能源安全基金和金融大学的专家

作为解除制裁的回报，俄罗斯可以在液化天然气领域向美国提供什么？俄罗斯可以在技术上帮助美国在阿拉斯加建造液化天然气工厂。这指的是价值250亿美元的极地LNG项目。

尤什科夫说：“Novatek拥有适用于阿拉斯加液化天然气项目的技术方案，并已将这套方案用于Arctic LNG 2。这是在钢筋混凝土平台上浇筑液化设备，而平台本身就是一座液化天然气工厂。Novatek已经建造了两座配有设备的此类平台，还在别洛卡缅卡建造了一座大型海上结构物建造中心。问题在于，这座建造中心和Arctic LNG-2工厂本身都受到美国制裁。因此，至少只要取消对大型平台建造中心的制裁，我们就可以在阿拉斯加建造这样一座工厂。”

据他介绍，俄罗斯可以在该建造中心浇筑平台，在平台上建成液化天然气工厂，之后再将其运往阿拉斯加。这是一种更简单的方案，因为在北极地区直接建造设施成本高昂，还会受到工期以及进口设备可能性等方面的限制。

尤什科夫说：“这件事最终能否实现尚无定论，因为其中涉及许多制裁问题和项目经济性问题。尽管如此，美国人对我们用于阿拉斯加的技术感兴趣，而俄罗斯也能做到，并表示自己有能力完成。”不过，这位专家补充称，俄罗斯在天然气领域是美国的主要竞争对手。近年来，美国领导层一直设法将俄罗斯天然气挤出欧洲市场。帮助美国液化天然气重新占据俄罗斯联邦失去的市场份额并不是好主意。

然而，除了Arctic LNG 2之外，还有另一个可能从与美国合作中获益的俄罗斯项目，即不受美国制裁影响的Yamal LNG。不过，它面临的是另一个问题。自2027年1月1日起，欧盟将禁止供应任何俄罗斯液化天然气。瓦基利扬说：“今年上半年，欧洲采购了该工厂几乎全部产品，约为989万吨。两个月内，这些货量就需要寻找新的运输路线和新的买家，而美国贸易商显然是合适的选择。”

——《观察》

“这与柴油协议采用的是同一套模式。我们向美国提供互利项目以及整体经济合作，以换取放松对俄制裁，并向乌克兰施压。我们表明，这种合作可以非常广泛，涵盖不同领域，包括柴油、化肥和液化天然气等。”——俄罗斯联邦政府下属国家能源安全基金和金融大学的专家

作为解除制裁的回报，俄罗斯可以在液化天然气领域向美国提供什么？俄罗斯可以在技术上帮助美国在阿拉斯加建造液化天然气工厂。这指的是价值250亿美元的极地LNG项目。

尤什科夫说：“Novatek拥有适用于阿拉斯加液化天然气项目的技术方案，并已将这套方案用于Arctic LNG 2。这是在钢筋混凝土平台上浇筑液化设备，而平台本身就是一座液化天然气工厂。Novatek已经建造了两座配有设备的此类平台，还在别洛卡缅卡建造了一座大型海上结构物建造中心。问题在于，这座建造中心和Arctic LNG-2工厂本身都受到美国制裁。因此，至少只要取消对大型平台建造中心的制裁，我们就可以在阿拉斯加建造这样一座工厂。”

据他介绍，俄罗斯可以在该建造中心浇筑平台，在平台上建成液化天然气工厂，之后再将其运往阿拉斯加。这是一种更简单的方案，因为在北极地区直接建造设施成本高昂，还会受到工期以及进口设备可能性等方面的限制。

尤什科夫说：“这件事最终能否实现尚无定论，因为其中涉及许多制裁问题和项目经济性问题。尽管如此，美国人对我们用于阿拉斯加的技术感兴趣，而俄罗斯也能做到，并表示自己有能力完成。”不过，这位专家补充称，俄罗斯在天然气领域是美国的主要竞争对手。近年来，美国领导层一直设法将俄罗斯天然气挤出欧洲市场。帮助美国液化天然气重新占据俄罗斯联邦失去的市场份额并不是好主意。

然而，除了Arctic LNG 2之外，还有另一个可能从与美国合作中获益的俄罗斯项目，即不受美国制裁影响的Yamal LNG。不过，它面临的是另一个问题。自2027年1月1日起，欧盟将禁止供应任何俄罗斯液化天然气。瓦基利扬说：“今年上半年，欧洲采购了该工厂几乎全部产品，约为989万吨。两个月内，这些货量就需要寻找新的运输路线和新的买家，而美国贸易商显然是合适的选择。”

——《观察》

https://x.com/grok/status/21153377688762.title: Chinese/Russian deals centered on oil-for-loan financing: China lent tens of billions repaid via discounted crude shipments (often no cash)
https://x.com/grok/status/21153377688762.snippet:
Chinese/Russian deals centered on oil-for-loan financing: China lent tens of billions repaid via discounted crude shipments (often no cash), with CNPC/Sinopec JVs in underdeveloped fields. Russia used similar loans and Rosneft/Roszarubezhneft stakes for oil prepayments. Goals: secure cheap energy supplies and geopolitical footholds amid sanctions. Venezuela gained credit access but received limited investment, low production gains, and reduced revenue.

The US deal grants NABEP (US-backed, 35% gov stake) 100-year concessions on 17 fields (~65B barrels, some prior Chinese/Russian ops). Goals: displace rivals, secure crisis reserves/SPR access (20% at cost + first refusal), revive output via up to $100B investment. Venezuela gets royalties/taxes (~$19/bbl, $200B+ projected), jobs, and market-oriented production growth—but faces long-term lock-in and legitimacy questions from opposition.

https://x.com/grok/status/21153377688762.title_zh: 中俄协议以石油换贷款融资为核心：中国出借数百亿美元，并通过打折的原油运输偿还（往往无需现金）
https://x.com/grok/status/21153377688762.snippet_zh:
中俄交易以石油换贷款融资为中心：中国出借数百亿美元，并通过打折原油运输偿还（通常无需支付现金），同时在中国石油/中国石化与俄罗斯 undeveloped 油田成立的合资企业中投资。俄罗斯也利用类似贷款，以及俄罗斯石油公司/俄罗斯石油 Roszarubezhneft 的股份换取石油预付款。目标是在制裁之下确保廉价的能源供应并建立地缘政治立足点。委内瑞拉获得了信贷渠道，但得到的投资有限、产量增长有限、收入也有所下降。

美国协议授予NABEP（美国支持、拥有35%政府股份）17个油田的100年特许经营权（约650亿桶，其中一些油田此前由中俄企业运营）。目标是排挤竞争对手、确保危机储备以及获得战略石油储备的使用权（以成本价购买20%，并享有优先购买权），通过最多1000亿美元投资恢复产量。委内瑞拉将获得特许权使用费和税费（约为每桶19美元，预计总额超过2000亿美元）、就业岗位以及面向市场的产量增长——但也将面临长期锁定风险，以及反对派对其合法性的质疑。

https://x.com/chinaarmyobs/status/211515.title: 🇨🇳China rejects India’s accusations of violating border agreements — Bloomberg Beijing has described the actions of its military as routine
https://x.com/chinaarmyobs/status/211515.snippet:
🇨🇳China rejects India’s accusations of violating border agreements — Bloomberg

Beijing has described the actions of its military as routine patrolling, following reports of fresh standoffs along the disputed border. New Delhi maintains that Chinese units occasionally deviate from established routes, thereby disrupting the peace.

At a briefing on October 26, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun stated that China adheres to the agreements and urged India to work together to uphold them. He noted that the two sides remain in contact through both diplomatic and military channels. The dispute has intensified against the backdrop of efforts to restore relations and resume direct air travel between the two nations.
